title: Project & Account Manager B2B
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. En naast individuele woningeigenaren werken we ook steeds meer samen met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders die grotere aantallen woningen willen verduurzamen.

Daarom zoeken we een B2B Account & Project Manager die deze projecten van begin tot eind in goede banen leidt. Iemand die overzicht houdt, afspraken nakomt en ervoor zorgt dat klanten, bewoners, installateurs en interne teams weten waar ze aan toe zijn.

Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen onze zakelijke klanten en de mensen die de projecten uitvoeren. Je zorgt dat plannen niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook in de praktijk werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het succesvol realiseren van grotere warmtepompprojecten. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan de installatie van warmtepompen in 50 woningen binnen één wijk, waarbij meerdere installatieteams, bewoners en externe partners betrokken zijn.

Je zorgt dat projecten soepel verlopen

  • Je vertaalt afspraken met zakelijke klanten naar een concreet projectplan met duidelijke deadlines, verantwoordelijkheden en deliverables.

  • Je bewaakt de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en afgesproken KPI's van projecten.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met onze Installation Quality Specialist aan de voorbereiding en uitvoering van projecten. Jij houdt de regie over het totale project, terwijl de Installation Quality Specialist de technische kwaliteit bewaakt.

  • Je stemt de voorbereiding en uitvoering af met onze interne teams, installateurs en externe partners.

  • Je signaleert risico's en knelpunten vroegtijdig en zorgt dat ze worden opgelost voordat ze de voortgang in gevaar brengen.

  • Je houdt overzicht over meerdere projecten tegelijk en stelt prioriteiten waar nodig.

Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor onze zakelijke klanten

  • Je onderhoudt relaties met woningcorporaties, vastgoedeigenaren en vastgoedbeheerders.

  • Je zorgt dat klanten weten wat ze kunnen verwachten, hoe projecten ervoor staan en welke beslissingen nodig zijn.

  • Je organiseert de afstemming tussen alle betrokken partijen, van de opdrachtgever tot de bewoners en installatieteams.

  • Je rapporteert over de voortgang, resultaten en kwaliteit van projecten en bespreekt verbeterpunten met klanten.

  • Je bouwt aan langdurige klantrelaties door afspraken waar te maken en problemen goed op te lossen.

Je helpt ons steeds slimmer te werken

  • Je kijkt kritisch naar hoe we grotere installatieprojecten organiseren en uitvoeren.

  • Je gebruikt projectdata en KPI's om te begrijpen wat goed gaat en waar we kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je helpt processen te ontwikkelen waarmee we steeds grotere aantallen woningen efficiënt en met hoge kwaliteit kunnen verduurzamen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die structuur kan aanbrengen in complexe projecten, maar ook pragmatisch is wanneer de werkelijkheid anders loopt dan gepland. Je kunt schakelen tussen een gesprek met een vastgoedmanager en het oplossen van een praktisch probleem met een installatieteam.

Dit vinden we belangrijk:

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met projectmanagement, waarbij je zelf verantwoordelijk was voor planning, voortgang, kwaliteit en resultaten.

  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en communiceert makkelijk met verschillende partijen, zowel intern als extern.

  • Je weet hoe je meerdere projecten, deadlines en belangen tegelijkertijd managet zonder het overzicht te verliezen.

  • Je bent gewend om met KPI's te werken en hierover helder te rapporteren.

  • Je neemt eigenaarschap. Als iets niet volgens plan loopt, wacht je niet af maar kom je met een oplossing.

  • Je bent organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en werkt graag in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je goed redden in het Engels.

Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste:

  • Ervaring met woningcorporaties, vastgoedbeheerders of andere zakelijke partijen in de vastgoedsector.

  • Ervaring met de uitrol van grotere verduurzamings-, installatie- of renovatieprojecten.

  • Affiniteit met warmtepompen, installatietechniek of de energietransitie.

Je hoeft dus geen warmtepompexpert te zijn. Belangrijker is dat je weet hoe je een complex project succesvol organiseert, mensen meekrijgt en resultaten behaalt.

Waarom DeWarmte?

Bij DeWarmte krijg je de kans om direct bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Je werkt niet aan abstracte plannen, maar aan projecten die ervoor zorgen dat steeds meer woningen daadwerkelijk van het gas af kunnen.

We zijn een groeiende scale-up met korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en weinig bureaucratie. Je krijgt de ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, verbeteringen door te voeren en mee te bouwen aan hoe we onze B2B-projecten in de toekomst organiseren.

Je werkt samen met collega's uit verschillende teams die allemaal hetzelfde doel hebben: slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen toegankelijk maken voor zoveel mogelijk huishoudens.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een rol met veel verantwoordelijkheid en directe impact op de groei van DeWarmte.

  • De kans om mee te bouwen aan onze B2B-activiteiten en de manier waarop we grotere projecten uitvoeren.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ontwikkeling en het verbeteren van processen.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €3500 en €5000 per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • Via ons SAR-programma (Stock Appreciation Rights) deel je mee in het financiële succes van DeWarmte en profiteer je van de waarde die we samen opbouwen.

  • Een fijne werkplek in Den Haag, met de mogelijkheid om ook op projectlocaties te werken.

  • Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

  • Gezamenlijke lunch op kantoor.

  • Regelmatige teamuitjes en borrels, waaronder onze jaarlijkse stranddag en wintersport.

Interesse?

Lijkt het je leuk om grotere verduurzamingsprojecten van plan naar praktijk te brengen? En krijg je energie van het organiseren, verbinden en oplossen van problemen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Compensation: €3.5K – €5K per month

title: Klantadviseur Sales
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard en steeds meer mensen weten ons te vinden. Daarom zoeken we een Klantadviseur Sales die ervoor zorgt dat iedere geïnteresseerde én bestaande klant snel en goed geholpen wordt.

Je hebt contact met klanten, voornamelijk telefonisch en via video. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en helpt iemand naar de logische volgende stap. Soms betekent dat een afspraak inplannen voor een Digitale Inspectie. Soms blijkt dat onze oplossing niet past. En soms help je een bestaande klant met een vraag nadat de warmtepomp al is geïnstalleerd.

Je hoeft bij binnenkomst geen warmtepompexpert te zijn. Wel vinden we het belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en energie krijgt van veel klantcontact.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten en werkt over verschillende momenten in de customer journey.

Aan de voorkant van ons salesproces volg je nieuwe leads op. Je belt mensen die interesse hebben getoond in onze warmtepompen, ontdekt wat hun situatie en behoefte is en beoordeelt of een Digitale Inspectie een goede volgende stap is. Je legt helder uit hoe onze producten en het proces werken en zorgt dat goede leads daadwerkelijk verder komen.

Daarnaast help je bestaande klanten met vragen nadat ze voor DeWarmte hebben gekozen. Je luistert, zoekt uit wat er speelt en zorgt dat de klant verder wordt geholpen. Waar nodig schakel je met collega's uit andere teams.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • telefonisch contact hebt met potentiële en bestaande klanten;

  • nieuwe leads snel en zorgvuldig opvolgt;

  • doorvraagt om te begrijpen wat een klant nodig heeft en of DeWarmte bij de situatie past;

  • geïnteresseerde klanten begeleidt naar een concrete volgende stap;

  • bestaande klanten helpt met vragen en zorgt voor goede opvolging;

  • gesprekken en afspraken netjes vastlegt in ons CRM systeem;

  • terugbelafspraken en openstaande acties zelfstandig opvolgt;

  • via telefoon en videocalls vertrouwen opbouwt en onze producten duidelijk uitlegt;

  • signaleert waar klanten tegenaan lopen en die inzichten deelt met het team.

Wie zoeken we?

Voor deze rol vinden we je manier van werken belangrijker dan een specifiek diploma of aantal jaren ervaring.

Je bent sterk in communicatie. Je maakt makkelijk contact, luistert goed, vraagt door en kunt informatie op een eenvoudige manier uitleggen.

Je hebt daarnaast een commerciële drive. Je vindt het leuk om een gesprek ergens naartoe te brengen en durft een concrete vervolgstap voor te stellen. Je bent overtuigend zonder te pushen.

Je kunt goed kwalificeren. Je achterhaalt snel wat iemand zoekt, wat de situatie is en of het zinvol is om verder te gaan in het proces.

Ook houd je van tempo en resultaat. Op een drukke dag spreek je verschillende klanten. Dat geeft je eerder energie dan dat het je afschrikt.

En je werkt gestructureerd en zelfstandig. Als je iemand belooft donderdag terug te bellen, gebeurt dat ook. Leads, afspraken en acties blijven niet liggen.

Mooi meegenomen

Ervaring in sales is fijn, maar zeker niet de enige route naar deze functie. Misschien heb je gewerkt in inbound sales, telefonische verkoop, een callcenter, energie of telecom. Maar ook ervaring in bijvoorbeeld de horeca kan heel relevant zijn als je daar hebt geleerd om snel contact te maken, goed te luisteren en commercieel te denken.

Daarnaast is het mooi als je:

  • interesse hebt in techniek en duurzaamheid;

  • ervaring hebt met adviserende gesprekken of videocalls;

  • eerder met een CRM-systeem hebt gewerkt;

  • naast Nederlands ook goed Engels spreekt.

Technische kennis over warmtepompen verwachten we niet vanaf dag één. We leren je wat je moet weten. Wel verwachten we dat je nieuwsgierig bent en nieuwe informatie snel oppakt.

Praktisch

Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands.

De functie is mogelijk vanaf 24 tot 40 uur per week.

We werken deels vanuit huis en deels samen op kantoor. Werk je op onze vaste kantoordagen maandag, woensdag en vrijdag, dan verwachten we dat je op die dagen vanuit ons kantoor in Den Haag werkt.

Waarom DeWarmte?

DeWarmte is een scale-up, dus je komt niet terecht in een omgeving waar alles al jarenlang vastligt. We groeien, leren en verbeteren continu.

Dat betekent dat we zoeken naar iemand die niet alleen zijn of haar gesprekken afwerkt, maar ook ziet wat beter kan. Merk je dat klanten steeds tegen hetzelfde probleem aanlopen? Dan horen we dat graag. Zie je een slimmere manier om leads op te volgen? Kom ermee.

Uiteindelijk hebben we één gezamenlijk doel: zoveel mogelijk huishoudens helpen om de overstap naar duurzaam verwarmen te maken. En ieder goed klantgesprek brengt ons daar een stap dichterbij.

title: Full Stack Engineer, Frontend-focused (Next.js + Django)

Make switching to a heat pump simple, clear and trustworthy—from first discovery to installation and beyond.

  • Build, test and deploy customer-facing features in Next.js and React, with supporting Django and API changes where needed.

  • Keep improving conversion, speed and usability based on data and customer feedback.

  • Improve the flows customers use after installation, from questions and service requests to documents and updates.

  • Connect the web application with the workflows used by our sales, planning, installation and service teams.

  • Remove manual work and friction for customers and colleagues alike.

Strengthen the frontend platform

  • Improve frontend architecture, reusable components, performance, accessibility and SEO.

  • Improve automated frontend testing, CI/CD, monitoring and safe release practices.

  • Work with the Backend Developer to shape clear APIs and interfaces between the web application, apps and external systems.

  • Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation and repeatable engineering practices.

  • Review code and share knowledge by default.

Build with AI

  • Use AI tools to support design, coding, testing, reviews and documentation.

  • Help the team improve its AI workflows, shared context and quality checks.

  • Try new tools, keep what works and share what you learn.

  • Hold AI-assisted code to the same standards as any other production code.

Work across the company

This role reaches beyond the software team. You'll work with marketing, sales, planning, installation, service and product development to solve today's customer and operational issues without compromising the platform for tomorrow.

What success looks like

In your first few months

  • You understand the customer journey end to end, the frontend architecture and where it connects to our backend.

  • You can independently ship frontend features and make focused Django or API changes when needed, using the team's review and release practices.

  • You've identified the biggest usability issues and frontend technical risks in the journey, and helped prioritise them.

As the role develops

  • New frontend features ship predictably, safely and with good test coverage.

  • More visitors become customers, and customers rarely need to contact us to know where they stand.

  • You take responsibility for the frontend architecture and significant parts of the customer journey.

  • The team uses AI tools confidently and responsibly in its day-to-day work.

Who we're looking for

  • Strong TypeScript and React skills, plus experience with Next.js; familiarity with the Pages Router is useful.

  • Strong HTML and CSS fundamentals, with a good eye for responsive design, accessibility and interaction details.

  • Experience building customer-facing flows such as onboarding, configurators, quotes, checkout or self-service portals.

  • A track record of taking functionality from design through implementation, testing and deployment to real-world use.

Dat betekent goed advies, duidelijke communicatie, ondersteuning en aandacht bij elke stap.

Jouw bijdrage aan onze missie

Als Customer Experience Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en consistentie van de totale customer experience. Van digitale tot persoonlijke interacties: jij bewaakt de kwaliteit van alle processen die onze customer journey direct raken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die over de hele organisatie heen kijkt, ontdekt waar het beter kan en ervoor zorgt dat verbeteringen ook daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd.

Jij bent binnen DeWarmte de functionele eigenaar van Customer Experience. Je bepaalt samen met de organisatie wat onze CX-standaard is, brengt systematisch in kaart waar we daar niet aan voldoen en zorgt dat de belangrijkste verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd. Je werkt hiervoor dwars door Marketing, Sales, Operations, Installation, Support & Service en Software heen.

Je hoeft daarbij niet ieder project zelf uit te voeren. Een verbetering kan bij jou liggen, bij een ‘Head of’ of bij iemand anders in de organisatie. Wat wél bij jou blijft liggen, is de accountability voor het realiseren van de verbetering: je zorgt voor een duidelijke eigenaar, doelstelling, deadlines en een kwaliteitsstandaard. Daarnaast bewaak je de voortgang en het resultaat. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de CEO. Vanuit die positie werk je organisatiebreed en krijg je het mandaat om CX-verbeteringen over teams heen aan te jagen. Cross-functionele verbeterprojecten die over meerdere teams heen lopen, leid je in principe zelf.

Dat vraagt senioriteit. Je moet een Head kunnen challengen wanneer de customer experience niet goed genoeg is, maar net zo makkelijk zelf een review beantwoorden, een geautomatiseerde e-mail herschrijven of een (kleiner) verbeterproject van A tot Z uitvoeren.

 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert en verbetert onze bestaande customer journey en bijbehorende process maps en gebruikt deze om continu te identificeren waar de customer experience beter kan.

  • Je ontwikkelt samen met de verschillende teams onze CX-standaarden voor de belangrijkste customer touchpoints, bewaakt deze en spreekt teams erop aan wanneer de ervaring daar niet aan voldoet.

  • Je gebruikt reviews, klachten, customer feedback en operationele data om structurele problemen en verbeterkansen te identificeren en te prioriteren.

  • Je vertaalt deze inzichten naar een duidelijke, geprioriteerde CX-improvement roadmap.

  • Je initieert verbeterprojecten binnen Marketing, Sales, Operations, Installation, Support & Service, Software en andere teams en zorgt voor een duidelijke eigenaar, doelstelling, deadlines en kwaliteitsstandaard.

  • Je bewaakt de voortgang en het resultaat van deze verbeterprojecten en zorgt dat afgesproken verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd.

  • Cross-functionele CX-projecten die over meerdere teams heen lopen, leid je in principe zelf van analyse tot implementatie.

  • Je meet na implementatie of verbeteringen daadwerkelijk het gewenste effect op de customer experience hebben gehad.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onze aanpak rondom Google Reviews en Trustpilot: je zorgt dat reviews snel en goed worden beantwoord, dat problemen bij de juiste eigenaar terechtkomen en dat noodzakelijke opvolging snel plaatsvindt.

Hoe ziet succes eruit?

Makkelijk van het gas af. Dat moet de ervaring van onze klanten zijn gedurende de hele customer journey. Na de belangrijkste onderdelen van deze journey vragen we onze klanten actief om feedback. De scores op deze customer feedback vormen belangrijke KPI’s voor deze rol en laten zien waar de ervaring goed is en waar deze beter moet.

Onze Google- en Trustpilot-scores zijn belangrijke overkoepelende KPI’s voor de totale customer experience. Het doel is daarbij niet alleen om scores te verbeteren, maar vooral om de onderliggende customer experience structureel beter te maken.

Daarom kijken we ook naar hoe snel en goed customer feedback en reviews worden opgevolgd, hoeveel structurele customer pain points we oplossen en hoe snel en met welke kwaliteit de belangrijkste CX-improvement projecten worden gerealiseerd.

 

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken iemand die continu ziet hoe het beter kan en vervolgens zorgt dat het ook beter wordt. Je combineert een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard en sterk analytisch vermogen met executiekracht. Je kunt diep de details induiken, maar ook bepalen waar de grootste impact ligt en op senior niveau door de hele organisatie verbeteringen realiseren.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

The Role

Great technology loses to good technology that reaches the customer first. You'll hire the people who make sure ours gets there, and the people who keep the company running while it scales.

This seat owns hiring for Mission and defense business development, business operations, finance and accounting, real estate, and marketing. The searches are fewer, but every one of them matters. Many are the first hire in a function: the finance leader who takes us into our next stage, the real estate lead who helps stand up a new facility, the capture and program people who put our aircraft and software in front of the warfighter. We treat them like the high-stakes searches they are.


The Work

  • Own full-cycle hiring across Mission, business operations, finance and accounting, real estate, and marketing

  • Recruit defense BD, capture, program, and mission roles with real credibility, and know where those people come from: primes, defense tech startups, the Pentagon, and the operational force

  • Run senior and first-of-kind searches like an executive search partner: map the market, calibrate early, and close hard

  • Be the advisor first-time hiring managers didn't know they needed. Challenge the role when it's wrong and help define what great looks like

  • Build relationships with future leaders before we need them, so the next search starts warm

  • Convince exceptional people who never pictured themselves in defense that this is the most important work they'll ever do

You

  • Have [5+] years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including senior or executive-level searches

  • Have recruited in or around defense, government, or national security, and know the difference between BD, capture, and program management

  • Have closed candidates who had other options, including at the leadership level

  • Earn hiring managers' trust by telling them the truth about the market, even when it's not what they want to hear

  • Love range. A controller, a head of marketing, and a defense BD lead in the same week sounds like a good week to you

Bonus Points

  • Executive search or agency background paired with in-house startup experience

  • A network in the defense BD, capture, or military community

  • Experience hiring finance, real estate, or marketing leaders at a scaling company

  • Military service or experience recruiting veterans and transitioning service members

Why This Seat

You'll build the teams that take our technology to the fight, and the teams that keep us standing while we grow.


How We Recruit

We're a small recruiting team building a defense company that has to win. Here's how we operate, and we hire recruiters who already work this way.

The Standard. We know the work deeply. We are not generalists hiding behind job descriptions; we study the engineering, the domain, and the landscape until we can hold a real conversation with a practitioner. Every candidate who talks to us should call it the best recruiting experience of their career, and we each bring our own personality to get there. High touch, never scripted.

How We Think. One foot old school, one foot forward: we're obsessive about the fundamentals of recruiting and restless about finding better ways to do it. We play the long game and hire for what someone will do in two and five years, not just next quarter. And we'd rather define the industry standard than follow it.

How We Operate. Mission first, always. Speed is a competitive weapon, and we use it. Quality over comfort: we'll have the harder conversation with a hiring manager before we'll make the easy hire.

If that reads like a description of how you already work, we want to talk.

description:

Read this part first

Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.

We are not going to make you wait.

What we do

We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.

That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.

The job

You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.

Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.

What you get here that you did not get there

  • Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome

  • Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form

  • The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first

  • Someone who runs sourcing searches themselves every day and will look at your search strings with you

  • A skill set at the end of two years that maybe a few hundred people in the country have

What we need from you

  • 1+ years of sourcing or recruiting, most of it in software engineering

  • A hire you are proud of, one nobody else was going to find, and the ability to walk us through exactly how you found them

  • A high tolerance for silence, because most of your outreach will go unanswered and the job is making the next message better anyway

  • Real curiosity about how aircraft get built, or at least the honesty to say you find it interesting and want in

  • Writing that sounds like a person, since your entire work product is text a stranger decides to open or delete

  • Clean data habits, because our reporting goes to the CEO and it needs to be right

What we do not need

Ten years of experience. A recruiting pedigree. A degree in anything specific. Permission from your current manager to be good at this.

The honest version

The pace is uncomfortable. You will be asked to fill roles you do not understand yet, and the answer will usually be to go learn them rather than to wait for a briefing.

If you want a clear ladder and a quiet quarter, this is the wrong job. If you have been waiting for someone to hand you something real, this is the shot.

description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Generalist (Workshops)
description:
Deliver workshops that help exceptional people pursue high-impact work in AI safety, biosecurity, and policy.

Depending on experience, we consider candidates for the Generalist (Workshops) or Senior Generalist (Workshops) version of this role.

We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis.


About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

  • Generator Residency: In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from OpenAI, AI Futures Project, METR, and more.

  • Global Challenges Project: A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley.

  • Pathfinder Fellowship: Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work.

We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem.

 

The Role

The Global Challenges Project (GCP) runs three-day residential workshops that help talented individuals explore careers in AI safety and biosecurity. Over the past few years, GCP has run dozens of workshops for 400+ students, mostly in Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley. GCP has a long and successful track record and became part of Kairos in early 2026.

We’re now expanding GCP into a full portfolio of workshops serving different audiences and career stages, with the ambition of becoming the leading fieldbuilding workshop organizer in AI safety and biosecurity. This means building new programs, new formats, and the systems to deliver reliably at scale.

We’re looking for a generalist to help deliver our workshops. You’ll own the operational backbone of our events, including outreach, venues, travel, admissions logistics, guest coordination, inventory, and the systems that hold it all together. You’ll also attend some of our workshops and help run them in person.

This job requires agency as you’ll own the delivery of many key aspects of our workshops. You’ll need to spot problems before they happen, and improve our strategy and systems after every event. This role offers excellent opportunities for progression, and your scope and responsibility will grow with our portfolio.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own operational workstreams end to end. For each workshop, you’ll take responsibility for workstreams such as outreach, venue search and contracting, catering and dietary needs, participant and guest travel, inventory and materials, and on-site logistics.

  • Run admissions and participant operations. You’ll build application and RSVP forms, help coordinate selection processes, send decisions, run onboarding communications, and make sure every participant arrives informed and prepared.

  • Coordinate guests. High-quality guests are central to our workshops’ impact. You’ll track invitations, chase confirmations, and act as a point of contact so guests have a smooth experience from first email to follow-up.

  • Deliver workshops in person. You’ll travel to some of our workshops (predominantly in the UK and US) and help run them on the ground.

  • Build systems that scale. We run our events on Notion, Airtable, Linear, and a growing set of automations and custom code. You’ll help design and improve these systems and turn what we learn at each event into better playbooks and templates.

  • Help shape our workshops strategy. You’ll work across GCP, OASIS, and our new workshop programs, and everyone on the team has a say in how Kairos’s events develop.

  • Contribute to Kairos more broadly. As capacity allows, you’ll pitch in on our other programs like SPAR and Pathfinder, build relationships across the AI safety ecosystem, and ship small cross-team projects.

 

Who You Are

  • An operations generalist with events experience. You’ve delivered events such as workshops, conferences, or retreats, or you’ve done demanding operational work and can show you’d thrive doing it for in-person events.

  • Highly organized. You’ll juggle multiple workstreams across several workshops at once, each with its own deadlines. You have strong systems for keeping everything on track, and details don’t slip past you.

  • High agency. You spot problems early and fix them without waiting to be asked, and you adapt when plans change on the day.

  • A high quality bar. You check your own work before handing it over, and you care about getting the small things right because they’re important to the attendees’ experience.

  • Good with people, and energized by workshops. Attending three-day residential events is part of this role. You’ll need the energy to engage warmly with participants and guests while keeping the event running smoothly.

  • Mission-aligned. You care deeply about how the development of advanced AI and biotechnology plays out, and you believe workshops can be a highly effective way to help talented people enter these fields. Familiarity with the AI safety ecosystem is a plus, but not required.

 

Why Work With Us

  • You’ll work toward reducing risks from advanced AI and biotechnology, two of the most important challenges of our time. Both fields need far more talented people than they have, and our workshops move promising people into careers working on them. The quality of our delivery is a big part of that impact.

  • You’ll own your workstreams end to end, and you’ll see the results firsthand at every workshop.

  • You’ll build on GCP’s strong brand, excellent reputation, and long track record, and help us grow into the leading workshop organizer in the space.

  • You’ll work closely with high-profile guests across AI safety and biorisk, and develop a strong professional network.

  • We’re building a world-class team, so you’ll be in good company. Work alongside people who’ve come to Kairos from METR, Coefficient Giving, Rethink Priorities, the UK AI Security Institute, and CEA who share your commitment to impact.

 

What We Offer

  • Salary: $105,000–$145,000 (baseline), $130,000–$180,000 (supported hubs, like London, DC, Boston, and NYC), or $145,000–$200,000 (San Francisco Bay Area), depending on experience, with potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates

  • Location: This is a remote role. We provide access to office space in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, with optional coworking elsewhere. If you work from an AI safety office in one of these cities, we cover food, lunches, and office expenses. If you work from home, we cover home office expenses.

  • Benefits: Flexible working hours, highly competitive health insurance, dental and vision coverage, generous vacation policy, and professional development budget

  • Team retreats: We host all-team retreats three times a year to connect in person, collaborate, and build team culture.

  • Travel: Work-related travel and expenses covered.

 

Logistics

  • This is a remote role, with travel roughly 8 to 12 times a year (typically 3 to 6 days at a time) for workshops, conferences, and events, predominantly in the UK and US.

  • We’re a remote-first organization, but because much of our workshop work happens on UK time, we have a preference for candidates within five hours of UK time. Our current team spans GMT-8 to GMT+1, and we’ll gladly consider exceptional candidates elsewhere, including in the US.

title: General Manager (m/w/d) - Fitness & Lifestyle Brand
description:
Managing Director (m/w/d) - Fitness & Lifestyle Brand

Location: Köln

Start: Ab sofort

Setup: Vollzeit (on-site)

THE BRAND & THE OPPORTUNITY

Du baust gemeinsam mit uns eine neue Fitness-Marke im Segment Mid Cost - High Value auf.

Die Vision: „Der neue Hotspot in der City für Workout, Recovery, Co-Working und Socializing.“

Kraft, Cardio und Functional, Live-Kurse, Sauna und Recovery, Bar und Lounge sowie eine ruhige Co-Working Zone, alles unter einem Dach - zu einem erschwinglichen Preis deutlich unter Premium-Clubs.

Unsere Clubs sollen auf ehemaligen Retail-Flächen entstehen, in 1A-Innenstadtlagen mit langfristig gesicherten Mietverträgen. Wir starten in Westdeutschland in der Region Köln, Essen, Frankfurt und expandieren dann.

Wir arbeiten mit unternehmerischem Anspruch: kleines Team, kurze Wege, jeder Standort muss sich selbst tragen. Der erste Club ist der Beweis für das Konzept, und jeder weitere wird durch den Erfolg des vorherigen verdient.

Für dich heißt das: Du bist ab Sekunde 1 dabei und gestaltest vom Namen über das Konzept bis hin zur Location alles von Grund auf mit. Kein Einstieg in einen bestehenden Betrieb, sondern die Chance, eine Marke von Null an aufzubauen, das Modell in allen Details zu gestalten und volle Verantwortung für das Ergebnis zu übernehmen.

THE ROLE & YOUR ROADMAP

Als Managing Director verantwortest du den kompletten Aufbau der Marke - von den ersten Entwürfen auf dem Reißbrett bis hin zur Multi-Site-Skalierung.

  • Phase 1 - Konzept schärfen: Du bringst das Angebot, das Flächenprogramm, die Pricing-Strategie und den Brand-Auftritt gemeinsam mit den Gesellschaftern zur Marktreife.

  • Phase 2 - Ersten Club eröffnen: Du steuerst den Ausbau vor Ort, baust dein Kernteam auf, drehst den Pre-Opening-Sales auf Anschlag und bringst den ersten Flagship-Standort ans Netz.

  • Phase 3 - Proof of Concept: Du erreichst mit dem Club die geplanten Mitglieder- und Ergebniszahlen (P&L) und machst aus dem Piloten ein hocheffizientes, wiederholbares Modell.

  • Phase 4 - Skalieren: Du eröffnest weitere Standorte in Deutschland und baust die Organisation auf, die dieses Wachstum trägt.


YOUR IMPACT (DIE ERSTEN 12 MONATE)

Du bist von Tag 1 an am Start und bringst den ersten Standort ans Netz:

  • Konzept zur Marktreife bringen: Zusammen mit der Projektleitung feilst du an Angebot, Flächenaufteilung, Preisen und Marke.

  • Ausbau steuern: Du betreust den Aus- und Umbau des ersten Standorts und behältst Zeit- und Kostenrahmen fest im Griff.

  • Kernteam aufbauen: Du rekrutierst Club-Leitung, Trainer sowie Servicepersonal und prägst von Anfang an Kultur und Standards.

  • Pre-Sales & Markteintritt verantworten: Du treibst die Mitgliedergewinnung vor der Eröffnung, machst lokales Marketing und schließt Deals mit Firmenkunden sowie Aggregatoren (z. B. Urban Sports Club, EGYM Wellpass).

  • Prozesse & Tech aufsetzen: Du richtest Mitgliederverwaltung, Zugangssysteme, App und Reporting ein.

  • Ersten Club eröffnen: Du begleitest das Grand Opening und führst den Standort erfolgreich in den Live-Betrieb.

YOUR PROFILE

Du brennst selbst für Fitness und Lifestyle, denkst wie ein Unternehmer und hast den Biss, etwas Eigenes aufzubauen? Dann bist du genau die richtige Person!

  • Track Record: Du hast Führungserfahrung in der Fitnessbranche (z. B. als Area Manager, Cluster Manager oder Regional Director), idealerweise mit P&L Verantwortung.

  • Neueröffnungs-Erfahrung: Du hast schon eine Neueröffnung von A bis Z selbst verantwortet oder mitgestaltet (Ausbau, Teamaufbau, Pre-Sales).

  • Business Mindset: Du hast Kaufmännisches Denken, Data-Drive und souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Gesellschaftern, Vermietern und Partnern.

  • Hands-on & Drive: Du packst überall mit an, bis du zufrieden bist. Danach führst du ein wachsendes Team.

  • Setup: Vollzeit, Wohnsitz oder Relocation in die Startregion Köln, Essen oder Frankfurt. Reisebereitschaft zu den Standorten und Deutsch C2.

Das wäre ein Plus: Vorerfahrung aus Hospitality, Wellness oder Gastronomie, Erfahrung im Markenaufbau sowie ein starkes Netzwerk in der Fitnessbranche.

WHY US

  • Maximale Gestaltungsfreiheit: Die seltene Chance, eine komplett neue Marke von der ersten Skizze an zu ownen.

  • High-Speed & Support: Kurze Entscheidungswege und direkter Austausch mit den Gesellschaftern. Du entscheidest alles mit!

  • Executive Package: Attraktive Vergütung bestehend aus Fixgehalt, transparentem Bonus und einem Firmenwagen.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform & Infrastructure (f/m/d)
description:
The product you will work on

The HOLOPLOT Matrix Array is a new type of sound system built around precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - grounded in physics and implemented through a combination of custom hardware and purpose-built software. HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment. 


Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.


The ideal candidate is

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who builds the platform our sound systems run on, and who takes responsibility for how it behaves in production.


This is a software engineering role first. You will spend your time writing software, either with your own team or embedded with one of the other HOLOPLOT teams: services, controllers, agents, and tooling that provision, configure, observe, and update our systems. Our infrastructure is defined as code and evolves through the same review and release process as the rest of our software. You design the operational side, you build it, and you are on call when it misbehaves in the field.


Your role and responsibilities

You will join the team that owns the platform underneath our installations and connected services, working alongside backend, embedded, and frontend engineers who are organized in cross-functional product teams.


Build the platform

  • Architect and implement services to provision, configure, and manage server fleets across AWS and local clusters.

  • Create control-plane logic for venue systems to ensure consistency, health monitoring, rollout management, and recovery, even during uplink disruptions.

  • Establish end-to-end provisioning workflows for embedded Linux hardware, spanning from initial manufacturing to customer deployment.

  • Enhance update processes to streamline software deployments for active customer installations.

  • Develop APIs and developer tooling that empower engineering teams to independently deploy, observe, and troubleshoot their services.

  • Embed telemetry capabilities into the platform to facilitate remote diagnosis of venue system behavior

  • .

Run what you build

  • Own the AWS infrastructure behind our connected services: remote access, access control, telemetry ingestion, remote backup, secret management, and monitoring. All of it is infrastructure as code.

  • Operate and evolve the on-premises Kubernetes footprint at venues, including air-gapped and intermittently connected installations.

  • Monitor large environments, investigate problems across the software/hardware boundary, and turn each incident into a fix in the code.

  • Be part of a compensated on-call rotation


Set the technical direction

  • Advise and collaborate with product teams on building distributed systems that are scalable, secure, and observable, and review their designs with production reality in mind.

  • Research and introduce tools and technologies where they measurably improve how we build and operate.

  • Contribute back to the open-source projects we depend on, through issues and fixes.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Several years of professional software engineering experience, most of it spent designing and shipping production systems.

  • Fluency in software engineering as a craft: concurrency, error handling, testing, and designing APIs that other teams build on.

  • Working knowledge of the Kubernetes control plane and the operator/controller pattern, including how clusters behave when they are unhealthy.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, and a firm belief in infrastructure as code. Terraform and Ansible are what we use today.

  • Comfort across several languages, and the ability to pick up a new one when the problem calls for it. Our platform work is mostly Go and Python, with Rust and C++ elsewhere in the stack.

  • Experience building distributed systems, and a clear understanding of how they fail: partitions, partial rollouts, clock skew, retries, and reconciliation.

  • A good sense for software architecture and maintainability, and the habit of writing code that colleagues can pick up and change.

  • A strong command of Linux, scripting, and automation.

  • Experience instrumenting software for telemetry and using it to answer real questions about running systems.

  • Good judgment about what to automate and what to leave alone.

  • Strong communication skills in English. You can explain a design or a failure clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists.

  • Willingness to take part in compensated on-call and weekend work when installations need it.

  • A can-do mentality, an eye for detail, and the courage to take on problems outside your comfort zone.

  • Experience in using AI for engineering.


Nice to haves

  • Experience with NATS, Prometheus/Thanos, or PostgreSQL in production.

  • Experience with air-gapped or intermittently connected installations.

  • Experience running Kubernetes in production, not only deploying to it.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, device fleet management, or IoT security.

  • Networking depth: multicast at scale, WireGuard, BGP, IPv6.

  • Experience in the audio, broadcast, or live events industry.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure projects


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching.

title: Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d)
description:
Who we are and what you’ll do

HOLOPLOT is seeking a decisive, technically strong and business-oriented Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), to lead our 20-person software engineering organization, drive cross-functional delivery, and own the long-term software architecture for our high-performance audio products.

Working closely with engineering leads who focus on deep technical problem-solving and team mentorship, this role leads overall software delivery, strategic technical vision, and cross-departmental alignment.


Main objectives of the role

As Senior Director Software Engineering (f/m/d), you will take full technical ownership of the end-to-end delivery of HOLOPLOT’s software ecosystem, spanning embedded and distributed Linux systems, audio DSP, 3D/GPU, C++, Rust and web-based front-end applications, Kubernetes cluster and cloud infrastructure. You will act as the operational bridge between software engineering, hardware development, research, product, customer success teams, and key enterprise clients. You will work closely with the Director of Product for Software as well as the CPO, and report to the CTO.


Your role and responsibilities

  • Strategic Software Vision & Architecture: Own and drive the strategic vision for the technical backbone of the HOLOPLOT product ecosystem. Proactively identify architectural risks and ensure performance and scalability across embedded hardware, audio processing platforms, and user interfaces.

  • Execution & High-Stakes Delivery: Take full accountability for software delivery timeliness, quality, and reliability. Proactively lead critical client-facing missions, OS rollouts, and on-site integration handovers (e.g., venue acceptance testing and integration protocols), including regular international travel

  • High-Performing Mission-Driven Teams: Attract, grow, and retain strong engineering talent to build highly successful, cross-functional product development teams. Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, agency, and innovation that drives high employee engagement, productivity, and strong outcomes for our customers.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive seamless collaboration between Software, Research, Customer Success, Product Management, and external technical partners (such as client IT security and external system integrators). Eliminate inter-departmental friction and establish clear integration pathways.

  • Business-First Leadership: Together with Product, align software priorities and architecture directly with HOLOPLOT’s strategic and commercial objectives. Make decisive, well-reasoned trade-offs under pressure while optimizing engineering output for maximum company value.

  • Operational Leadership & Partnering: Partner with dedicated Engineering Managers and Tech Leads who oversee team culture, individual mentoring, and deeply technical topics. Foster a culture of engineering excellence, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Focus your impact on operational discipline, accountability, and clear departmental direction.

  • AI Strategy & Development Workflows: Define and execute HOLOPLOT's AI strategy for software development. Integrate AI-assisted engineering tools, automated workflows, and emerging AI technologies into the software development life cycle to elevate team productivity and explore modern product capabilities. 

  • Platform, Quality & Operational Excellence: Ensure high standards of quality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability across all software solutions. Identify, assess, and mitigate technological risks, including technical debt and platform lifecycle challenges. Define and improve engineering processes, development standards, and tooling to enable predictable, high-quality delivery.

  • Security, Compliance & Risk Management: Drive HOLOPLOT’s technology security strategy, including cybersecurity, data protection, and secure-by-design principles. Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards, validation/certifications, and regulatory requirements. Ensure systems are resilient, reliable, and fit for production and customer use.


What you need to succeed in this role

  • Engineering Leadership: Extensive experience managing software teams of significant size (15-30+ engineers) in complex, multi-disciplinary technology environments

  • Deep-Tech Literacy: Comfortable navigating a highly heterogeneous tech stack encompassing Low-Level/Embedded C++ & Rust, Audio DSP, 3D/GPU rendering, Linux, Kubernetes, NATS, gRPC, JUCE, CI/CD and Web services.

  • Track Record of Ownership: Proven experience driving complex hardware-software product rollouts and managing high-stakes client or partner integrations end-to-end.

  • Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Strong diplomacy and technical communication skills, with a track record of bridging engineering teams with business, product, research, and client stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic Decision-Making: Ability to operate with high clarity and a steady hand in fast-paced environments, prioritizing long-term product stability over short-term friction.

  • AI-Driven Development Strategy: Demonstrated experience establishing AI-development strategies and driving the practical adoption of AI-assisted software development, LLM tooling, or automated engineering workflows.

  • Audio Software and Hardware Products: Experience with the Pro Audio and Music Technology product space, as both developer and user.


We offer you

At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with the scope and impact of this leadership role, along with perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme.

You'll join an international, open-minded team and work directly with our C-level, engineering and product leads, as well as cross-functional stakeholders in customer success, research, and operations. You'll shape the strategic direction of our software architecture, own high-stakes delivery for cutting-edge audio technology, and drive the AI-assisted development strategy for a 20-person software engineering team, with the autonomy and accountability that comes with a senior leadership mandate.

title: AI Trainers Network - Arabic
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in Germany.

Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence.
In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems.
Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.
Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.
Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms.
This is a talent network opportunity rather than an active job opening, meaning you will be contacted when a suitable project becomes available.
Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability.


Accountabilities

As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include:

  • Annotating and labeling text, images, or audio to help train and improve AI models.

  • Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness.

  • Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs).

  • Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness.

  • Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs.

  • Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail.

  • Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems.

  • Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability.

    • Requirements

    We are looking for detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable contributors who are interested in language, technology, and the development of AI systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Arabic language skills with the ability to evaluate information critically and work independently in a digital environment.

    • Native or near-native fluency in Arabic, with a strong understanding of grammar, vocabulary, and linguistic nuances.

    • Current residence in Poland for this opportunity.

    • Good English proficiency to understand project instructions and communicate effectively.

    • Comfort using digital tools, online platforms, and web-based applications.

    • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify linguistic, factual, and contextual inconsistencies.

    • Good analytical and critical-thinking skills, particularly when evaluating content for accuracy and relevance.

    • Cultural awareness and an understanding of Arabic-speaking communities, communication styles, and regional language variations.

    • Ability to follow detailed guidelines, work independently, and deliver consistent, high-quality results.

    • Curiosity about artificial intelligence, language technologies, and how human feedback can improve AI systems.

    • Flexibility to participate in projects of varying durations and complexity, depending on your availability.

      • Previous experience in data annotation, content evaluation, translation, linguistics, prompt engineering, or AI training may be helpful, but project-specific requirements will vary.

      Benefits

      • Flexible, remote work: Contribute to suitable projects from your preferred working environment, subject to individual project requirements.

      • Control over your availability: Choose whether to participate when a project matches your schedule and interests.

      • Project-based opportunities: Access assignments that may last from a few days to several weeks, depending on scope and demand.

      • Transparent compensation: Receive project-specific details about payment, tasks, and timelines before deciding whether to participate.

      • Practical AI experience: Develop your understanding of AI training, data annotation, language evaluation, and large language models.

      • Meaningful contribution: Help build more accurate, inclusive, and culturally aware AI technologies.

      • Global contributor community: Become part of an international network of people contributing their linguistic and cultural expertise.

      • Opportunities to grow: Build relevant skills through exposure to different projects and evolving AI technologies.

title: AI Production Lead (m|w|d)
description:
WIR SIND WIETHE

Wiethe gehört zu den führenden Content-Produktionsunternehmen Europas und ist Marktführer in Deutschland. Für internationale Marken wie adidas, Y-3, Tchibo, C&A, FC Bayern München und Peek & Cloppenburg entwickeln und produzieren wir Content auf höchstem Qualitätsniveau.

Mit rund 250 Mitarbeitenden an unseren Standorten Bremen und Osnabrück produzieren wir jährlich über 5 Millionen Bilder, mehr als 20.000 Filme und mehrere Tausend AI Assets.

Unsere Kompetenz verbindet Fotografie, Film, Generative AI und CGI. Was uns besonders macht: Wir denken Content nicht in einzelnen Kampagnen, sondern in skalierbaren, technologisch gestützten Produktionsprozessen – mit höchsten Ansprüchen an Qualität, Effizienz und Konsistenz.

Generative AI ist ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Wachstumsstrategie. Wir investieren konsequent in neue Technologien, intelligente Workflows und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktionsmöglichkeiten.

Dafür suchen wir erfahrene Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Teams führen, Kunden begeistern und unser weiteres Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten.

DEINE ROLLE

Als AI Production Lead (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Führungsrolle in unserem wachsenden AI-Bereich.

Du verantwortest die Planung, Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung anspruchsvoller AI-Produktionen für führende internationale Marken. Dabei verbindest Du tiefgehende technologische Expertise mit ausgeprägtem Produktionsverständnis, wirtschaftlichem Denken und souveräner Mitarbeiter- und Kundenführung.

Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung und Umsetzung skalierbarer AI-Workflows, die auch bei hohen Produktionsvolumina höchste Qualitätsstandards, Effizienz und verlässliche Ergebnisse sicherstellen.

Du bist technologischer Experte, fachlicher Lead, Sparringspartner unserer Kunden und treibende Kraft bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer AI-Produktion.

DEINE AUFGABEN

title: Cyber Security Engineer - Infrastructure & AI Platform Security (w/m/d)
description:
Über IONOS

Bei IONOS verwalten wir nicht nur Server, wir prägen mit unseren Lösungen die digitale Zukunft für über 6,2 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden weltweit. Als Europas führender Hosting-Anbieter und Pionier für unabhängige Cloud-Lösungen bauen wir eine Infrastruktur der nächsten Generation: von souveränen Cloud-Architekturen und hochperformanten GPU-Clustern bis hin zu integrierten KI-Automatisierungstools.

Was uns antreibt: Digitale Entscheidungsfreiheit für Europa und echter Impact für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU) sowie Großunternehmen. Wir arbeiten in agilen Teams, setzen auf transparente Strukturen und glauben daran, dass Exzellenz und Innovation nur mit echtem Teamgeist entstehen.

Bereit für Deinen nächsten Schritt? Werde ein Teil von IONOS und wachse mit uns.

Beide Hälften dieser Rolle drehen sich um dieselbe grundlegende Frage: Welche Systeme können unsere empfindlichste Infrastruktur erreichen und unter welchen Kontrollen. Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer providerseitigen Infrastrukturschicht und bist Fachexperte (m/w/d) für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen und -Agenten. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass diese in einem sicheren, verwalteten und auditierbaren Zustand laufen, anstatt sich schleichend als neue Klasse von privilegierten Zugriffen anzuhäufen.

Dies ist eine praxisnahe Expertenrolle. Du setzt Standards, prüfst Designs auf Herz und Nieren und arbeitest direkt mit Plattform- und Engineering-Teams über all unsere Marken hinweg zusammen, um diese umzusetzen.

Aufgabenbereich

Infrastruktursicherheit

  • Definieren und Pflegen von Sicherheitsarchitektur-Standards und Härtungs-Baselines für providerseitige Infrastruktur: Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Control Planes und Bereitstellungssysteme, DNS, Mail-Infrastruktur sowie Backup- und Wiederherstellungssysteme.
  • Bewerten und Stärken der Mandantenisolierung über Shared-Hosting-, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Schichten hinweg sowie Treiben von Behebungsmaßnahmen mit den verantwortlichen Plattform-Teams.
  • Überprüfen von Infrastruktur-Designs und wesentlichen Änderungen auf Sicherheitsauswirkungen sowie Agieren als Eskalationsinstanz für Fragen zur Infrastruktursicherheit aus Plattform-, Cloud- und Marken-Engineering-Teams.
  • Reduzieren des Blast Radius auf den wichtigsten Pfaden: privilegierter Zugriff auf kundenorientierte Infrastruktur, administrative Segmentierung, Umgang mit Secrets und Wiederherstellungsintegrität — übersetzt in umsetzbare markenspezifische Implementierungspläne für unsere heterogenen Plattformen.
  • Unterstützen von Cyber Defense, Vulnerability Management und IT-Notfallmanagement mit Infrastruktur-Expertise bei Vorfällen und der Nachbereitung/Härtung.

Interne KI-Plattform- und Agentensicherheit

  • Verantwortung für die Sicherheitsarchitektur und Baseline-Standards für die intern betriebenen KI-Plattformen: Modell-Gateways und self-hosted Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks, Assistenten-Integrationen, Konnektoren und Retrieval-Pipelines über interne Daten.
  • Definieren und Durchsetzen, wie Agenten identifiziert, authentifiziert und autorisiert werden: Umgang mit nicht-menschlichen Identitäten, Credential- und Token-Management, Least-Privilege-Zugriff auf Tools und Systeme sowie Festlegung, wo autonomes Handeln ein Human-in-the-Loop erfordert.
  • Festlegen, welche Daten interne KI-Systeme aufrufen und indexieren dürfen, sowie Sicherstellen, dass Agentenaktivitäten protokolliert, zuordenbar und überprüfbar sind — entsprechend den Anforderungen unserer regulatorischen Verpflichtungen und Zertifizierungen.
  • Durchführen von Pre-Deployment-Sicherheitsprüfungen für neue interne KI-Plattformen und Agenten-Anwendungsfälle im Einklang mit dem schnellen Tempo der Adaption sowie Überblicken von ungesicherter/unsanktionierter KI-Nutzung (Shadow AI).
  • Beraten der Sicherheitsfunktionen und internen Engineering-Teams bei der sicheren Einführung von KI, einschließlich der Schutzplanken (Guardrails), die eine vertretbare Einführung ermöglichen.

Qualifikationen

  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Infrastruktur- oder Plattform-Sicherheit, idealerweise bei einem Hosting-Anbieter, Cloud-Anbieter, Telekommunikationsunternehmen oder in einer vergleichbar großen Mandantenumgebung.
  • Tiefes praktisches Wissen über Linux, Virtualisierungs- und Container-Plattformen, Netzwerke und die Sicherheitseigenschaften von Mandanten-Infrastrukturen.
  • Starker Hintergrund im Bereich Identity & Access: Privileged Access, Maschinen- und Workload-Identitäten, Secrets Management, Autorisierungsmodelle und Infrastructure-as-Code-Sicherheit.
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Durchsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards in einer heterogenen, teils historisch gewachsenen Landschaft sowie bei der Akzeptanzgewinnung in Teams außerhalb der eigenen Führungslinie.
  • Praktische Kenntnisse im Aufbau und Betrieb von LLM- und Agenten-Systemen sowie der spezifischen Risiken: Prompt Injection durch unvertraute Daten, zu weit gefasste Tool-Zugriffe, Datenexposition durch Retrieval, unprotokolliertes autonomes Handeln, Modell- und Anbieterabhängigkeiten.
  • Fähigkeit, risikobasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und zu verteidigen — einschließlich des Blockierens von Deployments mit klarer Begründung — sowie technisches Risiko gegenüber nicht-technischen Stakeholdern verständlich zu erklären.
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutschkenntnisse sind aufgrund unseres regulatorischen Umfelds und des öffentlichen Sektors von starkem Vorteil.

Wünschenswert / Von Vorteil

  • Praktische Erfahrung beim Deployment oder der Absicherung interner KI-Plattformen, Agenten-Frameworks oder Tool-Calling-Integrationen in einer Produktionsumgebung.
  • Vertrautheit mit NIS2 / BSIG oder ISO 27001.
  • Hintergrund in DNS, E-Mail-Infrastruktur oder plattformnaher Missbrauchsbekämpfung (Abuse).
  • Erfahrung in einem Multimarken- oder Post-Acquisition-Umfeld, in dem dieselbe Control in verschiedenen Implementierungen umgesetzt werden muss.
  • Hintergrund in Security Engineering oder Softwareentwicklung (Automatisierung, Tooling, Scripting).

Wer zu uns passt

Jemand, der sich wohl damit fühlt, bei bestimmten Fragestellungen die/der einzige Expert*in im Raum zu sein, der lieber Ursachen behebt als nur Befunde zu dokumentieren, und der über Sicherheitsfunktionen und Plattform-Teams hinweg agieren kann. Du solltest echtes Interesse an KI-Systemen als Engineering-Artefakte mitbringen, nicht nur als Richtlinienthema — ein Großteil dieser Praxis entsteht gerade erst, und Du wirst unsere mitgestalten.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten durch Vertrauensarbeitszeit.
  • An einigen Standorten eine bezuschusste Kantine und verschiedene kostenfreie Getränke.
  • Moderne Büroflächen mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung.
  • Diverse Mitarbeiterrabatte für Aktivitäten und Produkte.
  • Mitarbeiterevents wie Sommer- und Winterfeiern, sowie Workshops.
  • Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote, wie Sport- und Gesundheitskurse.

Hinweis zur Bewerbung

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.
