Join us as Head of Video & Storytelling and build the video engine behind Qonto’s brand. You’ll report to Julie Regis, our Brand & Communications Director.
Today, most of our videos start as a one-off request and end after one shoot. Your job is to change that. Every shoot should become five or more finished videos. Our best series should become recognisable formats that people look for. Everything we publish on YouTube and LinkedIn should be something people remember and something search engines and AI assistants can find and quote.

➡️ What you’ll do
  • Decide what gets made. You’ll priorotise requests against the brand strategy, evaluate every month what we can output communicate limits to stakeholders.
  • Turn one shoot into many videos. You’ll run the system that makes this routine: dedicated editing and motion design, and tools for reframing, clipping, subtitling and AI voice localization. You’ll also rework our workflows with AI-assisted production.
  • Build series that belong to Qonto. Business Finance Academy, Product Drop and The Industry Numbers are the start. You’ll give each one a clear idea, a recognisable look and a fixed format, so our videos feel like Qonto in all six markets.
  • Raise the standard for scripts and copy. You’ll manage our copywriters, from scripts and hooks to captions and transcripts. You’ll decide when a script deserves real craft time and when a template does the job.
  • Work with outside producers. You’ll set up a trusted bench of studios and freelancers, with clear briefs and quality checks. You’ll also give each market one contact for planning and prioritising.
 ➡️  What we’re looking for
  • Real craft in video. You’ve made or shaped video work you’re proud of, and you can explain why it’s good. You keep that standard when time is short.
  • Experience managing creative people. You’ve led producers, editors or copywriters, ideally a team of around eight, and you can balance delivering work with building better tools and processes.
  • A track record with recurring formats. You’ve built series, characters or sets that audiences came back to, and you’ve kept them consistent across markets or languages.
  • A feel for both audiences. You know how to make a video people remember and how to make it easy for search engines and AI assistants to find and cite.
  • A clear head under pressure. You’re comfortable with numbers like lead times and capacity, and you can turn down a senior stakeholder with good reasons while keeping their trust.
 ➡️  What we can offer you
  • A team that’s ready for a new direction. Eight producers and copywriters, with a model to move from one-off requests to formats that build on each other.
  • Clear goals. Videos delivered within 30 days for time-sensitive launches, at least five finished videos per shoot, and a growing share of outside production. We’ll also track how often our flagship series are cited by AI assistants.
  • Two channels, six markets. YouTube in five markets, adapted locally, and LinkedIn run centrally. You’ll define how Qonto looks, sounds and feels in motion.
  • A voice in the Creative Factory. You’ll work alongside Brand Design and the other creative teams, and bring video’s craft standards to the whole group.

title: Fraud Manager - Data & IA (F/H)
description:
Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique.

C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 1,5 million de clients nous font confiance et près de 500 collaborateurs contribuent à notre développement dans 4 pays européens.

Ce que nous construisons

    • Younited Credit : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients.
    • Younited Pay : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires.
    • Younited Cashback : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking.
    • Younited Bank : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement.
Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité.

Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident

    • Make it simple : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence.
    • Act as an entrepreneur : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec.
    • Innovate or die : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître.
    • Faster is better : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat.
    • No limit : viser la lune tout en restant humble.
Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe.

Contexte 📄

Au sein de l’équipe Fraude, tu contribueras à la lutte contre la fraude externe à l’échelle du Groupe, présent en France, en Italie, en Espagne, au Portugal et en Allemagne.
 
Tu auras pour mission d’innover en mettant l’IA et la data au service de la détection et de la prévention de la fraude, de piloter la fraude par la donnée et de construire la lutte contre la fraude sur nos nouveaux produits.
 
Tu évolueras dans une organisation tech et en croissance, où la data et la technologie sont au cœur des décisions, en lien étroit avec les équipes Data, Tech, Produit et les équipes anti-fraude locales.
 

Missions 🚀

1) Définir et faire évoluer le système de détection de fraude
    • Développer un dispositif antifraude efficace en collaboration avec les Business Units, les équipes Produit et Data, en t’inspirant des meilleures pratiques du marché
    • Concevoir des parcours modulaires adaptés au niveau de risque de fraude, en optimisant l’équilibre entre friction et prévention
    • Anticiper les risques de fraude liés au lancement des nouvelles offres bancaires et des programmes de cashback dès leur conception

2) Innover grâce à l’intelligence artificielle et à la veille technologique
    • Suivre l’évolution des menaces et des technologies de lutte contre la fraude, identifier les solutions les plus prometteuses et formuler des recommandations
    • Tester de nouvelles approches et piloter des POC
    • Concevoir et déployer, avec les équipes Data, Tech et Produit, des outils intelligents pour automatiser la détection et faciliter le travail des analystes

3) Piloter la performance et harmoniser les pratiques à l’échelle du Groupe
    • Construire et harmoniser les indicateurs de suivi de la fraude, développer les tableaux de bord et le reporting à destination du management
    • Analyser les tendances pour anticiper les risques et proposer des plans d’action
    • Travailler avec les équipes anti-fraude des différents pays pour partager les bonnes pratiques, contribuer à l’harmonisation des processus et suivre les évolutions réglementaires européennes et locales liées à la fraude

À propos de toi 👇

    • Tu es diplômé.e d’un Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, de commerce, master data, statistiques ou risques),
    • Tu justifies de 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en lutte contre la fraude, gestion des risques, conformité ou data, idéalement en banque, cabinet de conseil ou fintech,
    • Tu maîtrises Excel et SQL, et tu as une bonne pratique des outils d’IA (machine learning, IA générative) et de data visualisation,
    • Tu connais bien les sujets de fraude au crédit et de  LCB-FT ; une expérience sur la fraude bancaire, aux moyens de paiement ou aux programmes de fidélité / cashback est un vrai plus,
    • Tu es curieux.se, tu as le goût de la veille et tu fais preuve de rigueur analytique,
    • Tu es autonome, de l’idée à la mise en production, et à l’aise dans un environnement international et transverse,
    • Tu parles anglais couramment, une autre langue européenne (italien, espagnol, portugais) constitue un atout.

Processus de recrutement 📅

    • Premier échange en visio avec Arthur, Talent Acquisition Manager, pour apprendre à se connaître et échanger autour du poste, de tes motivations et de ton adéquation avec les valeurs et la culture Younited (30 min)
    • Deuxième entretien en visio avec Baptiste, Responsable Risque Opérationnel, pour revenir sur ton parcours et échanger sur ta vision de la fraude et de l’IA (30 min)
    • Étude de cas data et fraude à restituer à Baptiste suivie d’un échange avec tes futur.e.s collègues (90 min)
    • Entretien final en visio avec Romain, Group Chief Risk & Data Officer (30 min)

🎁 Les avantages à rejoindre Younited ?

  • Des bureaux situés au cœur de Paris (9ème arrondissement)
  • Un environnement de travail international et l’opportunité de partir en mission dans nos bureaux à l’étranger (Barcelone, Lisbonne, Rome)
  • Un état d’esprit entrepreneurial et un fort esprit d’équipe
  • Un accompagnement managérial et RH individualisé pendant l’onboarding et tout au long de l’aventure Younited
  • Un environnement d’apprentissage continu avec la possibilité de bénéficier de formations externes et internes, plateforme de e-learning et des « Friday workshops » au sein de l'équipe Tech, pour accompagner le développement de chacun
  • Une attention particulière à l’équilibre vie pro / vie perso
  • Une charte de la parentalité pour soutenir tous les projets de famille à travers des mesures clés
  • Pour t’accompagner dans les moments clés de ta vie personnelle, des congés exceptionnels souvent bien plus favorables que les dispositions légales
  • Une politique de télétravail hybride 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine selon les équipes et la possibilité d’une semaine de full remote deux fois par an
  • 33 jours de congés payés soit 8 de plus que les 25 jours légaux (à la place des traditionnelles RTT)
  • Un abonnement à la plateforme Wellpass, ex Gymlib (+4000 activités sport et bien-être partout en France) à un tarif préférentiel 
  • Carte tickets restaurant à hauteur de 10€ pris en charge à 60% par l'employeur
  • Des team buildings en France (Summer Party et Winter Party), à l’international et en équipe
 
Younited is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e)
description:
Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.
  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.
  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.
  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.
  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.
  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.
  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.
  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.
  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.
  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.
  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.
  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.
  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.
  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.
  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.
  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.
  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.
  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.
  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.
  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.
  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.
  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.
  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Commercial terrain, Commercial itinérant, Sales, Freelance, Vente, Commercial B2B, Commercial indépendant, Développement commercial.

 

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Head of Integrated Marketing France
description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

À propos du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Head of Integrated Marketing France pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing France, basée à Paris.

Rattaché(e) à la Head of Marketing France, vous piloterez l'une des trois équipes Marketing du marché français et managerez une équipe de 3 personnes.

Votre mission : être le point de connexion entre la stratégie Global et son exécution sur le marché France, en fédérant l'ensemble des parties prenantes autour d'une vision marketing claire, cadrée et exécutée dans les temps.

À la croisée de la stratégie, de l'orchestration et de l'exécution, vous porterez la vision marketing France auprès du Global et des instances exécutives locales, tout en veillant à ce que chaque campagne — globale ou locale — soit livrée avec excellence et dans les délais. Vous piloterez également le programme de fidélité en France.

Vos missions

  • Définir et porter la vision stratégique marketing France, en s'appuyant sur une compréhension fine de la stratégie Global et en assurant sa traduction pertinente sur le marché français (spécificités locales : créa, moments de consommation, culture...).
  • Être l'interlocuteur constructif du Global : savoir s'intégrer dans une stratégie globale tout en la challengeant de façon argumentée lorsque les spécificités françaises le nécessitent.
  • Fédérer l'ensemble des pôles (Sales, Brand & Media, Creative, CRM, Analytics, Global...) pour s'assurer que chacun travaille vers les mêmes objectifs et dans le même calendrier.
  • Piloter et sécuriser le calendrier de livraison des campagnes (globales et locales) : brief à temps, validation des plans média, validation brand, etc., pour garantir une exécution sans accroc.
  • Simplifier et cadrer des sujets complexes impliquant de multiples parties prenantes, en faisant émerger les décisions à prendre et en portant les recommandations qui en découlent.
  • Formaliser et présenter la vision et la performance marketing France à un niveau exécutif, avec clarté et impact.
  • Piloter le programme de fidélité en France, en garantissant sa cohérence avec la stratégie marketing globale et les priorités business locales.
  • Intégrer l'IA dans les méthodes de travail de l'équipe, pour gagner en efficacité et en qualité d'exécution.
  • Manager et développer une équipe de 3 personnes, en apportant vision, coaching, structure et exigence d'exécution.

Le profil recherché

Vous êtes un(e) leader marketing structuré(e), reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à simplifier des sujets complexes multi-stakeholders et à faire en sorte que les choses avancent.

Vous apportez notamment :

  • 8 ans et plus d'expérience en marketing, avec une expérience significative dans des environnements matriciels et multi-marchés.
  • Une capacité avérée à travailler à l'interface du Global et du Local, en sachant à la fois s'aligner sur une stratégie globale et la challenger de façon constructive quand nécessaire.
  • Un leadership naturel pour fédérer, cadrer et orchestrer des sujets impliquant de nombreuses parties prenantes, sans lien hiérarchique direct sur la plupart d'entre elles.
  • Une forte capacité de formalisation et de communication, notamment pour porter une vision ou une recommandation devant un public exécutif.
  • Une orientation PMO marquée : rigueur, sens du détail, capacité à garder le contrôle sur des plannings complexes et à faire respecter les délais.
  • Une appétence pour l'IA et son intégration dans les méthodes de travail marketing.
  • Une expérience réussie en management et dans le développement de talents.
  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais.

Les compétences qui feront votre réussite

  • Leadership et fédération d'équipes transverses
  • Simplification et cadrage de sujets complexes
  • Sens de l'organisation et rigueur (PMO)
  • Capacité à challenger de façon constructive
  • Communication et formalisation à niveau exécutif
  • Gestion de projet et respect des délais
  • Appétence pour l'IA et les nouveaux outils
  • Management et développement de talents
  • Connaissance du média (brand et performance)
  • Orientation business, à l'aise avec la data et le reporting chiffré

title: Director of rewards, data & analytics
description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

As Director, Rewards & Data, you make pay, equity, benefits, workforce costs and People data work as one decision system

You join the People Leadership Team and lead a team of three experts (Compensation; People Data & HR Cockpit; Cost Control & Workforce Planning), plus our Benefits and Immigration providers.

Your mandate has two sides:

  • Total Rewards — design and run a reward system (compensation, stock options and BSPCE, benefits, international mobility) that is competitive, fair, transparent and financially sustainable.

  • People data and workforce economics — give leadership a reliable, shared view of headcount, people costs and workforce trends, and turn it into recommendations before decisions are made.

What you'll do

Build and lead the hub

  • Set the hub's vision, roadmap and ways of working; lead and grow your three experts and manage specialist providers with clear accountability.

  • Define who decides what with People Partners, Finance, Legal, Payroll and People Operations & Tech, and shape our People strategy as a member of the People Leadership Team.

Own Total Rewards and compensation

  • Own our reward philosophy and global compensation framework: job architecture, salary ranges, benchmarking and pay positioning.

  • Lead the annual compensation review with Finance, and advise executives and People Partners on offers, promotions, retention and organisational changes.

  • Monitor internal equity and market competitiveness, and get Back Market ready for the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Steer our equity programmes (stock options and BSPCE)

  • Own equity principles, governance and the role of equity in total compensation, with Finance and Legal.

  • Guarantee a reliable, documented and auditable lifecycle from grant to exit, and help employees understand and value their equity.

Turn People data into decisions

  • Own the HR Cockpit priorities and the definition of our key People metrics, built on Workday and aligned with company data standards.

  • Co-steer workforce planning and the people cost trajectory with Finance (headcount, compensation, equity, benefits, contingent workers), with scenarios for organisational decisions.

Shape benefits and international mobility

  • Set the principles for global and local benefits and immigration, and manage providers on compliance, quality, cost and employee experience as we grow internationally.

Keep it trustworthy

  • Make sure reward decisions and sensitive data are handled with clear governance, approvals, auditability and data protection, and flag reward-related risks early.

What you'll bring

  • Significant experience leading a Total Rewards or Comp & Ben function in an international, multi-site company. Scale-up, tech or marketplace experience is a strong plus.

  • Hands-on ownership of stock option and BSPCE programmes (or comparable French equity plans): governance, allocation and lifecycle.

  • A track record of running people cost and headcount planning with Finance, and of building or rebuilding an HR data or analytics capability.

  • Multi-country practice across Europe and at least one of the US or APAC, with working knowledge of pay transparency and pay equity requirements.

  • Credibility with a CEO, a CFO and an Executive Committee: you bring fact-based recommendations and challenge constructively.

  • Sound judgement balancing fairness, business needs, market competitiveness and financial sustainability.

  • A builder mindset: you enjoy shaping a hub that is still taking form with a lean team, and you stay close enough to the detail to guarantee quality.

  • The ability to explain complex reward and equity topics simply, and to handle sensitive matters with discretion.

  • Fluent English (our working language).

     

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in France.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
  • Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.

description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Facilities Operations Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.
 

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Facilities Operations Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer: 

  • great freedom for your creative ideas.
  • ongoing professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative and technological environment.
  • Convenient transport connections, new modern and well-equipped office and workshop space with the option to contribute creatively to the design.

title: Enterprise Account Executive - Financial Services
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Financial Services: the banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, and wealth managers people trust with their money, their families, and their futures. These institutions win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere. Their customers increasingly expect to talk, not type, whether they’re checking a balance, disputing a charge, filing a claim, or asking about a loan.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to institutions reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will:

  • Win net-new logos and drive ElevenAgents deal volume. These are the two metrics that define success in this role

  • Be able to balance a diverse pipeline of large financial institutions who require white glove experience with medium sized regional clients who require speed to close

  • Partner with the Enterprise Sales Lead to turn warm introductions into qualified opportunities and closed deals

  • Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows. Our public use cases include account inquiries, payment support, fraud triage, loan origination, claims processing, collections, and compliance verification. Others include caller verification, onboarding, policy servicing and renewals, and contact center coaching

  • Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in AI governance and model risk

  • Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (CX and Contact Center Operations, Digital and Product, Technology, and Risk, Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

  • Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through model-risk, security, and architecture review, and set them up to scale in production

  • Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Financial Services positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements

  • At least 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

  • Financial services experience (banks, credit unions, insurers, lenders, payments) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

  • Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

  • Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

  • Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (CX, operations, digital), and to risk and compliance gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

  • Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

  • Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, model risk, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

  • Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

  • High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

  • Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

  • Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

title: Head of Hardware
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

  • Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

  • Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

  • Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

  • Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

  • Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

  • Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

  • You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

  • Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

  • You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

  • You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

  • A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

  • Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

  • Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

  • Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

  • Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

  • Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

  • Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

  • Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Lead Controls & Data Engineer
description:
At DeWarmte, we develop technology that helps homes move away from gas. Our heat pumps combine hardware, embedded control software, cloud services and data—and the quality of the software connecting those elements directly determines how well our products perform in customers’ homes.


We are looking for a Lead Controls & Data Engineer to take ownership of two foundations of our products: the control software that operates our heat pumps and the data platform that helps us monitor, understand and improve them.


This is a hands-on leadership role. Initially, most of your time will be spent writing code, diagnosing real-world behaviour, improving reliability and delivering new functionality. At the same time, you are in the lead for collaborating with external partners, ensuring data reliability and scalability. Additionally, you will build the technical foundations, documentation and team that move us away from dependence on any one engineer.

Your mission

Build reliable, scalable controls and data capability that is owned by a team—not an individual.

You will inherit working systems and products already operating in the field. Your job is to understand them deeply, keep them running, improve their performance and evolve their architecture. You will then recruit and develop the engineers needed to create durable, shared ownership.

What you'll do

Own and improve our control software

  • Work directly in the production code that controls our heat pumps.

  • Design, build, test and deploy new control functionality.

  • Improve product performance, stability, safety and energy efficiency.

  • Diagnose and understand complex behaviour across software, electronics, sensors, hydraulics and the physical installation.

  • Manage controlled software rollouts across both new products and the installed fleet.

  • Establish appropriate automated testing, simulation, observability and release practices.

  • Current stack includes Bash/Shell, Python, Kafka, Telegraf and Influx. You will own the evolution of the stack together with our Hardware R&D team.


Build our product data platform

  • Take technical ownership of the systems that collect, process and expose data from our connected smart heat pumps.

  • Make product behaviour and fleet trends observable for engineering, service and product teams.

  • Improve the quality, reliability and accessibility of operational data.

  • Ensure pipeline and server capabilities are able to handle rapid scaling.

  • Create the foundations for performance analysis, remote diagnostics and continuous product improvement.

  • Define clear interfaces between device software, cloud systems, the customer app and internal tools.


Build a team and eliminate key-person dependency

  • Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation, tooling and repeatable engineering practices.

  • Design systems that other engineers can intuitively understand, easily test and safely change.

  • Define the roles and capabilities the team will need as DeWarmte scales.

  • Recruit, onboard and mentor controls, embedded-software and data engineers.

  • Introduce effective code reviews, technical decision-making and shared operational ownership.

  • Gradually move from being the primary implementer to leading a capable team—without losing touch with the code.


Work across the product

You will collaborate closely with colleagues in hardware, software, data, product development, assembly, installation and service. You will help resolve immediate customer and operational issues while protecting the long-term quality of the platform.

 

What success looks like

In your first months

  • You understand the existing controls, data flows and operational risks.

  • You can independently maintain, debug and release the current systems.

  • The most important technical risks and knowledge gaps are visible and prioritised.

  • Monitoring, documentation and development practices begin to improve.


As the role develops

  • New control functionality can be delivered predictably and safely.

  • You work closely together with Hardware colleagues, developing the next generation of products

  • Product data supports faster diagnosis and better engineering decisions.

  • Critical systems are understood and maintained by more than one person.

  • A small, strong controls and data team is in place, with clear ownership and effective ways of working.

  • DeWarmte is no longer dependent on a single engineer to operate or evolve this part of the product.

What we are looking for

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience, including ownership of production systems.

  • Experience developing control or embedded software for physical products, machines or connected devices.

  • A track record of taking functionality through design, implementation, testing, deployment and real-world operation.

  • The ability to reason across software, hardware and physical-system behaviour.

  • Experience working with telemetry, time-series data, data pipelines or connected-device platforms.

  • Strong engineering fundamentals, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and structured incident resolution.

  • The ability to create clarity in an environment where systems and processes are still developing.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving how a team works.

  • The ambition and ability to recruit and lead a team while remaining highly hands-on.


Experience with heat pumps, HVAC systems, safety-critical design, fleet-management systems or optimisation is valuable, but we care more about your ability to learn a complex physical product and take genuine end-to-end ownership.

How you work

  • You solve urgent problems without allowing permanent workarounds to become the architecture.

  • You explain complex technical matters clearly to people with different backgrounds.

  • You balance reliability today with the investments needed to scale tomorrow.

  • You share knowledge by default and measure success by what the team can own without you.

  • You are comfortable switching between debugging a specific installation, reviewing architecture and interviewing a future teammate.

  • You are able to maintain alignment between your own team’s development roadmap and the roadmap of other product teams.

What you will get

  • Direct influence on technology that contributes to the energy transition.

  • Ownership of software and data that sit at the heart of a real physical product.

  • The opportunity to shape both the technical platform and the team around it.

  • A role that starts deeply hands-on and grows into broader engineering leadership.

  • Close collaboration with colleagues across the complete product lifecycle.

What we offer

  • 27 vacation days plus 8% holiday allowance

  • A healthy daily lunch at the office

  • Laptop and everything you need to do your best work

  • Regular team events, company drinks, our annual beach day, and winter trip

  • Lots of room to grow, develop yourself, and make a lasting impact

Interested?

title: Sales Adviseur - Duurzame Energiesystemen
description:
Onze missie

Heel Nederland helpen om van het gas af te gaan. Dat is waar we iedere dag aan werken.


Bij DeWarmte ontwikkelen én installeren we onze eigen warmtepompen. Daarmee maken we duurzaam verwarmen slimmer, betaalbaarder en toegankelijk voor steeds meer huishoudens. Maar een goed product alleen is niet genoeg. Mensen hebben behoefte aan eerlijk advies en een vast aanspreekpunt.

Daar kom jij in beeld.

 

Wij maken warmte zonder gas

Je agenda zit 's ochtends al vol met mensen die zelf hebben gebeld. Ze willen weten of een warmtepomp past bij hun huis en of het uit kan.

 

Geen koude acquisitie dus. Nooit.


Wist je dat wij onze warmtepompen zelf ontwerpen? Met een club van ruim zestig mensen bedenken we ze, assembleren we ze in Utrecht en installeren we ze zelf. Voor huiseigenaren door heel Nederland en sinds dit jaar ook in Duitsland. Vorig jaar won onze Pomp MP als enige warmtepomp ooit zowel de iF Design Award Gold als de Red Dot.


Elke week gaan er tientallen huizen van het gas af. Het doel is 10% van alle Nederlandse woningen, ongeveer 800.000 huizen. De vraag is er en het product staat. De rem zit op hoe snel we kunnen leveren.


Dat lukt niet zonder jou als sales adviseur.

 

Wat jij hier doet

  • Adviesgesprekken via telefoon en videocall met huiseigenaren die zelf hebben aangeklopt

  • Digitale inspectie: aan de hand van foto's inschatten wat er in dat specifieke huis nodig is

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
Staff Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure

The role

We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for our Infrastructure team.

Stream runs behind apps that more than a billion people use: billions of API requests a month, a 99.999% uptime promise, and a small team keeping it all running. Infrastructure here decides how fast our products feel, how well they scale, and how quickly we can launch new ones.

This year we're wrapping up a big move. We're simplifying where and how we host, and rebuilding our data layer on self-hosted, open-source systems that are faster and cheaper to run. That's the groundwork, not the job. Next comes building the infrastructure every Stream product runs on, including the ones we haven't built yet. That means real SLOs, clear costs, calmer on-call, and a platform that helps teams ship faster.

What you build will shape how much Stream spends and how fast it grows, and we'll trust you with big decisions from your first few weeks.

This is a Software Engineering role first. Attitude, ambition and a willingness to experiment across the stack matter more to us than years of Kubernetes or database operations. We expect AI to cover a good share of the DevOps-heavy work, and we expect you to use it that way. What a tool can't give us is system design judgement, strong fundamentals and good code, so that is what we look for.

Platform & Infrastructure is a small, senior team without the support structures of a large organisation. It moves fast and it gets hectic. We would rather say that now than have you find out in month two.

 

What team is focusing on:

  • Runs Stream's global platform. Keeps the edge and backend that serve customers worldwide fast and up, at single-digit millisecond latency on a 99.999% uptime SLA.

  • Shapes Stream's margins. Our hosting and infrastructure decisions directly drive the company's profitability. You will decide where and how we run, and what we stop paying for.

  • Builds tools people actually want to use. Internal tools that change how engineers deploy and debug, and external ones that give customers a clear view of their own traffic and health.

  • Makes on-call boring. Builds a rotation people can sustain, and cuts alert noise until a page means something real is broken.

  • Makes cost visible. Gives every team a clear view of what it spends on infrastructure and why, so cost becomes part of every engineering decision.

What you will do:

  • Define what "good" looks like for the platform. Set latency and uptime SLOs for every product team, and decide what we measure, from error rates and delivery times to how healthy our customers' apps really are.

  • Make the big infrastructure calls. Lead the design reviews and decisions on where and how we run, working with backend, video and moderation engineers on tradeoffs that cross service boundaries.

  • Build the platform tooling. Write the internal tools and services that help engineers ship, deploy and debug faster, plus the docs and AI skills that make launching a new product repeatable.

  • Turn incidents into fixes that stick. Take part in on-call, and make sure every root cause ends in a durable fix, not a workaround.

  • Make cost part of every design. Weigh cost alongside reliability in every decision, and give teams the numbers to do the same.

What we are looking for:

  • A software engineer who has built systems, not only configured them. You write production code in Go, Python or a similar language. Scripting-only backgrounds are not a fit.

  • Strong system design. You can reason about failure modes, capacity and cost in distributed systems, and explain why you chose what you chose.

  • Solid fundamentals in networking, storage and concurrency, and the habit of asking why a system behaves the way it does instead of accepting the default.

  • You have owned high-scale production systems and set technical direction beyond your own work, through design reviews, RFCs and decisions other engineers build on.

  • You experiment. When you hit Kubernetes, a database or a cloud service you have not run before, you dig in, use AI to close the gap, and ship.

  • You already use AI tools every day in your engineering work.

  • You treat cost and reliability as engineering problems, and you can put a number on an outcome you drove.

  • You write clearly. Much of this role is docs and standards that other teams will follow.

  • You are comfortable in a small team, setting direction and reviewing a PR in the same week.

Nice to have experience:

  • Kubernetes in production: cluster architecture, workload design or a migration you led.

  • PostgreSQL at scale, ideally self-hosted or with CloudNativePG: sharding, replication, partitioning tradeoffs.

  • Valkey or Redis at scale, ideally on Kubernetes.

  • Hands-on AWS and GCP, including multi-cloud setups or migrations between providers.

  • Cloud commitment and reservation strategy (committed use discounts, savings plans), or formal FinOps practice.

  • SLO design, alert hygiene and a Prometheus and Grafana based observability stack.

  • Real-time systems: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming or other persistent-connection workloads.

  • Open source contributions, or writing and talks on cloud, platform or distributed systems.

Our stack

  • Go, gRPC, RocksDB, Python

  • PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ

  • GCP

  • Grafana, Prometheus, ELK (Elasticsearch and Kibana)

  • Jaeger and Tempo for distributed tracing, Datadog

  • Redis, Memcached

  • Claude Code, Cursor

You will thrive here if

  • You want platform and infrastructure problems at a scale most engineers never touch, and the autonomy to set the direction yourself.

  • You would rather try something, measure it and change course than wait for a perfect plan.

  • You ship fast and learn fast, including when it is hectic.

  • You are self-directed and comfortable working with a globally distributed team across time zones.

You probably will not if

  • You want to stay a specialist in one layer of the stack.

  • You want tightly scoped tickets and step-by-step direction.

  • You need a calm, highly predictable environment.

Compensation and benefits

For employees based in the Netherlands:

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan

  • Commute covered: an NS Business Card or a company Swapfiets

  • Fitness contribution of up to €60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership

  • Learning and development budget

  • Work from anywhere: up to four weeks a year

  • Full Dutch statutory leave, with Stream topping up paternity leave to 100% pay

  • Catered team lunches in the office, and snacks

  • MacBook Pro and peripherals

  • Relocation support, visa sponsorship and 30% ruling support

  • An office in the centre of Amsterdam

  • Conferences and meetups, as an attendee or a speaker

  • The chance to work on our open source SDKs

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with global presence and a team of around 145 people from more than 35 countries.

We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

Hybrid office policy: applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.

title: Battery Engineer / Technician, Electrode Specialist
description:
Who we are

At CarbonX, we are solving one of the clean energy transition's biggest bottlenecks: replacing imported graphite in EV batteries with a local, scalable, high-performance carbon material. Our technology enables 6-minute ultra-fast charging and lower production emissions, dropping directly into existing commercial manufacturing lines without requiring cell makers to retool.

Born out of TU Delft, we’ve crossed the initial R&D threshold. We are now transitioning from technology development to industrial manufacturing and global scale—expanding our footprint across the Netherlands, Texas, China, and South Korea to supply Tier-1 automotive and battery partners.

If you're motivated by high-velocity execution, true hands-on ownership, and doing work that has a visible, measurable impact on global energy independence, this is where you can build something that scales.

The Role

As our Electrode Specialist, you will take direct responsibility for our electrode-making process in our Delft laboratory. This is a practical, bench-first role (80% practical lab execution & quality control, 20% data analysis, reporting & process improvement) that sits at the center of our commercial validation pipeline.

Because CarbonX materials physically behave differently from standard graphite during dispersion and calendering, you will play a crucial role in diagnosing processability, optimising slurry formulations, and ensuring defect-free electrode production.

Key Responsibilities

• Slurry Preparation & Electrode Manufacturing: Formulate, mix, coat, and calender slurries containing active materials, binders, and conductive additives strictly in line with experimental and customer protocols.

• Physical & Diagnostic Characterisation: Perform hands-on bench tests including rheology and viscosity profiling, slurry density, moisture, particle fineness analysis, adhesion and peel-strength testing (90°/180°), and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM).

• Processability Optimisation: Observe how novel carbon structures interact during mixing and calendering; identify physical bottlenecks to ensure process repeatability.

• Operational Troubleshooting & QC: Enforce strict quality control standards. Identify root causes of material or coating deviations and execute real-time operational problem-solving.

• Lab Equipment Ownership: Manage, calibrate, and maintain key equipment (different types of mixers, coating/calendering lines, diagnostic tools), manage routine calibration and preventative maintenance, and draft practical SOPs.

• EHS Rigor: Maintain a clean, organised, and safe laboratory environment, strictly following chemical handling and safety protocols.

Enough about us - what about you?

To really enjoy and excel in this role, we imagine you will have a background encompassing the following:

• Lab-First Mindset: You genuinely enjoy being hands-on at the lab bench (80%+ of your time) over desk-based research and take pride in precision execution.

• Practical Experience: 1–2+ years of practical, applied laboratory or industrial scale-up experience in electrode manufacturing (slurry preparation, coating, calendering) or adjacent liquid-coating/formulation industries.

• Educational Background: Bachelor's (BSc), HBO, or MBO in Materials Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related practical scientific discipline.

• Scale-Up & QC Mindset: Motivated by extreme accuracy, precision, and detail, but adaptable enough to troubleshoot operational lab issues calmly under customer deadlines.

• Fluent English: Professional working proficiency in spoken and written English.

Why Join Us?

• Real Industrial Impact: Your bench precision directly validates our novel carbon material, impacting customer sign-offs and multi-million-euro supply contracts.

• Culture & Leadership: Join a collaborative, supportive lab team led by Agnes Chojnacka where open feedback and safety are prioritised.

• Deep Tech Scale-Up Environment: Work directly with novel carbonic structures and high-spec laboratory infrastructure in a fast-moving, non-bureaucratic environment.

Ready to take proven deep-tech to industrial scale?

The technology is no longer just an idea—it has been produced at scale, integrated into commercial processes, tested in cells, and validated by major customers. Now we need exceptional people (scientists, engineers, operational specialists, and commercial leaders) to help solve the next—and arguably hardest—part: taking it global.

Don't worry about having a "flawless" CV.

If you don’t check every single box, don’t let impostor syndrome hold you back. We value high-velocity execution, true hands-on ownership, and raw drive far more than a perfect paper history.

Ready to stop working on theoretical projects and help build something that’s actually shipping?

Hit apply or reach out to us directly—let’s talk.

About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Backend Engineer

As a Backend Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the platform infrastructure that powers our products. You will work closely with our Frontend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and other stakeholders to design and build scalable, reliable, and high-performance products.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance to our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Design and implement scalable and reliable backend systems and infrastructure to support our products

  • Develop and maintain our micro-services to expose platform functionality to internal and external clients

  • Collaborate with development and quality assurance teams to ensure high availability, scalability, and security of our systems

  • Collaborate with DevOps Engineers to ensure the continuous delivery and deployment of software products

  • Work with software developers to identify and implement improvements to our platform architecture and functionality

  • Develop and maintain documentation of our systems and processes

  • Mentor and train junior members of the backend team

  • Keep up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies

What you bring to the table:

  • Proficiency in Python programming language

  • 3+ years of experience in the related field

  • Experience with relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle

  • Experience with the cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP)

  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with stakeholders across the organization

  • Excellent English communication skills 

What success in the first 6 months looks like:

  • You’ve built trust with Product, Frontend, and DevOps peers and taken clear ownership of 2-3 domain APIs/services, including stewardship of their contracts and SLAs.

  • You’ve established an API-first workflow: starting from use cases, you propose and socialize OpenAPI specs, align on naming and conventions, then implement in FastAPI with Pydantic models.

  • You’ve delivered impactful API features end-to-end (design → implementation → tests → docs) that are consumed by internal and external clients without hand-holding.

  • You’ve raised API robustness: strong request/response validation, consistent error models, pagination and idempotency where appropriate, and backward-compatible versioning enforced via automated contract tests in CI (ruff, Poetry, pre-commit).

  • You’ve improved the reliability and performance of our service by adding meaningful observability (metrics, logs, tracing) and defining SLIs/SLOs for key endpoints—reducing 5xx rates and improving p95 latency.

  • You’ve made safe database changes in MySQL with SQLAlchemy migrations, optimized critical queries, and contributed to data access patterns involving DynamoDB or Neo4j while keeping API contracts stable.

  • You’ve strengthened the security of APIs (authN/authZ boundaries, scoped tokens, least-privilege access, secrets management, rate limiting) and documented the approach.

  • You’ve written clear API documentation and examples (e.g., snippets/collections), shared knowledge with the team, and mentored junior engineers so others can build on your work.

Current tech stack:

We are fully cloud-native, leveraging AWS and adopting a Lean, API-first product development approach driven by modern cloud technologies and thoughtful design practices.

Our backend applications are built using Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy (MySQL). On the front end, we predominantly develop with Angular and also utilize Headless Wagtail and WordPress for select products. To ensure code quality and a consistent release pipeline, we employ GitHub Actions for CI/CD along with tools like Renovate, ruff, Poetry, and pre-commit.

We containerize our applications using Docker and Docker Compose. Currently, we are transitioning from AWS Lambda-based deployments to Kubernetes-managed services and moving from AWS CloudFormation to Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue to expand our capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and database technologies (MySQL, DynamoDB).

What we offer:

  • Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

  • International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 

  • Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.  

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

  • Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

  • Hybrid working model. 

  • Policies to support working parents. 

  • Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.  

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp  

  • Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.
