title: Chief Financial Officer
description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The Mission

Every day, patients, physicians, and pharma companies navigate a fragmented, slow, and complex healthcare ecosystem to find pre-approval treatments. At myTomorrows, we are building the global infrastructure to solve this. Our mission is clear: to enable earlier and better access to all possible treatment options for patients who cannot afford to wait.

Operating across 134+ countries, with hubs in Amsterdam, New York, and India, we've supported over 17,000 patients and 3,000+ physicians. Avego's €25 million growth investment is our launchpad to scale the business internationally, deepen BioPharma partnerships, and build the financial architecture that a company of this complexity now requires.

As our Chief Financial Officer (CFO), based at our Amsterdam headquarters, you will be a central member of the Leadership Team and a close strategic partner to the CEO. You will not simply run a finance function. You will build the financial infrastructure, governance, and discipline that this next chapter of growth demands, across a business spanning technology, regulated healthcare services, and multiple jurisdictions.

The Challenges

As CFO, you will step into the trenches to tackle four defining challenges:

  • Leading buy-side M&A execution: You will be the primary financial architect behind our inorganic growth. As myTomorrows evaluates acquisitions and strategic partnerships to complement organic growth, you will lead deal structuring, due diligence, valuation, and integration from a buyer's seat, bringing real process discipline to a company entering its first phase of consolidation.

  • Architecting for multi-jurisdiction complexity: You will own the financial structure connecting our operations across the Netherlands, the US, and India. This means building robust transfer pricing policies, intercompany arrangements, and multi-party revenue recognition frameworks that hold up to investor and regulatory scrutiny as the business scales across borders.

  • Being a credible investor partner: You will serve as the finance function's primary interface to our Supervisory Board. You will bring investor-grade reporting rhythms, board governance discipline, and the judgment to translate operational reality into the language our sponsor and Board expect.

  • Preparing for future fundraising and exit: You will help set the company up for its next capital event, whether that is a follow-on raise, a strategic sale, or another form of exit. This means building the financial track record, audit readiness, and data room discipline that institutional buyers and investors expect, well ahead of any process actually starting.

What You Bring to the Table

Experience & Technical Depth

  • Proven CFO or strong CFO-1 experience in a high-growth, investor-backed business, ideally in healthtech, healthcare services, life sciences, or another complex international platform environment.

  • Buy-side M&A execution is a firm requirement. You have led acquisitions from the buyer's side, not only sell-side or advisory M&A, and can speak credibly to deal structuring, diligence, and post-deal integration.

  • Multi-jurisdiction financial complexity: hands-on experience with transfer pricing, intercompany structures, and multi-party revenue recognition across at least two of the following: Europe, the US, and Asia.

  • Institutional governance familiarity: direct experience with board reporting rhythms, supervisory board obligations, and the accountability that comes with a private equity or growth equity sponsor.

  • Regulated sector navigation: exposure to compliance-intensive environments, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, or another highly regulated domain.

  • Leading a lean senior team: you have led finance at this scale and know how to raise the ceiling of a small team rather than solving it with headcount.

  • Fundraising and exit experience: you have run or closely supported a capital raise, whether equity, debt, or both, and ideally have direct exposure to a sale process, IPO, or other exit event. You know what "diligence-ready" actually means in practice.

Leadership Style & Cultural Fit

  • A Builder at Heart: You are energized by creating and scaling finance infrastructure, and you are comfortable reviewing a deal model, writing a Board memo, or rolling up your sleeves with the team when needed.

  • Commercially Astute: You connect mission to economics, balancing patient-first principles with the discipline an investor-backed business requires, and you can challenge constructively.

  • Low Ego, High Accountability: You establish clear standards, hold yourself and others to them, and proactively remove roadblocks rather than waiting for structure to be handed to you.

  • A Strategic Connector: You translate financial complexity into a clear narrative for the CEO, Supervisory Board, and cross-functional leaders, building alignment and confidence in the numbers.

Please note: this is a hybrid role, combining flexible home-office days with regular days at our Amsterdam headquarters. Because we value face-to-face collaboration during the week, we are looking for candidates who already live within commuting distance. We cannot provide fully remote options.

The Financial Foundation Today

You will inherit a finance function with a solid FP&A core and real scope to build:

  • Structure: A multi-entity organization spanning the Netherlands, the US, and an operational hub in India, with growing cross-border complexity.

  • Team: A lean, capable team of five. A finance lead as your direct report with three people behind her, plus Revenue Operations, giving you direct influence over pipeline, forecasting, and pricing rather than a view from the sidelines.

  • Reporting: FP&A and performance reporting capability already in place; the priority now is professionalizing controls, governance, and investor-grade reporting infrastructure around it.

  • Ownership: A Supervisory Board and a committed institutional sponsor, Avego Healthcare Capital, with clear expectations on growth economics, capital allocation, and value creation.

  • Growth model: Organic growth complemented by inorganic opportunities, with M&A and strategic partnerships expected to play an increasing role in the company's next phase.

What 12-18 Months of Success Looks Like

  • When you look back at your first year and a half, you will have successfully:

  • Led or materially advanced one or more buy-side M&A processes, demonstrating deal discipline from sourcing through integration.

  • Established a robust multi-jurisdiction financial architecture, including transfer pricing policy and intercompany structures that hold up under scrutiny.

  • Built investor-grade financial governance and greater confidence in data quality across the business.

  • Strengthened the finance team and its standing with business leaders, while building on the FP&A foundation already in place.

  • Become a trusted partner to the CEO and Supervisory Board, with a reporting rhythm that meets institutional ownership expectations.

  • Helped shape a clear financial roadmap for international scale and long-term value creation.

What we Offer

  • A Seat at the Table: Autonomy to shape the financial architecture of a category-defining company with deep strategic relevance.

  • Stability + Speed: The financial backing of a leading healthcare investment fund, paired with the agility and creativity of a global scale-up.

  • Comprehensive Executive Benefits: Competitive base salary, performance-driven annual bonus, and a substantial Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP).

  • Well-being & Development: Attractive pension plan (full premium covered by myTomorrows), a dedicated personal learning budget, and mental health support via OpenUp.

  • Our HQ Culture: Healthy lunches at our thriving headquarters, a hybrid working model, policies supporting working parents, and legendary events hosted by our Culture Club, including our annual "myTomorrowland" celebration.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Partnership Manager
description:
As a Partner Manager, you will play a pivotal role in developing and managing existing strategic service and technology partnerships that drive growth and customer acquisition for Trengo. You will be responsible for identifying potential partners, building strong relationships, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure the success of partnerships. The Partner Manager will work closely with the sales, marketing, and product teams to align on goals, and execute joint go-to-market strategies.

About Trengo

Welcome to the forefront of AI-driven communication. At Trengo, we’re redefining the industry by replacing repetitive work with meaningful conversations through our AI-powered customer engagement platform. We unify communication channels and leverage agentic AI to deliver proactive, human-like service, boosting efficiency for thousands of businesses worldwide.

As a fast-moving Dutch scale-up, backed by a $36M Series A and an official WhatsApp Business Solutions Provider, we thrive on acceleration. Your expertise will drive growth: you’ll make a strategic impact, champion AI innovation, and help shape the product roadmap. You’ll do this alongside an international team guided by our Dynamic pace, Future-proof mindset, Ownership, and Open culture.

What your role looks like

Let's break down this vision into a little taste of your work at Trengo:

  • You will research and identify potential partners that align with Trengo’s business goals.

  • You will develop and execute business plans driving all aspects of the partner relationship to maximise growth opportunities by building territory partner strategies. Main focus will be on EMEA.

  • You will gain new customers with your partners, and ensure all partners are well-positioned to deliver successful customer implementations and recommendations.

  • You will negotiate and finalise partnership agreements that drive mutual value.

  • You will manage and nurture existing partnerships, being the primary point of contact for assigned partners

  • You will collaborate on Go-to-Market strategies that can bring further Partners gains

What you’ll bring

Du willst verstehen, wie ein modernes FinTech Risiken steuert und gleichzeitig mit Automatisierung und KI echte Prozessverbesserungen bauen? Im Enterprise Risk Management von auxmoney arbeitest Du in unserer GRC-Plattform (OneTrust) an Workflows, Integrationen und smarten, KI-gestützten Abläufen, die Risikomanagement effizienter und transparenter machen.

Wir berichten direkt an den CFO und bündeln Themen wie Internes Kontrollsystem, operationelle Risiken, Incidents, Drittparteien sowie wiederkehrende Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche an einem zentralen Ort. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und den Fachbereichen zusammen, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen strukturiert erfasst, Aufgaben sauber verteilt und Statusdaten ohne manuelles Nachfassen ins Reporting fließen.


Das erwartet Dich:

  • Workflows konfigurieren: Du entwickelst Workflows in unserer GRC-Software OneTrust, von der Analyse des Ablaufs bis zur fertigen Konfiguration mit Datenfeldern, Statuslogiken, Verantwortlichkeiten, Eskalationen und automatischen Benachrichtigungen.
  • Systeme integrieren: Du verbindest OneTrust über Schnittstellen und moderne Workflow-Tools mit weiteren Systemen bei auxmoney, zum Beispiel Slack, SharePoint oder Outlook, damit Fachbereiche Statusupdates dort liefern können, wo sie ohnehin arbeiten.
  • Automatisierungen aufbauen: Du identifizierst wiederkehrende Handgriffe und ersetzt sie durch Automatisierungen, die Informationen anfordern, Aufgaben verteilen, Fristen überwachen und Folgeaktivitäten auslösen, etwa bei regelmäßigen Bestätigungen der Fachbereiche oder bei der Überprüfung unserer Dienstleister.
  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du baust mit unseren KI-Bausteinen konkrete Lösungen für das Risikomanagement, zum Beispiel zur Strukturierung von Informationen, zur Vorbereitung von Bewertungen, zum Erkennen fehlender Angaben oder zum Zusammenfassen von Berichten, und achtest dabei auf Nachvollziehbarkeit und Qualität.
  • Qualität absichern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, prüfst Workflow-Logiken und KI-Lösungen vor dem Einsatz und dokumentierst Konfigurationen, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten so, dass andere darauf aufbauen können.
  • Reporting verbessern: Du sorgst dafür, dass Informationen vollständig und strukturiert erfasst werden, und überführst Statusdaten automatisiert in klare Übersichten für Management und Board.
  • Flexibel arbeiten: Du arbeitest flexibel aus dem Homeoffice. Wenn Du in der Nähe von Düsseldorf studierst, triffst Du Dein Team einmal pro Woche im Büro, ansonsten sehen wir uns regelmäßig digital und zu gemeinsamen Team-Tagen vor Ort.


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Immatrikulation und Praxis: Du bist in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, Business Analytics, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang immatrikuliert und hast bereits praktisch mit Software, Automatisierungen oder Daten gearbeitet, zum Beispiel im Studium, im Nebenjob oder in eigenen Projekten.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du hast Freude daran, neue Software zu verstehen, Workflows zu konfigurieren und technische Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen. Plus: Erfahrung mit Workflow-, Low-Code/No-Code-, Ticket- oder GRC-Systemen.
  • Automatisierung und KI-Mindset: Du möchtest herausfinden, wie KI-Anwendungen und automatisierte Workflows das Risikomanagement verbessern, und hinterfragst Ergebnisse kritisch, statt Dich blind auf Vorschläge zu verlassen.
  • Daten und Schnittstellen: Du denkst in Datenstrukturen und verstehst, wie Systeme über Schnittstellen miteinander sprechen. Plus: erste Kenntnisse in Excel, SQL, APIs oder Prozessmodellierung.
  • Strukturiertes Arbeiten: Du zerlegst komplexe Abläufe in klare Prozessschritte, arbeitest lösungsorientiert und bleibst auch bei vielen Details sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
  • Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Du stimmst Dich gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen ab, erklärst technische Sachverhalte verständlich und kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.


Das bringen wir mit:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte Deinen Arbeitstag so, dass er optimal zu Deinem Studium passt – wir unterstützen Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse!
  • Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Homeoffice: Arbeite dort, wo Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst. Ob im Büro oder von zu Hause – Du entscheidest!
  • Flache Hierarchien: Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Du hast direkten Kontakt zu Entscheidungsträgern und kannst Deine Ideen einbringen.
  • Vielfältige Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Du hast die Chance, Deine eigenen Projekte zu leiten und Deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Zahlreiche bereichsübergreifende Events: Knüpfe wertvolle Kontakte und erlebe unser Team bei spannenden Veranstaltungen und Teamevents.
  • Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club: Bleib fit und gesund – wir fördern Dein Wohlbefinden mit attraktiven Fitnessangeboten!
  • Täglich frisches Obst, endlos Kaffee, Tee und Wasser: Genieße eine gesunde Snack- und Getränkebar, die Dir hilft, energisch durch den Tag zu kommen.
  • Rabatte über Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Angeboten und Rabatten auf zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen – ein zusätzliches Plus für Deinen Geldbeutel!
Schließe Dich unserem Team an und bewirb Dich noch heute! Vergiss nicht, uns Dein voraussichtliches Ende des Studiums, Deinen gewünschten Stundenlohn sowie Dein nächstmögliches Startdatum mitzuteilen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Deine Bewerbung zu erhalten!

Das bringen wir mit:

  • Flexibilität für Deine Lebensgestaltung : Genieße familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten und eine großzügige Homeoffice-Regelung , damit Du in jeder Lebenslage agil und flexibel bleiben kannst.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten : Durch kurze Entscheidungswege ermöglichen wir Dir, selbstständig zu arbeiten und Deine Ideen aktiv einzubringen – bei uns hast Du Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

description:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As a working student in the Legal & Compliance department, you will gain diverse insights into compliance processes as well as valuable experience supporting our Legal Counsel and their daily business. In addition to contract and IT law, you will gain insights into organizational GDPR and actively support your colleagues.

Your tasks include:

  • You support our internal departments with compliance processes and compliance inquiries and document the progress.
  • You research legally relevant topics and monitor as well as document regulatory requirements.
  • You will assist in the creation of internal compliance training and prepare compliance audits.
  • You support your team with contract review and management and learn best practices in the process.


What you need to succeed

  • You are a student of business administration, law, business law, or a comparable degree program.
  • You have already gained experience in the Legal & Compliance field.
  • In addition to excellent German and English language skills, both written and spoken, you are proficient in MS Office.
  • You are characterized above all by your open-minded, flexible, and communicative working approach.
  • Additionally, you enjoy taking on responsibility and working independently.
  • You enjoy learning new things and have an interest in modern technologies.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You can work on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Your health matters: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • Lastly, and most importantly, we offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.

  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferred enrollment in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
  • For better insights, check us out on Instagram!


Our Values

We are…

  • Customer-Centric: We keep close to the customer and innovate in every aspect of our customer experience to ensure their success with our product and company.
  • Decent: We are respectful, helpful and reliable when working with customer, partners and colleagues.
  • Dynamic: We seek to constantly improve by measuring and sharing our work, inviting ideas from all colleagues, and responding quickly to new opportunities.

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Mercanis bist du der zentrale Umsatztreiber für unser bestehendes Kundenportfolio im gehobenen Mittelstand und Enterprise-Segment. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Vertriebs-Restrukturierung trennen wir "Hunting" und "Farming" konsequent: Du übernimmst die volle Vertriebs- und Deal-Verantwortung für ein exklusives Territory von ca. 60–70 bestehenden Accounts.

Deine Mission: Du identifizierst ungenutzte Cross- und Upsell-Potenziale, navigierst souverän durch komplexe C-Level-Buying-Center, steuerst vielschichtige Deal-Zyklen bis zum Verhandlungsabschluss und maximierst so nachhaltig unsere Net Revenue Retention (NRR). Wenn du ein tiefes Verständnis für B2B-SaaS-Vertriebsmethodiken mitbringst und Bestandskunden nicht nur betreuen, sondern durch echten Mehrwert strategisch ausbauen willst, ist dies deine perfekte Gelegenheit.


Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Expansion & ARR-Wachstum: Du steuerst den gesamten Verkaufszyklus für Upsell-, Cross-Sell- und Modul-Erweiterungen in einem Portfolio von ca. 60–70 Bestandskunden und triffst deine eigenen Quota-Ziele.

  • Pipeline-Generierung im Bestand: Du analysierst deine Accounts eigenständig auf White Spots, identifizierst neue Anwendungsfälle im Bereich Einkauf & Supply Chain Management und generierst aktiv qualifizierte Expansion-Pipeline.

  • Strategisches Closing & C-Level Selling: Du navigierst komplexe Buying Center (CPO, CFO, IT-Leitung), baust Belieber- & Champion-Netzwerke auf Executive-Ebene auf und führst kommerzielle Verhandlungen (Preisgestaltung, Lizenzerweiterungen, Vertragsverlängerungen) eigenständig zum Abschluss.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

About the Role

As a Senior Data Engineer on our Maritime Models team, you will take technical ownership of the core data pipelines and distributed storage architectures powering Kpler's vessel tracking and predictive analytics. You will design, scale, and optimize high-throughput batch and streaming pipelines that ingest raw maritime telemetry and transform it into actionable intelligence. Working with distributed NoSQL systems like Apache HBase at scale, your work directly ensures the freshness, accuracy, and reliability of the data models our global customers depend on.

 


Key Responsibilities

 

  • Architect, build, and operate high-throughput batch and streaming data pipelines using Java, Python, Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, and Airflow.

  • Design, tune, and maintain scalable distributed NoSQL databases, prioritizing Apache HBase performance for high-volume time-series maritime telemetry.

  • Drive end-to-end operational excellence across containerized cloud environments on AWS using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and GitOps workflows.

  • Define and enforce system reliability metrics, monitoring pipeline latency, data completeness, and uptime to meet strict operational SLAs.

  • Partner with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and SRE teams to translate complex maritime modeling requirements into robust, production-grade infrastructure.

  • Mentor peer engineers, drive code review standards, and leverage modern AI development tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to elevate team productivity.

    •  


Experience & Background

What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Data Engineer designing, scaling, and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in distributed NoSQL data stores, specifically Apache HBase, for high-volume time-series storage and query optimization.

  • Strong proficiency in software engineering using Java and Python.

  • Demonstrated experience with stream processing and orchestration tools such as Apache Kafka, Apache Flink, and Apache Airflow.

  • Solid background operating containerized services on AWS cloud environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform.

    • Nice-to-haves

    • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.

    • Experience working with geospatial data technologies (e.g., GeoServer) or spatial indexing algorithms.

    • Exposure to AI-assisted software development tools like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.

    • Domain familiarity with maritime tracking, AIS telemetry, or supply chain logistics.

  • Du stellst die Einhaltung und Dokumentation gemäß IMS, DIN ISO 29993 und 21001 sicher und unterstützt bei internen und externen Audits, z.B. durch EBA und Zertifizierungsstellen.

  • Normenkenntnisse: Kenntnisse der DIN ISO 29993, 21001 und ISO 9001:2015 sind von Vorteil und helfen dir, Qualitätsstandards in der Ausbildungsorganisation sicherzustellen.

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. title: AI Harness Engineer - Agentic & Autonomous Operations (m/f/x)
description:
xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business.

Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done.

We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it.

Tasks

We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems.

You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response.

What You’ll Own

  • Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs.
  • Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text.
  • Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost.
  • Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred.
  • Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns.
  • Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software.
  • Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture.
  • Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution.

Requirements

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python.
  • You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline.
  • You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations.
  • You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred.
  • You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate.
  • You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success.
  • You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents.
  • You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software.
  • You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence.
  • You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding.

Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

You May Not Be a Great Fit If

  • Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface.
  • Your background is primarily offline data analysis, model training, or experimentation, and you do not want to own production software and operational behavior.
  • You treat retrieval as the complete agent architecture rather than one possible source of context within a larger execution system.
  • You consider a coherent model response successful without verifying the decision, tool call, state change, or real-world outcome.
  • You rely on an agent framework to provide the system design and are not comfortable reasoning about the control flow, state, permissions, and failure behavior underneath it.
  • You are not interested in owning evaluations, trace analysis, regression testing, and production learning alongside feature development.
  • You prefer fully scoped implementation tasks with stable requirements and limited responsibility for product or operational outcomes.

Benefits

Real ownership: you're not maintaining someone else's codebase, you're building a core, novel part of the product from the ground up.

  • Build at the core. Own a defining part of xHeron’s technology, from the first architectural decisions to production.
  • Shape the direction. Work directly with our CTO, challenge assumptions and help decide what we build, not just how.
  • Grow beyond the job description. We invest in your development, with room to expand your ownership and take on technical leadership as xHeron grows.
  • Share in the upside. Salary plus VSOP participation, so you can benefit from the value you help create.

Our Process

  • Intro call (15-30 min): a conversation with Friedrich (CTO) about your background, what you've built, and why this role.
  • Technical take-home case study: a short, real engineering problem, close to what you'd actually be building.
  • Case study interview (1 hour): you walk us through your thinking, not just the final code.
  • Culture fit (30 min): meet both Founders and make sure it's a fit both ways.

What Makes You a Fit

Kenntnisse im deutschen Rechnungswesen. Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGB und des Umsatzsteuergesetzes.

The Environment

title: Founder's Associate (Praktikum)
description:
TL;DR — alago bringt KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement in die Baubranche. Als Founder's Associate (Praktikum) arbeitest du direkt mit den Foundern, hältst den operativen Maschinenraum am Laufen — Hiring, Ops, Datenschutz, Produkt- und AI-Setup — und übernimmst daneben eigene Projekte, die unser Wachstum beschleunigen. Vollzeit-Praktikum, vor Ort in München, Start Oktober 2026.

Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut.

Tasks

In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren. Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung.

🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3)

Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst:

  • Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation.

  • Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen.

  • Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten.

  • Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist.

  • AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet.

🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3)

Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel:

  • Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren

  • Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen

  • Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten

  • Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten

Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will.

Requirements

Rahmen

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate, Vollzeit

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

Wie du arbeitest

  • Umsetzung & Ownership: Du bringst Dinge zu Ende, ohne dass jemand nachfassen muss. Was du übernimmst, landet nicht im Nirgendwo.

  • Systems Thinker: Du siehst nicht die einzelne Aufgabe, sondern das System dahinter. Statt zehnmal dasselbe manuell zu machen, baust du beim zweiten Mal den Prozess, der es überflüssig macht — und dokumentierst ihn so, dass ihn auch die nächste Person versteht.

  • AI-Fanatiker: Du nutzt KI nicht gelegentlich, sondern reflexhaft. Du hast dir selbst schon Agents, Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (n8n, Zapier, Lovable, Claude Code o. Ä.), probierst neue Modelle und Tools aus, sobald sie rauskommen, und hast eine Meinung dazu, was taugt.

  • Struktur im Chaos: Du schaffst Klarheit in unübersichtlichen Situationen – ob durch eine saubere Notion-Seite, einen organisierten Hiring-Funnel oder ein aufgeräumtes Produkt-Setup.

  • Sorgfalt bei sensiblen Themen: Datenschutz und Dokumentation sind für dich kein lästiges Beiwerk – du arbeitest hier genau und zuverlässig.

Persönlicher Hintergrund

  • DISC-Profil: Du bist extrovertiert und findest eine gute Balance zwischen People- und Task-Fokus

  • Persönliche Eigenschaften: Du bist leidenschaftlich, neugierig, wettbewerbsorientiert und lernbereit / gut coachbar

  • Du bist deiner Leidenschaft gefolgt und hast dir in einem kompetitiven Umfeld (z. B. Projekte, Sport, Musik, Kunst o. Ä.) messbare Erfolge erarbeitet

  • Idealerweise bist du über eine persönliche Empfehlung aus unserem AAA-Netzwerk (Founders, Team, Partner, VCs etc.) auf uns aufmerksam geworden

Pluspunkte

  • Du hast bereits erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt – Praktikum, Werkstudentenjob, eigenes Projekt oder eine studentische Initiative

  • Du hast schon in der Baubranche gearbeitet oder hast einen engen Bezug zu ihr

  • Du hast bereits selbst KI-Automatisierungen oder kleine Tools gebaut (z. B. mit Lovable, n8n, Zapier)

  • Du hast schon in einem schnell wachsenden Startup gearbeitet

Wenn du dich nicht in jedem Punkt wiederfindest, aber überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu alago passt, bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend sind dein Potenzial und deine Lernkurve.

Warum alago?

Die meisten Praktika sind Zuarbeit. Dieses hier ist eine Abkürzung: Du sitzt sechs Monate im Maschinenraum eines Startups, das gerade von elf auf dreißig Leute wächst — und nimmst mit, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.

Was du danach kannst

  1. Du hast ein Hiring von A bis Z begleitet und weißt, wie man gute Leute findet, bewertet und gewinnt.

  2. Du hast interne Systeme selbst gebaut – Automatisierungen, KI-Workflows, Prozesse – und nicht nur bedient.

  3. Du hast gesehen, wie ein Produkt bei echten Kunden ankommt, was es kostet und warum Deals gewonnen oder verloren werden.

  4. Du kannst erklären, wie eine Firma von innen funktioniert: Finanzen, Recht, Datenschutz, Produkt, Vertrieb – keine Blackbox mehr.

Du baust Glaubwürdigkeit auf, bevor deine Kommiliton:innen anfangen

Am Ende hast du keine Liste von Aufgaben im Lebenslauf, sondern Ergebnisse mit deinem Namen dran: Prozesse, die laufen, Leute, die du mit eingestellt hast, Automatisierungen, die noch nach dir funktionieren. Genau das ist die Währung, mit der du danach verhandelst.

Zwei Türen, die danach offen stehen

  1. Eigene Gründung – Du hast aus nächster Nähe gesehen, wie man eine Firma baut: Fundraising, erste Kunden, erste Hires, die Fehler inklusive. Du startest nicht bei null, sondern mit einem inneren Playbook — und mit Zugang zu den Foundern, Coaches und VCs, die dir das ehrlich spiegeln.

  2. Der Startup-Job, den man nicht ausgeschrieben bekommt – Wer bei uns liefert, bekommt eine echte Referenz und Türen ins Münchner Startup-Ökosystem geöffnet. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, reden wir am Ende über eine feste Rolle bei alago.

Wie du dabei wächst

  • Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du bist Tag für Tag Seite an Seite mit Janick (Go-to-Market & Strategy) und Ann-Christin (Product & Domain) — kein Zwischenlayer, kein Praktikanten-Sonderprogramm.

  • Feedback in kurzen Zyklen: Du bekommst gesagt, was gut läuft und was nicht — wöchentlich, nicht zum Abschlussgespräch.

  • Zugang zu erfahrenen Coaches, Trainern und Mentor:innen sowie wöchentlichen Trainings- und Coaching-Sessions.

  • Eine umfangreiche Bibliothek, aus der du dir von den glaubwürdigsten Menschen der Welt etwas abschauen kannst.

Wir bauen für Skalierung – aber gerade ist es noch früh. Das bedeutet viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Feedback-Zyklen und die Freiheit, dich in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die am besten zu deinen Stärken passt – ob Operations, Product, Growth oder eines Tages die eigene Gründung.

  • Read This Before Joining as Employee 1 to 20 at a Startup von Stacy La (Employee #3 bei Clover Health): https://review.firstround.com/read-this-before-joining-as-employee-1-to-20-at-a-startup

  • First Startup Employees – Erfahrungsberichte von frühen Mitarbeitenden bei Wise, GoCardless, Gousto und mehr: https://sifted.eu/articles/first-startup-employees/

Zusätzlich bieten wir:

  • Perks: Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, zweimal pro Woche gemeinsames Team-Dinner sowie Unterstützung beim Relocation-Prozess.

  • Standort WERK1: Arbeiten in einem der aktivsten Innovations- und Startup-Hubs Münchens mit direktem Zugang zur Startup-Community.

  • Vergütung: Faire Praktikumsvergütung.

Closing

1. Schick uns deine Bewerbung

Neben deinem Lebenslauf freuen wir uns über ein kurzes Beispiel, in dem du Verantwortung übernommen oder anderen weitergeholfen hast.

2. Erstgespräch (30 Minuten)

Ein kurzes Kennenlernen mit Janick oder Ann-Christin, um deinen Hintergrund und deine Motivation zu verstehen. Wir erklären dir die Rolle, zeigen das Produkt und beantworten erste Fragen.

3. Case Study / Schnuppertag (halber Tag vor Ort)

Besuche uns in München und arbeite mit uns an einer realistischen Aufgabe – z. B. einen Hiring-Funnel strukturieren, ein Produkt-Setup vorbereiten oder eine interne Automatisierung entwerfen. So bekommst du ein echtes Gefühl für die Arbeit, und wir sehen, wie du denkst und kommunizierst.

4. Entscheidung

Du erhältst innerhalb von 24 Stunden Rückmeldung. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt – freuen wir uns sehr auf die Zusammenarbeit! 🎉

title: Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d)
description:
About ALVA Energie

At ALVA Energie, we’re driving the energy transition forward! With solar operator models for apartment buildings and commercial properties, we offer a comprehensive, worry-free package: from installation and management to the operation of PV systems as an energy supplier. Our goal is to make the decentralized energy transition simple and accessible. 🌞

As a growing startup in Berlin, we value teamwork, responsibility, and active participation. Everyone has the opportunity to actively contribute to our growth and share their ideas. Together, we’re working toward a sustainable future. 🚀

About your role

We think: impact over headcount! At our company, FP&A doesn't grow with the volume of work, but with its impact on the business. Data preparation, variance commentary and standard reports belong to automation and agents. Our people's time belongs to what machines can't do: judgment, model logic, challenge and decisions. If an additional hire enables significantly more impact, we grow. But never to absorb manual work that is better built than distributed.

You are the first dedicated hire in FP&A, start as an Individual Contributor and work directly with the CFO and management. Our existing models and tools have grown organically and are partly manual. You understand them, keep what works, rebuild the rest and automate consistently. With AI agents, you build the leverage that elsewhere would take an entire team.

Outlook: The path to Head of FP&A is open, but not planned for the short term. Your responsibility grows with the impact you create, not with team size.

Your responsibilities

As the Senior Manager / Lead FP&AI (m/w/d), you will drive financial planning, analysis, and artificial intelligence initiatives to support our growing operations.

  • Rebuild the FP&A foundation: current-state assessment, target architecture, budget, rolling forecast and multi-year planning

  • Build and maintain integrated, driver-based financial models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) for projects, the portfolio and the group, including multi-entity planning and intercompany

  • Develop the KPI framework and prepare management, board, investor and bank reporting with clear recommendations for action

  • Run scenario and sensitivity analyses and conduct deep dives on investments, financing, pricing and portfolio prioritization

  • Build and operate agentic AI workflows for forecasting, anomaly detection, variance commentary and reporting, incl. guardrails and governance

  • Close collaboration with the Data Team: you bring the finance logic and are the most demanding user of the data

  • Evaluate and implement suitable FP&A tools and manage tool and AI costs (FinOps)

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of experience in FP&A, controlling or strategic finance, ideally in a high-growth, complex environment

  • Very good financial modeling skills (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and understanding of complex financial and intercompany structures

  • Experience in rebuilding or redesigning planning and reporting processes, as well as with planning and BI tools

  • Hands-on mentality and enjoyment in building structures yourself

  • Strong communication skills: you convince management, investors, banks and business functions

Ideally you bring:

  • Energy sector experience, ideally solar/renewables, or other project-based business models

  • Multi-entity planning, intercompany and investor/bank reporting

  • Good German language skills

  • Experience with Claude or other AI coding tools and agentic workflows

In addition, we value the following skills:

  • Tech affinity: You see new tools and AI as leverage, not as a threat

  • Openness to change: You approach change positively and with agility

  • Impact mindset: For every analysis, you ask which decision it enables, and for every task: "Does a human need to do this, and where does it create the greatest impact?"

  • Entrepreneurial thinking: You always consider financial decisions in the context of growth, market opportunities and overall strategy

  • Drive to shape: You look at an organically grown Excel model and know what to keep, what to rebuild and what an agent can take over

  • You are motivated by the mission to advance the energy transition

Here’s what you can expect from us:

With your ideas, you’ll have the chance to enrich our dynamic team and actively help shape the future of solar energy at a rapidly growing startup!

  • Flat hierarchies, quick decision-making, and direct communication in a relaxed and positive work environment

  • Creative freedom—with us, you’ll have 100% responsibility for what you do and will have the opportunity to grow through challenges

  • Close collaboration with the founders, leading to a steep learning curve

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home ensure a good work-life balance

  • A modern office in the heart of Berlin with excellent BVG transit connections (e.g., Nordbahnhof, Rosenthaler Platz)

  • A fully stocked kitchen with coffee, soft drinks, and snacks available around the clock

  • Regular team lunches and other team events

  • We offer attractive subsidies for Urban Sports Club, a JobRad bike, and public transportation

description:
Technology that speaks your language

Domera Labs builds Ami, the first AI companion for seniors. Ami brings the power of a smartphone into a more human form: voice-first and deeply personalized

We at Domera Labs are rethinking human-machine interaction from first principles by introducing a better interface to interact with technology: voice

By combining the most intuitive hardware design with frontier AI, Ami makes AI accessible for the fastest growing demographic worldwide. The goal is to make the everyday life older adults more seamless, while addressing that generation's biggest challenge: loneliness and isolation. With Ami we are building the category leader of a new hardware paradigm by building a full standalone device (and not a gadget) that aims to makes the smartphones of today redundant.

The underlying technology of Ami combines a model-agnostic streaming pipeline consisting of proprietary models and off-the-shelf frontier models to create a hyper-personalized and proactive user experience. The backbone of Ami is built by our foundational lab that builds a social intelligence model that is optimized for social interaction, human behavior and interpersonal skills.

Domera Labs has secured large distribution agreements, a model co-development partnership with a leading AI lab, and ODM manufacturing proposals. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of human-machine interaction, mass-consumer facing hardware and shape frontier research with social/non-quantifiable benchmarking.


Core Responsibilities

You own the software that makes Ami work. Your primary responsibility is to architect, write and ship the on-device application and services for our mass-market consumer device, from voice interaction and cloud connectivity to onboarding, recovery and everyday reliability. You will work directly with our ODM and silicon partners to integrate that software with the underlying platform.

Our target hardware uses a Qualcomm SoC with Android/AOSP or embedded Linux depending on the final platform selection.

Our users are 75 years old and there is no screen, no settings menu, and no IT support. If the device does not work out of the box, it fails. Your job is to make the following work.

  • On-device application: build and own Ami's application and services, including interaction logic, real-time audio streaming, cloud communication, local state and recovery from network interruptions or service failures

  • Device identity and fleet management: provisioning, unique device identity, secure key storage, and the systems that let us know what every unit in the field is doing

  • The maintenance channel: a reliable service and diagnostics path to the device (BLE, USB-C, or both) for field debugging, factory test, and recovery

  • Out-of-the-box experience: first-boot network onboarding that a senior can complete alone, with no screen and no smartphone as a crutch. This is the single highest-stakes piece of the product

  • Flash and update management: partition layout, A/B OTA with rollback, staged fleet rollouts, and bricking as a category of bug that never happens

  • Base platform behaviors: boot and recovery, factory and soft resets, button and LED mappings, audio feedback, power states and battery behavior

  • The audio front end: working with our ODM and silicon partners on mic array, echo cancellation, wake word, and the latency budget from mic to first spoken token

  • Bringing the device through EVT, DVT, and PVT with our ODM as the technical counterpart on our side

 

What we are looking for

  • ⁠A builder's mindset: ship > fail > learn > improve

  • Stay focused when multiple priorities compete and the ranking is unclear

  • Work seamlessly across research and engineering

  • Can navigate ambiguity and make progress in fast-moving research environments

  • This is a founding-level position. You will work directly with the founders, shape the architecture from the ground up, and see your work in users' hands within months, not years.

 

Technical Requirements

  • You have shipped a connected consumer device to production, not just to a demo table. You know what goes wrong between DVT and mass production

  • Strong hands-on experience building production device applications and services on Android/AOSP, using Kotlin or Java and C/C++ for native components and hardware integration. You can own the on-device application end to end, including background execution, connectivity, audio and integration with platform services. Experience with embedded Linux is a plus; Python proficiency for tooling and testing is expected.

  • Experience developing for AOSP-based devices beyond standard smartphone apps: integrating privileged applications and services, working with system permissions and hardware interfaces, and collaborating with an ODM or silicon vendor on the underlying platform. Qualcomm platform experience is a plus.

  • Wireless connectivity in the real world: Wi-Fi provisioning, BLE, and ideally cellular. You have debugged a device that would not join a network in someone's home

  • OTA and flash: bootloaders, secure boot, A/B partitioning, rollback, and staged rollouts across a fleet

  • You can diagnose issues across application code, platform services and hardware interfaces

  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather ship and measure than debate

  • Bonus: real-time audio pipelines (I2S, DSP, AEC, wake word), on-device ML inference, factory test and manufacturing line bring-up, regulatory certification (CE, FCC), power optimization for battery life, experience in NLU / NLP

 

We lean toward senior engineers who can independently own production device software, but demonstrated ownership matters more than years of experience. Experience integrating real-time AI services into a consumer product is a plus.

 

What you get

  • ⁠Founding-team equity and a real say in technical direction

  • ⁠A product with signed launch partners, not a demo in search of a market

  • ⁠A small team, short decision paths

  • Cash compensation range of CHF 80 - 100k with significant equity incentives

  • Opportunity to shape the future of hardware and social intelligent AI models


We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role

RevenueCat helps apps of all shapes and sizes make more money across mobile, the web, and a growing list of other platforms like Roku, Amazon, and even AR through support for Vision Pro. As a result, many different types of users log in and use RevenueCat on a day-to-day basis. Product managers, support reps, lifecycle marketers, user acquisition specialists, data analysts, executives: the list goes on.

Communicating the growing breadth of use cases supported by RevenueCat in a way that makes sense for all those different types of businesses, apps, and users is a challenge. And that’s where product marketing comes in.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team led by Francie. Each Senior PMM owns a product area end-to-end, partnering with that area's product managers on positioning, messaging, and go-to-market. This is not a segment-specific role: RevenueCat serves everyone from solo indie developers to top-tier enterprise apps, often through the very same product surface, so you'll craft messaging and channels that flex across that full spectrum. This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Knows APIs and SDKs like their ABCs. Code may not be your craft, but you know how to talk the talk. Software developers are one of our core audiences, and they can smell BS a mile away. You can debug marketing messaging so it resonates with technical audiences, and craft narratives around the 1’s and 0’s that still land with business stakeholders.

  • Captains their own ship. You have a strong bias toward action and you’re not afraid to get your hands dirty on execution. Whether it’s juggling strategic and tactical work or navigating shifting priorities, you thrive on autonomy and love making things happen.

  • Distills collaborative chaos. You’re comfortable raising your hand and getting what you need from a dynamic and technical organization. Whether it’s nudging engineers for product updates or rallying Sales for customer stories, you can navigate the chaos and advocate for what the GTM org needs.

  • Gets excited about the unexpected. At RevenueCat we take shipping seriously, and are constantly adapting our product and strategies to meet the needs of developers. You see changes in direction and shifts in strategy as an opportunity to flex your creative muscles and learn on the fly.

  • Is a little quirky. You love a whimsical side quest and you can see the soft side of software. We pride ourselves in keeping our community on their toes with unique swag, challenges and events. You can play as big a role as you’d like in helping to brainstorm and bring these quirky concepts to life.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • GTM and adoption campaigns: Own key product areas to deeply understand the features we’re launching and the use cases and needs behind them. Craft compelling communication plans both within the organization, and to existing and prospective customers.

  • Lifecycle campaign building: Working with our marketing operations team to execute insight-based lifecycle campaigns to drive adoption, retention and community.

  • Web page design and optimization: Translate product messaging and customer understanding into visually compelling and highly converting web experiences with the help of our external web development agency. You’ll chart the vision for the story our website tells and the illustrations, animations and tools we create to convey it.

  • Case studies and testimonials: Organizing, facilitating, and translating customer interviews into compelling case studies and testimonials that showcase the value of RevenueCat.

  • Internal enablement: As an expert in your areas of product focus, you’ll empower developer-facing teams with the resources and training they need to support developers and ensure their success.

  • Market insights: Keeping your finger on the pulse of the mobile app industry and competitors to inform go-to-market strategies and uncover new opportunities for growth.

  • Whimsical side quests: Taking on unique projects with minimal instruction, coordinating the collection of 1000 screenshots to launch Paywalls.com, designing, printing and shipping a calendar of cat photos, hosting the World Paywall Speed Building Championships, or crafting a keynote speech for leadership. You’ll get to work on projects that stretch your creative muscles.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Marketing within a B2B or B2D SaaS environment, preferably targeting developers or software companies. RevenueCat runs a hybrid motion - self-serve/PLG for indie developers alongside a sales-assisted motion for larger accounts - so experience with either end of that spectrum is valuable; you won't need to have done both to succeed here.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist to own payroll processing and compliance for our workforce across the US and Europe. You will be the main contact between the company and our US EOR provider and international payroll advisors (UK, US, Poland, Portugal, Estonia, Germany). For European entities that run payroll locally, you will receive their payroll data, keep one accurate record of who sits on which entity's books, and consolidate it into group-level reporting. You will also own benefits administration, the annual renewal cycle, and pensions in every country where we operate.

The job covers more than processing. You will run live payroll cycles accurately and also improve how payroll works: writing SOPs, tightening controls, consolidating reporting, managing providers, and supporting audits. Over time you will reduce our reliance on third-party providers by moving payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, including setting up payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership. You will work closely with People, Finance, payroll providers, benefits brokers, pension providers, and auditors, and you will be the person employees go to for fast, accurate answers on pay, pension, and benefits. Responsibilities

  • Run UK and US payroll cycles from start to finish: validate all inputs (new hires, leavers, salary changes, bonuses, commissions, time off), review every payroll register, and coordinate with the US EOR and international payroll advisors.

  • Act as the main contact for European entities that run their own payroll: receive monthly payroll data, reconcile it against HRIS headcount, and keep a single accurate record of who sits on which entity's books.

  • Own statutory filings and tax portal access for UK and US payroll, and produce consolidated group payroll reporting to support month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, and audit.

  • Administer benefits and pension schemes in every country: enrollments, changes, leaver removals, entity transfers, reconciliations to payroll and provider invoices, and the annual renewal cycle with brokers and providers.

  • Move payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, covering statutory registration, data migration, parallel running, and cutover. Set up and run payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership.

  • Build and maintain the payroll operating rhythm (calendars, SOPs, controls, knowledge-base materials) with regular audits across payroll, HRIS, benefits, and provider data.

  • Hold external providers and country contacts to agreed timescales, and resolve discrepancies before they reach an employee's pay.

  • Answer employee questions on pay, pension, and benefits quickly, accurately, and confidentially, against a published response standard.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • Direct coordination of EOR providers, payroll advisors, or local payroll contacts across multiple countries. You hold providers to deadlines, check their outputs, and consolidate data into a reliable group view.

  • You have owned UK payroll cycles from start to finish, have credible US payroll exposure (direct processing, EOR coordination, or advisor management), and have reconciled payroll against HRIS or entity data across several countries.

  • Benefits and pensions administration experience, including enrollments, leavers, provider invoices, payroll deductions, UK auto-enrollment, member data, and annual renewals.

  • Payroll migration or entity setup experience: you have supported or led a move from an external provider or EOR to in-house processing (statutory registration, data migration, parallel running, cutover, provider exit), or set up payroll for a new entity.

  • You have built payroll systems, processes, controls, calendars, and documentation from scratch or in a very immature environment, and can turn compliance requirements into workflows that hold up under live payroll deadlines.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience running a payroll migration from an external provider to in-house processing yourself.

We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. The team:

Join our Customer Success department as a Salesforce & Tooling Lead, where you will own the strategic direction and day-to-day operation of our Salesforce ecosystem – spanning both Enterprise and consumer environments. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role in which you will line-manage a small team of Salesforce Administrators while serving as the primary technical expert for our Agentforce deployment and broader Salesforce architecture.

Based in London or Paris and on-site five days a week, you will work closely with Operations, Quality Assurance, Knowledge, Enterprise and other cross-functional stakeholders to drive scalable, high-quality tooling solutions that enable our global customer base to receive best-in-class support.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead, mentor and line-manage a team of Salesforce Administrators, setting clear objectives, providing technical guidance and supporting their professional development.

  • Own the strategic direction and operational health of Ledger’s Enterprise and consumer Salesforce environments, acting as primary system administrator for objects, flows, security and overall org health.

  • Act as the subject-matter expert on Agentforce, owning its maintenance, troubleshooting and enhancement.

  • Design and build custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce-native tooling, working with Customer Success leadership and cross-functional teams to turn business requirements into scalable solutions.

  • Own and scale Service Cloud (including Omni-Channel), Experience Cloud portals and integrations with external enterprise systems, evaluating third-party tooling where it extends Salesforce.

  • Own release management, CI/CD and the development backlog in JIRA, keeping releases stable and secure and prioritisation transparent, and lead technical projects from discovery through deployment.

  • Drive platform governance: define best practices, enforce data protection and retention policies, and maintain technical documentation.

  • Lead AI initiatives, beyond Agentforce, that improve efficiency and customer experience across Customer Success.

What we’re looking for

  • Able to work on-site five days a week in our London or Paris office.

  • A minimum of five years’ hands-on Salesforce experience in high-volume B2B and/or B2C environments, including Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, API integrations and CI/CD.

  • Proven experience operating and troubleshooting Agentforce (core requirement; general AI chatbot experience is not a substitute).

  • Deep expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce architecture.

  • Demonstrated experience leading a Salesforce team, with the confidence to coach, delegate and hold others accountable.

  • Salesforce certified as Administrator, Platform App Builder and Platform Developer; Service Cloud Consultant and Agentforce Specialist are a strong advantage.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
About Refractal

Refractal is an AI security company building the infrastructure organisations need to defend against autonomous AI threats. 2026 has shown that generally capable intelligence is here. The challenge now is modernising security to stop AI-enabled threats, whether they come from internal agents going rogue or from attackers using AI to become more dangerous.

Refractal was founded on cybersecurity and AI expertise from MIT, Microsoft, NASA and the U.S. Navy. Our product lets organisations detect AI-enabled threats at low cost without sacrificing detection quality. We take a practical approach to AI risk, combining proven cybersecurity methods with frontier AI security research.

Today, we work with governments and organisations that can't afford to get security wrong. We're backed by leading deep-tech and cybersecurity investors and are growing the team to deliver on this mission.

The role

Own the services and infrastructure that keep Refractal secure and reliable in production. You will work across the enforcement runtime, data integrity, tenant isolation, agent tracing, model services, and cloud infrastructure.

Build systems that connect activity across agents, services, and tools, evaluate risk, apply decisions, and preserve the evidence behind them.

What you'll work on

  • Build and operate a low-latency runtime enforcement pipeline with predictable failure behaviour.

  • Own observability and tracing across agent actions, tool calls, model calls, and enforcement decisions.

  • Build tamper-evident evidence storage and enforce multi-tenant isolation throughout every data path.

  • Create reliable event and streaming services with safe handling for load, retries, backpressure, and disconnections.

  • Build infrastructure for red-team jobs, evaluation workloads, and model-serving services.

  • Own cloud infrastructure, continuous delivery, secrets, artefact verification, and production trust boundaries.

What we're looking for

A systems engineer who reasons carefully about latency, failure, isolation, integrity, and cost, and uses measurements rather than assumptions.

  • Strong experience with backend, distributed, or infrastructure systems; Python experience is preferred.

  • Production observability and distributed tracing experience, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar tooling.

  • Experience building responsive services under load with correct timeout, retry, and backpressure behaviour.

  • Experience with Postgres, Row-Level Security, migrations, and multi-tenant access-control testing.

  • Hands-on experience with containers, cloud infrastructure, continuous delivery, and operational security.

  • The ability to work independently and own technically ambiguous production problems.

Our values

Radical transparency. We believe the best work happens when everyone feels able to give and receive honest, constructive feedback.

Public service. We see AI security as a form of public service. Getting the AI transition right means putting the right infrastructure in place to manage the threats that come with it, and our work helps protect the institutions and services society depends on.

Fail fast. We test ideas early, seek feedback and learn quickly. We experiment rapidly and change course when something isn't working, without compromising on security.

Pragmatism, not dogmatism. We choose approaches based on how well they solve the problem. That means combining established cybersecurity methods with frontier AI research, questioning our assumptions, and changing our minds when the evidence changes.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary, meaningful equity, and a performance-linked bonus.

  • Direct influence over the product, architecture, engineering standards, and company direction.

  • A clear path to technical leadership as the engineering team grows.

  • London-based, in-person work, with UK Skilled Worker visa sponsorship and support for Global Talent applications.
