title: Purchasing & Supply Chain
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

 

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

 

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

 

About you and this role

We’re looking for a Purchaser who’s organised, proactive, and ready to help build our supply chain from the ground up. You’ll play a key role in making sure we have the right parts at the right time to keep our robot production running smoothly. This includes working with suppliers, tracking lead times, placing orders, managing stock levels, and helping set up the tools and processes we need - starting with spreadsheets and later helping us move to an ERP system. You’ll also work closely with engineers to get drawings and specifications, check them for completeness, and make sure suppliers have what they need to deliver parts that meet our requirements.

You will own, and iterate on our existing procurement systems and built new ones to reduce lead times in our supply chain. Monumental is a unique company in that we’re solving the problem of on-site construction with a vertically integrated offering. We’re a hard tech company doing real R&D, financed through venture funding. We manufacture our hardware in-house, run a fully equipped workshop, manage a complex supply chain, and deploy masonry robots to construction sites across the Netherlands, and the UK.

You’ll be part of a small and growing operations team, and solving real-world problems every day. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys the mix of structured systems thinking and the unpredictability of a fast-moving software-enabled robotic solution.

Note: we are unable to support relocation for this role. Applicants must be based in the Netherlands, and able to commute onsite to Amsterdam to be considered.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work with other teams (especially engineering) to help predict what parts we’ll need to build our robots, so we can order the right items on time.

  • Help set up and maintain our Bill of Materials (BoM).

  • Find, qualify, and manage suppliers — bringing in new ones and phasing out underperforming ones.

  • Set delivery expectations and follow up with suppliers on delays, quality issues, or inventory problems.

  • Handle the sourcing and ordering of tools, materials, and supplies needed for production.

  • Build and improve simple processes (initially using spreadsheets) to manage stock levels and avoid shortages or overstocking

  • Provide ongoing financial forecasts of spend related to production and R&D

  • Take an active role in setting up our future ERP system and help migrate procurement and inventory processes into it.

  • Create clear processes to help supply chain, warehouse, and production teams work better together

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in a purchasing, procurement, or supply chain coordination role (ideally in a manufacturing or hardware environment, startup experience a bonus)

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets (e.g. Excel or Google Sheets) for tracking orders, inventory, and suppliers

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

  • Basic understanding of supply chain principles, lead times, and inventory control

  • Experience communicating with suppliers and managing purchase orders

  • Proactive, hands-on attitude — able to take ownership and get things moving in a startup-like environment

  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken

Nice-To-Haves

  • Experience helping implement or work with an ERP system (e.g. NetSuite, Odoo, SAP, etc.)

  • Familiarity with hardware bills of materials (BoMs)

  • Exposure to supplier onboarding and qualification processes

  • Interest in robotics, hardware, or high-tech manufacturing

  • Experience working across teams like production, engineering, and warehouse

  • Degree in supply chain management, logistics, engineering, business, or a related field

  • Relevant experience can substitute for formal education — we value hands-on skills and a proactive mindset over titles

  • Ability to communicate verbally and written in Mandarin

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. You will play an important role in protecting DataSnipper's information systems, product, and customer data from security threats while ensuring the resilience and availability of our IT infrastructure. You will work closely with all departments, alongside the other Security team members.

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

  • Contribute to defining, implementing, and maintaining information security policies

  • Operate risk assessment and internal security control activities, including tracking and monitoring remediation actions

  • Support compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and other relevant frameworks; actively contribute to the annual SOC 2 audit process, including evidence collection and day-to-day auditor communication

  • Support and deliver employee training and awareness initiatives to drive adoption of guidelines and policies

  • Provide support for client requests related to the security topics

  • Monitor and respond to security incidents, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate reporting collaborating with the relevant teams

  • 2–5 years of experience in information security, with demonstrated ownership of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and associated audits

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About the role

We're hiring a GTM Engineer to build and run the Data, Systems & AI Engineering layer underneath DataSnipper's GTM and Business Operations stack. This is the build function: if RevOps decides what the ICP is, who owns which territory, and what counts as a qualified opportunity, this team turns those decisions into the systems that actually run them.

That's a bigger remit than any one tool. You'll own the CRM data architecture, build the enrichment and signal infrastructure that feeds it, run the integrations and governance holding the wider stack together (Clay, Snowflake, Gong, and more), and build the automations and AI agents that turn all of it into something Marketing, Sales, CS, and BD run on every day. You decide how the whole engine is put together, working across every function rather than waiting inside one for requests.

Where the function stands today

We are building this function from scratch, and therefore you will have the opportunity to lay out the foundations of what a world class AI GTM Engineering team can look like in a fast paced AI company. We are looking for a team that can take and build upon the existing state- Marketing has built real foundation where enrichment runs steadily, AI nurturing agents are live and lifting reply rates, intent signals flow in from across the funnel, and HubSpot is trusted as the data model of record for accounts, contacts, deals, and lifecycle stages.
This team will be building the next next frontier: own integrations and vendor tooling (Gong, Snowflake, Clay, Default AI, Common Room, dialers) end to end instead of managing them reactively, and turn data governance - who can touch shared CRM objects, what change control looks like - from a principle into enforced practice. Beyond that, there's a funnel zone each for Sales, CS, and BD still waiting to be built out, on top of the intelligence Marketing already relies on.

We need operators who are instinctively drawn to turning manual process into clean systems, and ungoverned data into governed infrastructure. People who've spent their growth, marketing, sales, or RevOps careers quietly building automations and tightening the infrastructure underneath their own work, and are ready to do both full-time inside a function that already has shape and runway.

What you will be doing

CRM & data architecture

  • Administer and evolve the HubSpot data model: accounts, contacts, deals, and lifecycle stages.

  • Implement lead routing, ICP, and territory logic into the CRM per rules RevOps defines - you build it, RevOps owns what it means.

  • Implement rules of engagement (ROE) - handoff criteria and account rules - into CRM workflows, automation, and Clay infrastructure that execute them reliably.

Enrichment & signals

  • Build and maintain enrichment via Clay and providers such as ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, and Starbridge.

  • Run TAM analysis and intent-data infrastructure, and keep data quality high through continuous enrichment workflows.

  • Decide which signals matter, how to surface them, and how to route them to the people who should act on them.

  • Be the mirror and advisor to the business teams through your work

Integrations, tooling & governance

  • Own GTM tool integrations end to end (Gong, Snowflake, Clay, Default AI, Starbridge, dialers, Common Room, or equivalent) so data flows cleanly with no duplicate or conflicting records.

  • Apply data governance standards: review automation that touches shared CRM objects, and respect change control on the data model.

  • Shape vendor and tool decisions - fit, overlap, integration complexity - so we consolidate instead of running five tools for one job.

Automation & AI build

  • Build and maintain the core Clay & Lemlist infrastructure: account data, enrichment, sequences, templates, and how contacts flow in and out.

  • Develop account scoring models and standardized Clay functions that Sales and Marketing can use without building their own underlying workflows.

  • Build agents, automations, and AI-assisted workflows in Claude, Default AI, and connected tooling.

Activate the build across every funnel zone

  • Marketing (inbound signal → MQL): inbound enrichment and routing, audience activation, intent signal infrastructure. Drive signal-based outbound - detect a buying moment (hiring, funding, leadership change, product usage shift), find the decision-maker, enrich, send.

  • Sales (SQL → Closed Won → Renewal → Expansion): prospecting automation, account planning tooling, rep efficiency. Build lifecycle expansion plays triggered by product signals so CS and AEs get prompted when an account is ready to expand.

  • BD (outbound signal → partner + BD pipeline): partner signal workflows, account intelligence, BD-specific outreach and pipeline automation.

  • CS (Closed Won → Adoption + Health): onboarding automation, health-score workflows, renewal and expansion signal tooling.

Partner with Ops

  • Work through a request → brief → build → feedback model. Ops people are the interface; they translate field needs into precise briefs you execute against.

  • Functions consume what you build rather than configuring or building it themselves, and feedback routes back through Ops - keeping your time focused on builds, not ad hoc asks or slides.

What we're looking for

The mindset matters more than the title on your CV.

  • 2-4 years in RevOps, marketing/sales/CS operations, data/CRM administration, or a closely adjacent role. Prior GTM Engineering experience is a plus, not a requirement - the strongest people in this discipline today are crossovers.

  • AI fluency you actually use. You've been integrating LLMs, automations, and agents into your work for a while. You can talk concretely about what works, what breaks, and what's still a hack.

  • A builder's mentality. When you hit a wall, you build the thing rather than file a ticket. You pick up Lovable, Bolt, n8n, or whatever new tool surfaces. You've shipped automations that touched real revenue.

  • Comfort owning infrastructure, not just automations. You own a data model, an integration, or a governance rule as confidently as you own the plumbing - not just what sits on top of it.

  • A commercial bias. You ask “does this help close a deal?” before “is this elegant?” You measure your work in meetings booked and pipeline influenced.

  • Cross-functional comfort. You can move between marketing, sales, CS, and engineering languages without losing the room.

Tools you'll work with (willingness to ramp matters more than checklist completeness):

  • CRM and data architecture: HubSpot

  • Enrichment and orchestration: Clay, ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, Starbridge

  • Integrations: Gong, Snowflake, Default AI, dialers, Common Room

  • AI tooling: Claude Enterprise (Projects, Skills, and MCP integrations all unlocked), plus ChatGPT, and a flexible stack. Think: n8n, Lovable, Bolt.

  • Workflow automation: Zapier, HubSpot workflows

Bonus: SQL, Python, or TypeScript. The real signal is willingness to learn by tinkering.

title: Staff Product Manager - Trips
description:
Hi! 👋 I'm Steven, Lead Product Manager at WeTravel

I'm hiring a Staff PM to own Trips, the domain where every trip comes to life. Ten thousand travel businesses build, present, and sell their trips with WeTravel, from boutique agencies to student travel operators running hundreds of departures a year, which makes this both the surface their teams spend most of their working day in and the first thing their travelers ever see. You'll own it end to end: the trip page they sell with, and the content and AI engine that crafts it, and the content specialists who build our library, who will report to you.

About WeTravel

Travel gives people new experiences and brings them together, sometimes in life-changing ways. That's especially the case for group travel and multi-day travel (think of a 7-day safari in the Serengeti, a 5-day scuba diving trip in the Galápagos, or a multi-week pilgrimage) where travelers get to really immerse themselves. Passionate travel organizers make this magic happen, and WeTravel is here to support them.

Multi-day travel businesses use WeTravel as their end-to-end operating system: publishing trip offerings, generating and converting leads, processing payments around the world, paying suppliers and vendors. WeTravel helps them grow sales, save time, and save money, so they can focus on delivering incredible bucket-list experiences.

WeTravel is a 400+ person company representing more than 50 countries. We combine global diversity with the agility and closeness of a much smaller team. More than 90 colleagues are based in our Amsterdam office in Rokin, including the entire Product Org and most of our Engineering team.

You will have fun innovating fast with brilliant, low-ego colleagues. Our clients are also easy to reach, which helps us stay close to their needs and build with them.

Financially, WeTravel is highly secure and growing fast, with 50 to 100 percent year-over-year growth depending on the metric. This gives us a strong foundation to build from.

About the Role

This is the domain where our biggest bet is playing out. Building and selling a great multi-day trip is a lot of work: crafting a story worth booking, assembling the content that tells it, and presenting it all in a page a traveler trusts. Our goal is to cut that turnaround down so organizers get back to their client faster, convert more of them, and sell more trips. It also has to hold up as they grow, because a boutique agency selling bespoke trips and a student travel operator running hundreds of departures are building on the same tools. The way we get there is great technology in the hands of organizers and their teams. You will own that end to end, the experience and the engine behind it.

What you'll work on

WeTravel Trips give organizers the tools to create proposals, detailed itineraries and a high-conversion booking experience, while giving them time back to grow and operate their business.

We're now looking for a Staff PM to take this domain through its next phase of growth, and make WeTravel the best software for travel businesses to build, present and sell their trips.

Our success in this domain will drive the growth of our organizers by expanding in several areas:

  • An integrated building experience that helps organizers find the right content and craft the right trip for the right travelers.

  • Shared libraries that pay off most when a team works from them, so every proposal that leaves the company is consistent, beautiful, and unmistakably theirs, whoever wrote it.

  • AI-enabled tools to imagine and create new trips, produce world class content, and optimize their sales funnel.

  • Trip pages organizers can publish and promote wherever their travelers are.

1/ Designing the trip page and selling the trip

Think of the trip page as the product detail page of the travel industry. It is where an organizer's work becomes something a traveler wants, understands, and buys.

  • Dynamic Trip Builder: Intuitive tools for organizers to create their trip offerings, in the languages their travelers read, on WeTravel and beyond it.

  • Day by day itineraries: the plan that makes a trip feel real before anyone has booked it, built fast and kept accurate as the trip changes.

  • High converting pages and proposals: whether an organizer publishes a trip for the world or sends a tailored proposal to one client, the result has to look professional, capture travelers' imaginations, and turn interest into a booking.

  • Mobile app for travelers: once they have booked, travelers carry the trip page in their pocket, with everything they need before and during it.

2/ The content and AI engine that turns hours of work into minutes

  • WeTravel Library: a curated library of properties, activities, and reusable content on its way to 20,000 properties, so organizers build with high quality content.

  • The organizer's own library: their photos, their descriptions, their reusable blocks, so a growing team sells in one voice instead of rewriting content from scratch.

  • AI-assisted building: Copilot that drafts and improves trips inside the builder, so organizers start from a strong draft rather than an empty page.

And the team behind it. Our content specialists will report to you, and you will own the content strategy, the regional prioritization, and the pipeline that keeps the library growing.

I'm looking for an experienced, generalist product manager to lead this domain end-to-end. You will deeply study travel organizers' needs, prioritize them, come up with solutions (or hypotheses to test), drive all necessary functions to build and launch the solutions, drive adoption, and ultimately grow our revenue and profit. You will also manage our content team, and you will have direct and continuous access to C-level executives to ideate and create products.

If you've ever wanted to empower businesses with innovative tech and have fun in a well-funded rocketship in the heart of Amsterdam, this is it.

An Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate would bring a track record of exceptional results and a well-rounded product management skill set, especially the ability to break down any problem and drive high-velocity execution.

Must-haves:

  • Deep product management experience owning real outcomes, not just execution.

    • 10+ years in product management is ideal (for staff level)

    • 7+ years is minimum (for senior level)

  • Travel industry knowledge.

  • Comfortable being accountable for product-led commercial outcomes, not just features shipped.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder leadership across sales / account management, engineering, design.

  • Growth and experimentation mindset, with the judgment to decide without perfect data. Willing to ship, learn, and iterate.

  • Data self-sufficient. You can pull your own numbers, find where a funnel leaks, and size the opportunity before asking for engineering time.

Things that will likely help you in this particular role:

  • You have owned a builder, editor or CMS-like product where the artifact your users create is what earns them money.

  • You have shipped AI features that people kept using, and you can tell the difference between a good demo and real adoption.

  • You have treated content as product, not as someone else's job, and have worked with or led a content operation.

  • Experience with public APIs, webhooks, or platform work.

  • Experience managing people, even a small team or a dotted line.

Interview process

Our process aims to be high-signal and help you learn about WeTravel and our people. Two interviews will be realistic working sessions. No take-home assignments. The whole process will take only a few weeks.

Screen

  • Recruiter screen (30 min): introduction, background, motivation.

1st round

  • Hiring manager interview (60 min): your background in depth, the role, your questions.

2nd round

  • Live whiteboard session (60 min, onsite): a real Trips decision worked through together, for example Trip page redesign, Copilot scope, or Library content prioritization. Assesses structured thinking, clear reasoning out loud, and product judgment under incomplete information.

  • Team working session (45 min): with a Product Manager, an Engineering Manager, and a Designer: Working through your product management experience, plus a UX collaboration exercise.

3rd round

  • CEO conversation (30 min): A two-way discussion about mission, ambition, and culture.


A Final Note

Our clients are entrepreneurs and artisans who pour their passion into creating bucket-list experiences. Helping them grow their businesses is what motivates us, and what would motivate the right PM for the Trips domain. If that resonates, I'd love to meet you.

Steven

You contribute to developing, shaping and articulating product vision, strategy, objectives and goals. What you'll do

As a Product Designer, you’ll help shape complex enterprise products from early discovery through to production. You’ll translate what you learn into user flows, information architectures, wireframes, interfaces and prototypes, continuously refining your designs based on evidence and feedback.

Together with Product Managers, you’ll help shape product vision, strategy and priorities, bringing the customer perspective into roadmap and investment decisions. You’ll facilitate workshops and discovery sessions and help define meaningful user outcomes and measures of success. You’ll also help maintain and evolve Assai’s design system, ensuring a consistent, accessible and high-quality experience across the product. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll provide clear design guidance and help ensure the final implementation matches the intended experience.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Designing coherent end-to-end experiences for complex enterprise workflows, from concept to production.

  • Planning and conducting customer research, synthesizing insights into actionable product opportunities.

  • Collaborating with Product and Engineering to shape product direction, priorities and outcomes.

  • Evolving the design system, interaction patterns and visual language while maintaining accessibility and usability.

  • Advocating for customer-centered, evidence-based design and sharing knowledge across the organization.

What you bring

You’re an experienced Product Designer who enjoys getting to the heart of complex problems. You combine strong design craft with curiosity about customers, products and technology, and you’re comfortable moving between research, discovery, strategy and hands-on design.

You have at least five years of experience in Product Design, UX Design or a similar role, ideally working on complex enterprise or SaaS products. A degree in Product Design, Interaction Design, UX, HCI, Psychology or a related field is helpful, but equivalent practical experience is equally valuable.

You understand how to turn customer needs and evidence into meaningful product opportunities. You’re comfortable planning and conducting research, facilitating workshops, exploring ideas through prototypes and testing concepts with users. You can translate these insights into clear, intuitive experiences and work with Product Managers to connect design decisions to product strategy and outcomes.

You’re also a strong hands-on designer. You’re highly proficient in Figma and familiar with modern product design and research tools. An understanding of front-end development, responsive design and component-based frameworks such as Material UI is a plus.

Just as important, you enjoy working with people. You communicate clearly, tell compelling stories and can bring customers, stakeholders, Product and Engineering together around a shared understanding. You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable taking ownership, while knowing when to collaborate and ask for input.

In particular, we’re looking for someone who can:

We're hiring one person to own paid acquisition end to end.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making.

The Role

Not to manage an agency. Not to approve creative someone else made. You write the ad, you make the asset, you build the landing page, you launch it, you own the budget, and you read the numbers on Monday and kill what didn't work.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself. Performance marketer, paid media manager, paid acquisition lead, demand gen manager, growth marketer, creative strategist, media buyer, or the person at a startup who just ended up running the ads. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to have run B2B paid yourself and you need to have made the creative, and most people have only done one.

Who this is for. People who have personally run enterprise B2B ads at a company nobody had heard of yet. You know what a $40 click feels like, you know why the creative that won on LinkedIn dies on Reddit, and you have opinions about it that you earned by losing money that mattered.

If your last job was allocating budget across channels and reviewing what an agency shipped, this isn't it. If you've been making the ads yourself because it was faster than briefing someone, this is it.

What You'll Do

  • Own paid acquisition end to end: LinkedIn, Meta, Google, Reddit, , ChatGpt, X, and whatever you can prove works.
  • Make the creative. Copy, static, video, landing pages. You are the studio, and AI is how you get to twenty variants instead of two.
  • Run a real testing cadence: hypothesis, ship, read, kill. Volume of tests is the job; most of them will lose and that's the point.
  • Own the budget and the number. Pipeline and qualified meetings, not impressions.
  • Work with the founders, customer engineers, and customers on what Soda actually says to the market. Your opinion matters here.

Requirements

Long cycles, a buying committee, high contract values - and no brand pull to coast on. Running paid for a company everyone has heard of, with a big budget and an agency, is a different job to running it for one nobody knows yet on a budget that doesn't forgive waste. We need the second one.
  • Experiment obsessed: the testing cadence is the job. Tell us how many tests you ran last quarter, the last five and what each one was trying to learn, which ones you were wrong about, and what you killed. Most of them should have lost.
  • You make the creative: send us ads you personally made, with what they cost and what they returned. The most important line in this ad.
  • AI-first: you use frontier models to produce and iterate creative at volume, and you can tell us specifically where AI made it better and where it made it worse.
  • You own the budget: you've had spend authority and hit a number with it.
  • Enough technical range to be unblocked: landing pages, tracking, conversion APIs, UTMs, a CRM. Nothing waits on an engineer.
  • Enough data fluency to be credible: you're selling to data engineers and CDOs. You don't have to be one, but you can't sound like you've never met one.
  • Clear written English: most of the job is words on a page that someone decides about in two seconds.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data management, or data observability specifically.
  • You've built the attribution model as well as run the ads.
  • Founder or first-marketer background where nobody was going to do it for you.
  • You were the first paid hire somewhere and built the function from zero.

Benefits

  • Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography.

title: Member of Technical Staff Intern - Germany
description:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

As a Member of Technical Staff Intern, you'll build the system that decides how some of the largest manufacturers in the world operate. That means combining agent-based reasoning with mathematical optimization and simulation on large-scale industrial data.

  • Build agents people trust – when an agent runs a factory's week, the largest industrial companies in the world have to trust it with their critical processes and understand every decision it makes; you build the routing, orchestration and guardrails behind that

  • Ship features end-to-end – you understand the user need, and you get the freedom to build it across the LLM pipeline, infrastructure, backend and frontend, in production in your first weeks

  • Work close to the users – sit with the planners who use it, see what would make their work 10x faster, and build it

You'll own your own features from day one, and what you ship decides what a plant does next week.

​

YOU

  • Full-stack shipper – you've shipped production code end-to-end, you build scalable backend and infra that handles massive amounts of structured and unstructured data, and you build the interface that makes it usable

  • Highly technical – you've built something technically hard, and you can walk us through every decision behind it

  • Product sense – you spot the feature hiding in a user's complaint, and you've deleted your own favorite one because nobody used it

  • You care about getting it right – you know when it has to be 100% and when to keep it simple, and when it matters, you're still chasing the root cause at 2am

  • Sense of urgency – you'd rather ship it tonight than sleep on an open PR

  • Language – you're fully fluent in German and English

  • Relocation – you're ready to work onsite in Munich (we support visa)

​

TECH STACK

  • FE (TypeScript): React, Chakra UI v3, TanStack Router, TanStack Query, Vite

  • BE (Python): FastAPI with Pydantic v2, Temporal, Postgres with pgvector, dagster

  • AI: Pydantic AI, Langfuse

title: Werkstudent*in People Experience Team
description:
Warum Oviva?

 

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Großbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschließlich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

 

Die Stelle
Als Werkstudent:in im People Experience Team unterstützt du unser People Experience Team vor Ort in unserem Büro in Potsdam bei vielfältigen administrativen Aufgaben sowie im täglichen Büromanagement für 10 Stunden pro Woche, idealerweise aufgeteilt auf zwei Tage. Da du eng mit dem Team vor Ort zusammenarbeitest und eine zentrale Anlaufstelle im Büro bist, sind sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau zwingend erforderlich. In dieser Rolle erhältst du wertvolle Einblicke in den gesamten Employee Lifecycle sowie in globale Projekte innerhalb von People Team. Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, den Büroalltag reibungslos zu gestalten, deine Kolleg:innen zu unterstützen und interne Prozesse sowie Dokumentationen bestmöglich zu organisieren, um gemeinsam eine rundum positive Employee Experience zu schaffen.

 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Administrative & Büro-Unterstützung: Du kümmerst dich um den täglichen Büroablauf, bearbeitest die Post, bestellst Büromaterialien, koordinierst Raumbuchungen und hilfst bei Besucheranfragen vor Ort in Potsdam.

description:
Why qlub

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

At qlub, engineers don't write code by hand anymore, and they don't read it line by line either. AI agents do the implementation. Our engineers decide what gets built, specify it precisely, direct the agents, and prove the result is correct and safe before it touches a single payment.

As our next AI Engineer, you'll own that loop end to end: from turning a salon's problem into a clear spec, to orchestrating agents that build, test and ship it, to verifying it through tests, evals and observability rather than code review by eye. You'll ship real results from day one.

You'll also build the agentic systems our salons and teams use: agents that reason, retrieve information, call tools and execute controlled workflows across bookings, payments and operations.

  • Own integrations with salon management and booking platforms, payment providers, financial partners and other third-party systems, specified and delivered through agents

  • Write the specs, acceptance criteria, test suites and evals that define "done", so agent output is verified by evidence rather than by reading the code

  • Design and run the agentic development workflow itself: which agents do what, how they're prompted and given context, and how their work is checked, merged and deployed

  • Build AI-powered and agentic products for salons and internal teams, such as agents that answer client questions, manage booking and payment exceptions, or handle reconciliation, using retrieval, tool calling and controlled actions

  • Put permissions, human approvals, guardrails, observability, audit trails and fallbacks around every agent that can touch money, client data or a salon's calendar

  • Find and fix bottlenecks in speed, reliability, security and cost, including LLM and agent cost

Who you are

  • You already build with agents as your default way of working, not as an add-on to hand-coding

  • You move fast and make strong decisions with incomplete information

  • You take real ownership and think like an operator, not a coordinator

  • You're energised by hard problems in payments, beauty and wellness, and client experience

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

  • Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, tool calling, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows in production

  • Strong grasp of system design: REST APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing and distributed systems

  • Solid knowledge of databases, data modelling and database design

  • Experience with payment providers, booking or POS systems, or complex third-party integrations

title: Senior Backend Engineer – Platform & Reliability
description:
About Maesn

Want to join a growing European startup early and be part of an epic journey?

At Maesn we build software for other software companies. We provide an integration platform that lets B2B software companies add integrations to their platforms in hours and days instead of weeks and months. Our customers love us because we are innovative, quick, friendly and provide integrations for systems that others dare not touch.

We are a young dynamic SaaS Startup born in Düsseldorf who believe in working hard and having fun while doing it. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship.

The role

Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team.

What you will do

Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end

You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way.

Bring real observability to the platform

Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source.

Raise the bar on security and reliability

Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

Build product and level up the team

You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build.

What you bring

  • Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents.

  • Production debugging: You’ve chased down latency spikes, timeouts and flaky dependencies, and you know how to go from “something is slow” to the root cause.

  • Azure: Solid hands-on experience running production workloads on Azure.

  • Observability: Experience instrumenting services with tracing, structured logging and metrics, ideally with OpenTelemetry or similar.

  • Infrastructure-as-code mindset: You codify infrastructure rather than clicking through consoles.

  • Security by default: You think about secrets, access management, and compliance as part of the work, not as an afterthought.

  • Backend skills: You’re comfortable writing production code in TypeScript/Node.js and enjoy shipping features, not only keeping the lights on.

  • Pragmatism and mentoring: You pick the simplest setup that works. You enjoy helping less experienced engineers grow, and you’re excited to set the standards for how we run our platform.

What we offer

  • First-hand experience building a fast-growing tech startup

  • Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere

  • Steep learning curve and a varied job with interesting projects and technologies

  • Work fully remote or in our office in Düsseldorf

  • Fun offsites where the team gets together to work and play

  • One-time allowance for improving your home office

  • Subsidized Urban Sports Club membership

  • Laptop and work equipment

  • 30 days of PTO + Local holidays

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Want to work on Software-Defined Defense? 

At Apex.AI, we develop safety-certified software for mobility systems and intelligent machines. Our products power applications in automotive, trucking, robotics, aerospace, agriculture, industrial automation, and defense systems.

We are hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer to design and scale Apex.AI's build and release systems. You will architect and implement our build and release system solutions, which impact developer productivity company-wide and ensure that customers receive high-quality products in a timely manner.

In this role, you will work directly with European defense customers and internal product teams to design, build, deploy, and Apex.Alan. You will help customers bring real-world systems to production while contributing improvements and features back into our core platform. Find out more about Apex.Alan here and here.

This role is located in our Munich office. Authorization to work in Germany and German language skills are required.


What You Bring
  • B.S. or higher degree in a technical field with 5+ years of relevant work experience 
  • Proven experience working with cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Proven experience maintaining a cross-platform build system 
  • Proven experience managing CI/CD pipelines 
  • Proven ability to script in Python and Starlark 
  • Proven experience building C/C++ projects with Bazel
  • Familiarity with GitLab or GitHub 
  • Experience navigating Linux-based systems and tools in a terminal
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills  
  • Excellent communication skills 
  • German language skills

    • Nice To Have
  • Experience with infrastructure management tools such as Terraform 
  • Experience with Bazel internals 
  • Familiarity with releasing code and binaries to customers 
  • Familiarity with cross-compilation 
  • Experience with the usage of CMake 
  • Experience developing Bazel infrastructure 

    • Apex.AI is an international software company specializing in the development of safety-certified, developer-friendly, and scalable software for mobility systems, aiming to accelerate the transition to software-defined vehicles and mobility. Founded in 2017 by Jan Becker and Dejan Pangercic, the company is headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with additional offices in Munich, Stuttgart, Gothenburg, Tokyo, and Pangyo. To date, Apex.AI has raised over $75 million USD from world-class venture, financial and strategic investors including AGCO, Airbus Ventures, Canaan, Continental AG, Daimler Truck, HELLA Ventures, Jaguar Land Rover’s InMotion Ventures, LG Electronics, Lightspeed, Orillion, Toyota Ventures, Volvo Group Venture Capital and ZF.

    The company’s flagship product, Apex.OS, consists of two core components: Apex.Grace and Apex.Ida.

    • Apex.Grace is an application runtime framework in the form of a software development kit (SDK). It provides a robust framework for developing real-time, reliable, and safe applications. Core APIs are based on ROS 2 APIs with numerous extensions enabling real-time execution, reliable performance, deployment into large fleets, system state management, safety, security, and much more. It is safety-certified to ISO 26262 ASIL D.
    • Apex.Ida is a communication middleware delivering optimal high-performance data transport across use cases. These use cases range from fully autonomous vehicles with dozens of high-resolution cameras to small signals with ultra-high frequencies in safety-critical domains. Its core is based on a shared memory data transport with connectors into DDS, SOME/IP, MQTT, CAN, and many more protocols, all abstracted into a single application-facing API.

    Additionally, Apex.AI offers:

    • Apex.Alan provides customers with a highly optimized and efficient software integration, development environment, build, test, and delivery process.
    • Apex.OS for V&V enables record and playback of very large and diverse data streams, both time- and data-deterministically, which is crucial for replay, analysis, and performance evaluation of complex autonomous systems.

    Apex.AI’s software solutions are utilized across a diverse range of industries, including automotive, agriculture, medical, and defense sectors. The products enable developers to efficiently create and deploy safe, reliable, and high-performance applications, thereby accelerating the adoption of software-defined mobility systems. Through its innovative software solutions and strategic partnerships, Apex.AI is at the forefront of transforming the mobility industry, facilitating the development of next-generation vehicles and systems.

Während des 12-monatigen Traineeprogramms bekommst du die Chance dich stetig neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, dein persönliches Netzwerk auszubauen und relevante Bereiche eines eCommerce-Unternehmens kennenzulernen (z.B. Produktmanagement, (Produkt-)Marketing, Vertrieb, HR, Logistik, Einzelhandel, etc.). Der Schwerpunkt deines Traineeships ist das Produktmanagement.

Deine Rotation in andere Fachbereiche passen wir genau auf deine Erfahrungswerte und Fähigkeiten an.

Nutze die Chance und entwickle dich zum fachlichen Experten oder optimiere im Anschluss an das Traineeship unsere Abläufe im Unternehmen.


Das ist deine Rolle in unserem Team

#Einkauf:
Du unterstützt bei der Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivitäten. 
#Marktanalyse: 
Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du wirst lernen Kalkulationen oder Reports zu erstellen und die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge zu behalten.
#Produktmanagement: 
Nach dem Traineeprogramm sollst du deinen ersten kleinen Bereich übernehmen, dabei wirst du zum Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.
#Perspektiven:
Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Du bekommst von Tag 1 an einen Mentor an deine Seite gestellt, der dich auf deinem Weg begleitet.
#Team: 
Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.
#Weiterbildung: 
Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.
#Steile Lernkurve:  
Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder sogar kleine Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach einem Jahr eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. Und dein Einsatz bleibt nicht unbeachtet - wir sind stolz darauf, über 90% unserer Trainees in eine Festanstellung zu übernehmen.
#Arbeitsumfeld: 
Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und möchtest nun ins Berufsleben starten. Vielleicht hast du sogar schon praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?
#Leidenschaft: 
Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.  
#Verhandlungsgeschick: 
Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.
#Persönlichkeit:
Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
#Was noch? 
Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - überzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der/die Richtige bist ;)

⛱️ 30 Tage Urlaub  ⌛ Flexible Arbeitszeiten✨ Regelmäßiges Arbeiten aus dem HO✈️ Bis zu 4 Wochen im Jahr Work & Travel  ⭐ Events✔️ 20% Zuschuss zu bAV oder BU  ✔️ Jobrad  ✔️ Hansefit ✔️ Günstiges Deutschlandticket❤️ Wertschätzendes Miteinander  ⭐ Vielfalt & Offenheit


Vorabinformationen

Wir suchen dich als Elternzeitvertretung in Vollzeit für einen Zeitraum von 18 - 24 Monaten, je nach Einstiegszeit. Teilzeit ist ab einem Stundenumfang von 35 h ebenfalls möglich. 


Das ist deine Rolle in unserem Team

#Einkauf:
Du verantwortest die Abwicklung und Koordination von Einkaufs- und Beschaffungsaktivitäten für dir zugeordnete Hersteller.
#Marktanalyse: 
Zahlen sind dein Ding! Du erstellst Kalkulationen oder Reports und hast die Konkurrenz sowie Preisentwicklungen stets im Auge.
#Produktmanagement: 
Du bist Ansprechpartner für Kollegen aus anderen Fachabteilungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktmarketing bei der Steuerung von Produktkampagnen zusammen.
#Perspektiven:
Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten, nutze die Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Wachstumsunternehmen und profitiere von kurzen Entscheidungswegen. 
#Team: 
Wir arbeiten auf allen Hierarchieebenen eng zusammen und sind vom Vorstand bis Azubi per ‚Du‘. Du kannst dich jederzeit auf dein Team verlassen. Dieses lernst du im digitalen Probearbeiten kennen.
#Weiterbildung: 
Vieles ist learning-on-the-job, aber wir schicken dich auch auf firmeneigene Fortbildungsprogramme.
#Steile Lernkurve:  
Du übernimmst schnell Verantwortung für Teilprojekte und Hersteller. Wir geben dir die Tools an die Hand, sodass du nach der Einarbeitung eigenständig Produkte betreuen kannst. 
#Arbeitsumfeld: 
Unser Arbeitskonzept sieht eine Mischung aus mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten aus dem Büro heraus vor. Je nach Einsatzbereich kann die Anzahl der Büroarbeitstage variieren. 


Was solltest du mitbringen?

#Background:
Du hast dein Studium abgeschlossen oder eine kaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und hast schon erste praktische Erfahrungen im eCommerce-Umfeld, Produktmanagement oder Marketing sammeln können?
#Leidenschaft: 
Technik lässt dein Herz höherschlagen - ein Expertenwissen rund um Elektronikprodukte musst du jedoch nicht mitbringen. Dank deiner sehr guten Auffassungsgabe findest du dich nämlich schnell in neue Produktbereiche ein und baust Fachwissen dazu auf.  
#Verhandlungsgeschick: 
Du bist aufgeschlossen und überzeugst deine Gesprächspartner mit deinem sicheren Auftreten und deinen sehr guten kommunikativen Fähigkeiten. Dazu hast du noch ein Gespür für gute Deals und erreichst damit beste Einkaufspreise.
#Persönlichkeit:
Dich zeichnen eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Flexibilität und ein unternehmerisches Denken aus. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigeninitiativ, bist aber auch ein echter Teamplayer.
#Was noch? 
Excel oder sogar Pivot sind für dich Tools, mit denen du schon gearbeitet hast. Dank deiner Englischkenntnisse könntest du auch in Terminen mit internationalen Lieferanten und Herstellern überzeugen.

Du findest dich nicht zu 100% in dieser Beschreibung wieder? Kein Problem - überzeuge uns, warum du dennoch der/die Richtige bist ;)

title: (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
description:
Ein erster Einblick:

Wir, die MIFCOM GmbH, bieten die besten Jobs in der Gaming-Branche. Als einer der führenden Hersteller persönlich konfigurierbarer PCs und Notebooks für Gamer und anspruchsvolle Nutzer sind wir immer auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, mit einem Faible für Technik, die gemeinsam mit uns ihren nächsten Karriereschritt machen wollen.

Mit über 180 engagierten Mitarbeitern fertigen wir an 2 Standorten PCs, Workstations und Server nach Kundenwunsch. Egal ob Business-Laptop oder High-End Gaming PC, wir setzen alles daran die Vorstellungen unserer Kunden umzusetzen – „Geht nicht, gibt’s nicht!“

Dabei sind ein Höchstmaß an Flexibilität, bedingungslose Kundenorientierung und eine ausgesprochene Hands-On Mentalität die Grundpfeiler unserer täglichen Arbeit. Vielfach von der Fachpresse ausgezeichnet und mit besten Kundenbewertungen sind wir der führende PC-Systembuilder in Deutschland.

Wir sind aktuell auf der Suche nach einem (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d), der unsere Finanzabteilung mit fundierter Expertise im Hauptbuch und in sämtlichen Umsatzsteuerthemen verstärkt.


Deine Aufgaben:

Als (Senior) Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) bist Du Teil unserer Finanzabteilung und arbeitest eng mit Deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen sowie unserem CFO zusammen. Als erfahrener Profi in Sachen Finanzbuchhaltung übernimmst Du Verantwortung für zentrale Themen in unserem Team – mit einem klaren Fokus auf das Hauptbuch und die Umsatzsteuer.

Deine täglichen To-Dos umfassen vor allem die folgenden Tätigkeiten:

  • Du betreust das Hauptbuch inklusive der Abstimmung sämtlicher Sachkonten und der Anlagenbuchhaltung
  • Du bereitest die Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB vor und erstellst und verbuchst Rückstellungen und Abgrenzungen
  • Du behältst die Liquiditätssteuerung des Unternehmens im Auge gemeinsam mit unserem CFO und der Teamleitung Finance, das betrifft Zahlläufe, Cash-Prognosen und ggf. auch Bankenkommunikation
  • Du erstellst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen, zusammenfassende Meldungen und die Umsatzsteuerjahreserklärung in Abstimmung mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und stimmst diese ab
  • Du prüfst und beurteilst umsatzsteuerliche Sachverhalte, z.B. innergemeinschaftliche Lieferungen, Ausfuhren, Reihengeschäfte sowie Fernverkäufe über das OSS-Verfahren
  • Du begleitest die Umsetzung der E-Rechnungspflicht und stellst die umsatzsteuerliche Compliance in unseren Prozessen und Systemen sicher
  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und Finanzbehörden, u.a. bei Umsatzsteuer-Sonderprüfungen und Betriebsprüfungen
  • Du unterstützt bei Engpässen unsere Kreditoren-/Debitorenbuchhaltung und übernimmst die laufenden Buchungen im Tagesgeschäft
  • Du erstellst Reportings und Statistiken für Deine Stakeholder im Management
  • Zusätzlich treibst Du die Einführung neuer und die Verbesserung unserer aktuellen Prozesse aktiv voran bspw. die Einbindung von KI-Tools in die Finanzbuchhaltung


Dein Profil:

Bei MIFCOM hören wir nie auf zu lernen und uns weiterzuentwickeln. Wir glauben daran, dass eine perfekte Mischung aus technischem Fachwissen und Soft-Skills einen guten Kandidaten auszeichnen. Unser Anforderungsprofil ist eine erste Richtlinie, aber wir sind immer auf der Suche nach neuen Mitarbeitern, die ihre eigene Perspektive und den Willen, etwas zu bewegen mitbringen.

Als unser idealer Kandidat bringst Du folgende Fähigkeiten und Kompetenzen mit:

  • Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten / Steuerfachgehilfen (m/w/d) oder eine Qualifikation zum Finanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) – idealerweise hast Du zusätzlich die Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d) abgeschlossen
  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, bestenfalls hast Du einen Teil davon in einer Steuerkanzlei gesammelt
  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Hauptbuchhaltung sowie in der Vorbereitung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen mit

Finance ist heute weit mehr als Buchhaltung und Reporting: Prozesse, Systeme und Anforderungen entwickeln sich kontinuierlich weiter und eröffnen immer neue Möglichkeiten, Finance effizienter und zukunftsorientierter aufzustellen. Deine Aufgaben

Als Teil unseres Finance-Teams lernst du die unterschiedlichen Facetten von Finance aus nächster Nähe kennen und arbeitest an operativen, analytischen und projektbezogenen Fragestellungen mit. Dabei bist du eng mit unseren Funktionen Accounting & Tax, FP&A und Finance Transformation sowie den jeweiligen Directors im Austausch. Neben dem laufenden Finance-Tagesgeschäft wirkst du auch an Transformationsprojekten, M&A-bezogenen Themen und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Strukturen und -Prozesse mit.

Dabei erhältst du einen direkten Einblick in unsere Planungs-, Forecasting- und Reporting-Prozesse und lernst, finanzielle Entwicklungen einzuordnen und ihre wesentlichen Treiber zu verstehen.
  • Finance Transformation: Du unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Finance-Prozesse und wirkst bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen mit. Dabei begleitest du unter anderem die Automatisierung wiederkehrender Abläufe sowie die Einführung und Weiterentwicklung neuer Systeme und Technologien im Finance-Bereich.
  • M&A & PMI: Du unterstützt bei M&A-bezogenen Finance-Fragestellungen und erhältst Einblicke in Transaktionen und Due-Diligence-Prozesse. Ein besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Post-Merger-Integration: Hier wirkst du dabei mit, neu erworbene Gesellschaften in unsere Finance-Strukturen zu integrieren und Prozesse, Daten und Systeme zusammenzuführen.
  • Accounting: Du unterstützt unser Accounting-Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und lernst dabei die zentralen Prozesse der Finanzbuchhaltung aus erster Hand kennen. Darüber hinaus wirkst du bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen mit und entwickelst so ein fundiertes Verständnis dafür, wie Accounting und Reporting in der Praxis zusammenspielen.
  • Strategische Finance-Projekte: Du arbeitest an bereichsübergreifenden Finance-Projekten und aktuellen Fragestellungen mit und übernimmst dabei eigene Teilaufgaben. So erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Themen von der Analyse und Konzeption bis zur konkreten Umsetzung zu begleiten und zunehmend Verantwortung zu übernehmen.


Das bringst du mit

Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für Zahlen und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge, denkst analytisch und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein. Gleichzeitig packst du gerne selbst mit an, kommunizierst offen und klar und fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, in dem sich Themen und Prioritäten auch kurzfristig verändern können. Dabei bringst du die nötige Flexibilität und Eigeninitiative mit, um Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Themen aktiv voranzubringen. 

  • Du bist in einem Masterstudiengang oder mindestens im vierten Fachsemster eines Bachelorstudiengangs der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben und hast deinen Studienschwerpunkt im Bereich Finance, Accounting oder Controlling gesetzt.

  • Auch bei mehreren parallel laufenden Themen behältst du den Überblick und arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und zuverlässig.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du bist digital affin, verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse – insbesondere in Excel und PowerPoint – und arbeitest dich schnell und gerne in neue Tools und Finance-Systeme ein. Erste Erfahrungen mit Anwendungen wie DATEV, LucaNet oder Power BI sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit KI-basierten Tools und setzt diese gezielt ein, um Aufgaben effizienter zu bearbeiten, Informationen zu strukturieren und die Qualität deiner Arbeitsergebnisse zu verbessern.

Bei uns bist du nicht auf einen einzelnen Finance-Bereich festgelegt. Deine Aufgaben

title: Mission Systems Engineer (m/w/d) / Space & Defense Industry
description:
About the Company

Infinite Orbits GmbH is the German subsidiary of Infinite Orbits SAS, a NewSpace company founded in 2017 that now has more than 200 employees, with locations including Luxembourg, the UK, Spain, and Singapore.

The company develops in-orbit servicing solutions built on its own autonomous Rendezvous and Proximity Operations (RPO) technology, spanning awareness, surveillance, inspection, and protection of space assets through to life extension.

With its newly established Munich site, Infinite Orbits builds a dedicated local presence in Germany, developing capabilities in business development, R&D, product development, system engineering, production, and mission operations to enable Europe's defense and space sector.

About the Role

As Mission Systems Engineer, you own the mission. You turn customer needs into feasible, defensible mission concepts for RPO and in-orbit servicing across space segment, ground segment, launch, operations, and user segment, and you define the requirements each segment has to meet.

Proposal preparation is at the core of this role: you lead the technical volume of Infinite Orbits Germany's bids and RFI/RFP responses and provide the mission content for funding applications, from the first mission sketch to the submitted document. Working hand in hand with Business Development and the Proposal & Project Manager, you shape the technical solution that qualifies an opportunity and wins it, building on proven product and technology solutions from Engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities.

Once contracts are won, you carry your mission concept into execution. As a founding technical hire, you own the analysis that underpins every German proposal and delivery.

Job Description

  • Technical proposal lead: Lead the technical volume of RFI/RFP responses and customer proposals and provide mission content for national and European funding applications: mission concept, solution description, feasibility evidence, and technical risks and mitigations. Provide technical input to the compliance matrix, work breakdown structure, schedule, and cost, which the Proposal & Project Manager owns.

  • Bid strategy & win themes: Work with Business Development and the Proposal & Project Manager on bid/no-bid decisions, win themes, and technical discriminators; drive technical reviews and answer clarification questions through to submission.

  • Mission analysis ownership: Own RPO and in-orbit servicing mission analysis, including orbit and trajectory design, approach and abort strategies, safety and collision-avoidance concepts, and Δv and timeline budgets.

  • Mission concept & ConOps: Define mission architectures and concepts of operations across all mission phases, from launch and early operations through to end of life.

  • Requirements & allocation: Derive mission requirements from customer needs and allocate them to space segment, ground segment, launch, and operations; define the spacecraft-level requirements baseline together with the Satellite Systems Engineer.

  • End-to-end trade-offs: Run and document system-level trade-offs, ensuring technical coherence across all segments.

  • Sales & business development support: Provide technical depth in early customer conversations and capability presentations, and qualify new opportunities with Business Development.

  • Project execution: Own technical workstreams on won contracts, in particular concept and feasibility studies (Phase 0/A), ensuring delivery against mission and contractual requirements.

  • Group coordination: Work with Engineering in Toulouse and other Group entities to align mission analysis methods and leverage existing product and technology solutions across the Infinite Orbits Group.

Requirements

Education & Experience

  • Engineering degree in aerospace, astrodynamics, space systems engineering, or a related field, or equivalent.

  • 3+ years of experience in mission analysis or mission systems engineering, with a track record of independently owning technical workstreams.

  • Hands-on experience preparing technical proposals, study proposals, or funding applications in the space or defense sector (e.g. ESA, DLR, Bundeswehr, EU).

  • Experience with RPO, GNC, formation flying, or in-orbit servicing missions is a strong plus.

Skills & Other Requirements

  • Strong command of mission analysis tools and methods (e.g. STK, GMAT, Orekit, Python).

  • Working knowledge across space segment, ground segment, launcher interfaces, and user segment integration.

  • Ability to size, defend, and iterate mission solutions under customer or stakeholder scrutiny.

  • Excellent structured writing: able to turn technical analysis into compelling, compliant proposal content under deadline pressure.

  • Comfortable engaging directly with customers and prospects to support sales and business development conversations.

  • Autonomy and ownership: comfortable owning workstreams independently in an early-stage, cross-border team environment, working closely with Group entities in France and beyond.

  • Fluent in German and English.

  • Willingness to undergo a German security clearance procedure (Sicherheitsüberprüfung).

  • Frequent travel required within Germany and to Infinite Orbits' HQ in Toulouse and other European locations.

What we offer

  • A founding technical role with direct ownership of mission concepts and technical proposals in a growing European space and defense company.

  • Direct exposure to customers, bids, and cross-border collaboration with the Infinite Orbits Group.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
The AI Operating System for Private Capital.

Capsa

Private capital funds have to find potential investments, research and analyse them thoroughly, monitor them over time, drive improvements, and decide when to buy and sell. They've got to see through the marketing. They've got to outbid the competition. And they've got to learn from every deal they do. Historically, these processes have run on people, we are building the AI Operating System that will run them in the future.

We're focused, ambitious, and obsessed with building a category-defining company. In the last 12 months we've grown ARR 15x, achieved product–market fit with leading multi-billion-dollar PE firms, and expanded across the US, UK, and Europe. Now we're doubling down: we've raised a large Series A from top-tier VC investors to scale the team. We're hiring hyper-talented people who want to work at the forefront of AI and revolutionise an industry.

The role

You’ll manage the engineers across three squads (intelligence, experience and platform), own hiring and people development, and strengthen technical leadership within each team.

You’ll partner with the product managers in Intelligence and Experience and the squads’ technical leads to translate company priorities into clear objectives, shape solutions together, and agree credible delivery plans. You’ll make sure engineers contribute to understanding customer problems and exploring solutions rather than just implementing requirements.

Across the three squads, you’ll be accountable for engineering capability, the quality of our work, and delivery against agreed commitments. You’ll make capacity, dependencies and risks visible, resolve obstacles, and work with Product and the CTO when priorities, scope or timing need to change. Alongside the squads and Product, you’ll share responsibility for the outcomes the work achieves.

The opportunity

  • You’ll own hiring, coaching and performance management across all three squads, developing engineers and technical leads who can make good decisions and take responsibility for their work.

  • There’s real scope to shape engineering management at Capsa, working with the CTO and Product to establish clear responsibilities and a consistent operating approach in a lean, flat structure.

  • You'll work alongside a small, senior and high performing engineering team

  • Meaningful equity in a company that grew ARR 15x last year

What you'll achieve in the first six months

  • Formed an evidence-based view of the codebase, delivery process and engineering capability across all three squads, and agreed the most important improvements with the CTO and Product.

  • Made your first hiring and team-shape decisions, grounded in the capabilities and capacity each squad needs.

  • Established regular coaching and clear expectations for your engineers, with a grounded view of who’s thriving, who needs support and where the gaps are.

  • Established clear technical ownership within each squad, with engineers taking responsibility for decisions and technical leads working effectively with Product.

  • Helped the squads deliver meaningful improvements end to end, and assessed their impact on customers or the teams that depend on them.

  • Put an agreed, lightweight planning and delivery rhythm into practice across the squads, making commitments, dependencies and risks visible without centralising every decision.

Recent projects from the team

  • Agent Harness: our own agent harness built on a custom, streaming-first graph execution framework

  • Code Execution Framework: interruptible and resumable mid-execution, for programmatic tool calling

  • Document Ingestion, Indexing, and Search: a VLM-based OCR pipeline, a self-hosted search cluster, domain-aware search strategies

  • Citations: an end-to-end approach to reviewing supporting documentation behind AI-generated statements

  • Document Authoring: agent tooling and a document editor supporting collaborative authoring across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and email

Track record

  • Managed engineers directly for a few years; before that, a strong individual contributor at a venture-backed startup or a serious tech company

  • You’ve coordinated work across teams or substantial parallel workstreams, resolving dependencies and competing demands while keeping ownership with the engineers doing the work.

  • Hired people, developed them, and made calls about team shape as things scaled or didn't go to plan

  • Shipped distributed systems, data pipelines, or platform services to production through a team you led

  • Comfortable operating at pace, with incomplete information

How you operate

  • Takes responsibility for what your team ships and its effect on customers, not just internal velocity metrics

  • Thinks carefully about the problems being solved and the decisions the team makes; uses AI to sharpen that thinking, not replace it

  • Accepts that time is short and information is incomplete, makes progress anyway, and adjusts as more is known

If this opportunity excites you

We'd like to meet you. Initial conversations are direct and substantive, going deep on the work, the team, and what you'd own in the first six months.

title: VP of Marketing
description:
About Ryft

 

Ryft is a regulated payment facilitator and authorised payment institution building the infrastructure layer for modern commerce platforms.

We enable marketplaces, SaaS platforms and multi-party ecosystems to embed and monetise payments natively. Our technology handles onboarding, compliance, orchestration, split payments and revenue sharing, allowing our partners to focus on growth while we manage complexity.

 

We are now entering the next phase of scale, expanding into new verticals and building a category-defining embedded payments platform.

 

About The Role

We are looking for a VP of Marketing to build and lead the marketing function at Ryft. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set marketing strategy and budget, build and manage a team spanning multiple disciplines, and personally drive execution where it counts. You will report into the COO and work closely with the senior leadership team, translating commercial and product priorities into a marketing plan that supports B2B growth across the UK, EU and US.

 

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Leadership

  • Own the marketing strategy for Ryft, aligned to commercial targets, product roadmap and international expansion plans.

  • Set clear priorities and OKRs for the marketing function, and represent marketing performance and plans to the senior leadership team and board.

  • Build Ryft's brand and market position within the payments and fintech space, with a clear point of view on differentiation versus competitors and acquirers.

Budget and Resource Management

  • Build, own and manage the marketing budget, with clear allocation across channels, campaigns and headcount.

  • Track spend against ROI and commercial outcomes, and make the case for investment or reallocation with senior stakeholders.

  • Manage relationships and contracts with external agencies, freelancers and vendors.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Build out the marketing team as Ryft scales, hiring, developing and managing direct reports across relevant disciplines (e.g. content, demand generation, brand, product marketing, comms).

  • Set individual and team objectives, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and create a strong, accountable team culture.

  • Identify capability gaps and build the case for new hires or specialist support as the function grows.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with Sales, Commercial, Product and Compliance to ensure marketing activity is joined up with wider business priorities.

  • Coordinate go-to-market plans for new products, partnerships and market entries (including new geographies).

  • Act as a connector across disciplines, ensuring brand, content, demand and comms work as one coherent function rather than in silos.

Hands-On Execution

  • Stay close to the work: this is not a purely strategic role. You will be expected to get into the detail on campaigns, content and messaging where needed, particularly while the team is small.

  • Personally lead or shape flagship activity such as major campaigns, events, PR moments and thought leadership.

  • Hold the contract at the boundary: Agree with Software Engineering what crosses the write, in what shape, with what notice when it changes — then enforce it on your side, so a schema change is a handled event rather than an outage.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Evervault is hiring its first Security Engineer in London.

We build modular card payment infrastructure for companies building payment products or their own payments stack. Our tools help developers keep raw card data off their systems, reduce PCI compliance work, and improve payment acceptance, fees and fraud outcomes. Our customers include Rippling, Ramp and Sorare.

We’re a Series B company backed by Index Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Kleiner Perkins.

You’ll join our platform group and own application security from day one, with scope to take responsibility for security across Evervault over time. You’ll be our first dedicated security engineer, working closely with the engineers who build and run our products.

In your first year, expect roughly half your time to go towards hands-on security engineering and half towards audits, questionnaires and customer security reviews. Both are core to the job. You’ll help make our systems more secure and give customers confidence in how we protect their data.

Your work will include:

  • Finding and fixing vulnerabilities in our applications and infrastructure.

  • Building security checks and tooling into how we develop and ship software.

  • Working with engineers on security decisions in product and system design.

  • Owning security and compliance audits, including evidence collection and resolving findings.

  • Handling customer security reviews and questionnaires, and explaining our controls clearly.

You’ll establish how the security function works through the code you ship, the risks you address and the practices you help the team adopt.

We work mostly in Rust and Node.js on AWS, with Terraform and some Go. We care more about your engineering ability than experience with every part of our stack.

We’re looking for an excellent engineer with deep, practical security expertise. You should be comfortable writing production code, investigating unfamiliar systems and taking a fix through to completion. Strong engineering skills and hands-on experience with the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) are both essential.

Experience in card payments, particularly running or securing a cardholder data environment, is a strong signal. You’ve taken audits through to resolution and worked at a product company before Series C. Experience as a first or sole security engineer would be valuable.

You use AI daily and actively look for ways it can improve your work. You’re comfortable making progress when the problem is loosely defined, and you take responsibility for the result. We’d also like to hear about something exceptional you’ve done, at work or outside it.

This is an individual contributor role. You’ll have ownership and close collaboration within the platform team, with no immediate people-management remit. We welcome mid-level and senior engineers.

Our values are simple: be sound, curious and optimistic. Do the thing, win as a team, sign your name, wow the user.

We offer:

  • Stock options with an extended exercise window.

  • Full, top-tier health insurance.

  • Generous vacation and flexible working hours.

You’ll work from our Shoreditch office Tuesday to Thursday. We do not currently sponsor UK work visas.

If you want to define the security function at Evervault and stay close to the engineering, we’d like to hear from you.
