You will work inside the tension that defines this role: fast-moving AI models, production deadlines, visual realism, brand consistency, and systems that other people can actually use.

 

INDG has spent 20+ years building visual production systems for global brands. Grip extends that heritage into AI-orchestrated content production. Your work will help teams generate, edit, refine, and scale imagery while keeping outputs sharp enough for enterprise brand use.

 

 

What You Will Do

Build and Maintain Generative Image Workflows

Set up, configure, and troubleshoot custom ComfyUI workflows for image generation, image editing, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, relighting, variation generation, and controlled composition.

You will connect models, nodes, prompts, masks, ControlNet inputs, LoRAs, reference images, and post-processing steps into repeatable workflows. The goal is not a one-off good image. The goal is a workflow that can produce consistent, usable outputs across many assets.

Apply AI to Production Content Problems

Use generative AI techniques against real production needs: adjusting apparel/footwear/accessories/equipment imagery, refining fashion/sportswear product shots, extending scenes, improving model consistency, generating controlled variations, or supporting creative teams with rapid image exploration.

You should understand that production images are judged on details: skin texture, garment fit, fabric behavior, seams, logos, lighting direction, pose plausibility, background continuity, and whether the image still feels brand-correct after generation.

Adapt Quickly as Models and Tools Change

Work confidently across diffusion-based models, LoRAs, ControlNet, IP-Adapter-style workflows, segmentation tools, inpainting models, outpainting methods, face and identity consistency techniques, and emerging image-generation systems.

You will test new models, identify where they improve or break the pipeline, and help the team decide when a tool is production-ready. You do not need every new release to be perfect. You need to know how to evaluate it, isolate failure modes, and translate it into a usable workflow.

Support a Pipeline Used by Artists and Production Teams

Document workflows clearly enough for artists, producers, and technical teams to reuse them. Package settings, prompts, node graphs, model dependencies, and output criteria in a way that reduces guesswork.

You will work with CGI artists, creative technologists, production leads, and platform teams to connect creative intent with operational execution. When something fails, you trace the system: model choice, conditioning input, prompt structure, mask quality, render reference, node configuration, or post-process step.


Who You Are

You live at the intersection of image-making and systems-building. You care about the final image, but you also care about the workflow that created it.

 

You Have

Hands-on experience building and maintaining ComfyUI workflows, or comparable node-based generative AI systems.

A strong working knowledge of current image-generation methods: diffusion models, LoRAs, ControlNet, inpainting, outpainting, image-to-image workflows, upscaling, masking, reference-based generation, and controlled variation.

Experience producing or refining commercial-quality imagery. Fashion, sportswear, product, talent, ecommerce, campaign adaptation, or CGI production experience is a strong plus.

 

You Think

Systems-first. A good prompt is useful; a repeatable workflow is better.

Automation-first. Manual fixes are acceptable only when they teach the pipeline what to solve next.

Visually. You can tell when an image fails because of lighting, anatomy, garment behavior, material response, identity drift, composition, or post-processing artifacts.

 

Your Skills Are

ComfyUI workflow construction, debugging, model loading, node graph organization, and dependency management.

Practical prompt engineering for controlled output, not prompt decoration.

Image evaluation for realism, consistency, brand fit, and production usability.

Comfort with fast tool changes, incomplete documentation, broken nodes, model conflicts, and solving problems directly.

 

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than two decades building CGI, 3D, and visual production systems for global brands. Grip now orchestrates AI workflows and production-grade outputs across that same visual heritage.

This freelance role is for someone who wants to work where generative AI meets real production pressure: brand consistency, scale, quality control, and images that need to hold up beyond a demo.

description:
SAP S/4HANA Fachbereichskoordinator (m/w/d)

Über uns

Wir sehen die Halbleiterindustrie als Raum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir sehen Chancen. Und wir sehen das enorme Potenzial unserer Graphenlösungen, die Branche grundlegend zu verändern. Wir laden dich ein, diesen Wandel mitzugestalten und mit unserem konsequent menschenorientierten Ansatz kluge Köpfe für eine gemeinsame Vision zu vereinen.

Unsere Vision: Zeige allen, dass du grundlegende Veränderungen bewirken kannst. Beweise mit deinem Wissen und deinen Fähigkeiten, dass Dinge auch anders gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam verändern wir die Art und Weise, wie die Welt miteinander verbunden ist.

Über unsere Technologie

Die Halbleiterindustrie benötigt zunehmend leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch. Unsere Technologie bietet dafür eine Lösung: Wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken Computernetzwerken mit hohem Datendurchsatz und geringer Latenz.

Der Schlüssel liegt in den besonderen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen. Sie ermöglichen es uns, elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, sodass unzählige Chips nahezu so miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Innovation im Bereich der Graphenphotonik hebt Rechenleistung und Energieeffizienz auf ein völlig neues Niveau.

Kurz gesagt: Wir verbinden Chips zu leistungsstarken und energieeffizienten Netzwerken und überwinden damit bestehende Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiterindustrie. Wir liefern die Graphenlösung.

Deine Rolle

Die Black Semiconductor GmbH sucht einen SAP S/4HANA Fachbereichskoordinator (m/w/d), der als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen den Fachbereichen und externen SAP-Beratern agiert und sicherstellt, dass geschäftliche Anforderungen effektiv in geeignete Systemlösungen übersetzt werden.

Du betreust und pflegst unsere SAP S/4HANA Systemlandschaft über die Bereiche Finance, Logistik, Einkauf und Supply Chain hinweg. Dabei treibst du die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen, die Optimierung des Systems und die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Änderungen voran.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen SAP Beratungspartnern und funktionsübergreifenden Business Operations Teams, einschließlich Anforderungsaufnahme, Tests und Change Management, idealerweise unterstützt durch Tools wie SAP Cloud ALM

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sowie eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise im Umgang mit Fachbereichen, IT-Teams und externen Dienstleistern

Unsere Unternehmenskultur

Menschen vor Prozessen

title: Senior Producer
description:
Senior Producer

ScapeWorld Entertainment

Remote. Our working day runs on CET, wherever you sit. Full time, on a long-term contract. Starting as soon as you can. Where you live while you do is up to you; the location field on this posting only fits one country, so please read this as the real rule and apply from wherever you are.

About us

We are Scape, a Swedish game studio of about 30 people, fully remote by choice. We are launching Scape on Steam Early Access later this year: a growing platform of multiplayer games where a player's identity carries across all of them. The first game inside Scape is Gravity: a precision climbing game where 100 players share one server, one tower, and one long way down. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios, Epic and Ubisoft.

Since we are a small team about to put our first game in front of players, we are looking for the person who holds the plan, the priorities and the team together while we do it. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet.

The role

Let us start with the studio you would be joining. Around thirty people, fully remote, and a group of strong leads in design, art, engineering, QA, community and commercial who own their crafts and run their own teams. What we do not have is the person who looks across all of them at once, holds the plan they are all working to, and makes the day-to-day calls that keep it moving as one. That is this role. It is the only production seat in the company, and it comes with real authority.

You would work closely with the Creative Director. They own what the game is, set the direction and make the big bets. You own the plan that gets us there and the decisions inside it: scope, sequencing and trade-offs within a milestone are yours to make, and you decide which questions need to reach them and which do not. They should be able to step back and know that things are being handled, because they are.

In practice, it comes down to four things:

You know how a game gets made. You can see what depends on what, where the effort really sits, and whether an estimate is going to hold. When a lead tells you how long something takes, you know how to hear it and what has to land for the work to ship on time.

You own the plan and the priorities. Not just the schedule, but the order of work behind it. When two things compete, you decide, or you get the decision made and tell everyone affected. Open questions have an owner and a date. Nothing sits unanswered because nobody was sure whose call it was.

You plan ahead. Problems get found while they are still cheap, and everything that has to land together lands together: builds, assets, store material, localization, press dates.

You lead the team's delivery. People know the plan is real, feel good about hitting it, and are still standing when it ships. The leads lead their crafts. You lead how it all comes together, and you meet each team where it is: some want you in the weeds with them on estimates and sequencing, others mainly need the picture across teams kept current. You read which is which.

We have a production pipeline that works, and like any pipeline it can always be better. You would inherit it as it is, get to know it and the people who run it, and then improve it where you see the need. Nobody here expects you to arrive with all the answers. We do hope you arrive curious about how we work and comfortable telling us, kindly and clearly, where we could do better.


What you will own

  • Production priorities day to day: the order of work across the studio, the trade-off calls within a milestone, and every open question that is blocking someone. You find who can answer, get it answered or escalated with a clear recommendation attached, and close the loop with the teams waiting on it. If a question is blocking someone, it is yours until it is not

  • Keeping design, art, engineering, QA and marketing in step with each other, week by week, so nobody is working against a version of the plan that has moved

  • The forward view: every feature in flight, what each one is still waiting on, the handoffs between departments caught early, and risk seen while it is still cheap, named, and carrying a mitigation before it turns into a schedule event

  • The team's delivery health: sustainable pace, morale, and delivery on target, treated as one problem rather than a trade-off

  • Marketing as a real production dependency, and the alignment dates around release: builds, assets, store material, localization drops, press dates, landing on time and together

  • The production plan behind all of it: a milestone schedule with a baseline, a forecast per milestone from velocity against remaining scope, estimates held against actuals, and replanning on a cycle rather than after something breaks

  • QA in step with everyone else. Our QA lead owns testing; you make sure QA knows what is coming and when, that testable builds land when the plan says they do, and that the QA window sits in the schedule where it belongs rather than where it ends up

  • External production partners: localization, video, 3D, anything we outsource. You own the relationship and the communication in both directions, and you chase. Briefs and context going out, deliveries coming in and landing in the build, and the schedule that keeps them in step with everyone else. Leads should never have to chase a partner themselves. The craft stays with the partner; making it fit is on you

  • The production process itself and the tools it runs through. We use Jira, including Jira Plans for planning months out against a baseline, and you own it for the studio. You also support hiring managers through their recruitment processes, so a lead who is hiring can focus on assessing the person rather than running the process


You

Most people who can do this job have around five years in games production behind them. Take that as a description of who tends to apply, not a bar we hold. If you can show us the things below with less, please apply anyway. We would rather meet you than miss you.

  • You know how games get made across disciplines: what waits on what, how long things really take, and where a plan is optimistic before the dates say so

  • You have produced across several titles and taken at least one PC title all the way to release, including the closing stretch: feature lock, bug burn, submission, the go decision. Which store matters less than that you have been through a PC launch. Projects that were cancelled along the way still count; we know how the last few years have gone for a lot of good people

  • You have owned priorities, not just a schedule. You have made cut-or-keep calls on a shipped title and lived with them, and you can tell us about one you got wrong

  • You have worked closely with a founder, studio head or creative director, and you know how to take decisions off their plate without going around them

  • You have built and driven a schedule, and you have written down a way of working that other people picked up and used. We would love to see examples, in whatever form they exist

  • You have led a team to a target without burning it out, and the people on it would work with you again

  • You are proactive by default and you work independently. You do not wait to be asked or chased; given an assignment, you find out what it needs and finish it well without someone checking each step. That is what senior means to us

  • Leads tell you how things are really going, because you talk with them directly and they trust you with the real picture

  • You are fluent in Jira at the level of owning it for a team, Jira Plans included. It is a tool, not the job, but it is the tool we run the plan through, so we need you good with it

  • You work our day, which runs on CET; where you sit while you do is up to you. And you are comfortable working in English, written and spoken


Helpful, not required

  • Steam specifically: Steamworks, builds and depots, the store page, review and submission, and how Early Access behaves through the whole run

  • Live operations and a patch cadence

  • Working with external production partners before, on either side of the relationship

  • Time at a small studio where you were the only producer, or where the producer and product owner were the same person

  • A remote-first team


What we offer

The whole project and the authority that comes with it. Real decisions, not just a schedule to report against. Strong leads beside you rather than under you, and a Creative Director who wants to hand things over and means it. A company small enough that what you do is visible in what we ship, and people who will notice.

We are a self-motivated team, remote by choice and flexible in how we work, and we run on people helping each other rather than watching each other. Everyone here is trusted to own their part and supported when they need a hand, and we would like that to be true for you from your first week.

And we are early. Scape is heading to Steam with everything still ahead of it. Joining now means building something with a real chance of becoming big, and being one of the people it belongs to when it does.


Practical

  • Remote. Our working day runs on CET and this role keeps it.

  • Full time, on a long-term contract.

  • Start: as soon as you can. Tell us your notice period in the application form and we will work around it.

  • Recruitment is ongoing.

Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und temporäre Arbeitskräfte effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen buchen über unsere Plattform kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende in Echtzeit, während Studierende unsere App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Studierende und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.

Als Social Media Manager (w/m/d) verantwortest du unsere organischen Social-Kanäle und unser Influencer Marketing end-to-end. Du übersetzt unsere Markenstrategie in platform-native Formate, die Gen Z tatsächlich erreichen, und baust Zenjob als die verlässliche Adresse für Studierende auf, die einen Nebenjob suchen. Für viele Talents ist Social der erste Kontakt mit Zenjob, du gestaltest diesen Moment und bindest die Talente dauerhaft an die Marke. Gleichzeitig machst du Zenjob auf der B2B-Seite sichtbar und lieferst dem Growth-Team die Creatives und Insights, die auch bezahlt funktionieren.

Deine Aufgaben:

Dabei steuerst du dein Influencer-Budget eigenständig und setzt auf glaubwürdige Stimmen statt auf reine Reichweite

Dein Profil

  • Sehr gutes Gespür für Plattform-Mechaniken und Trends + inklusive der Fähigkeit, Trends zu bewerten statt nur zu kopieren

title: B2B2C Marketing Manager (Global)
description:
Location: Berlin (hybrid)

Hi, we are AMBOSS, and we are looking for an experienced marketer to drive our growth globally.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

Many of our students and clinicians access AMBOSS through an institutional license from their medical school or hospital. In this role, you’ll own the marketing that turns those license holders into active, engaged AMBOSS users and, ultimately, advocates. You’ll sit between our B2B Sales/Regional teams and our consumer marketing teams, with a clear focus on adoption and engagement of institutional customers.

A license only creates value once someone opens AMBOSS, finds the answer they need before an exam or at the bedside, and comes back the next day. You’ll make that first step easy and help it become a habit. Your work shows up in how many students and physicians actually use AMBOSS, in how confident our Sales and Regional teams feel going into renewals, and in how many future doctors make better decisions for their patients. You’ll build initiatives that work globally and still feel local to each campus and hospital. If you enjoy seeing a direct line from a campaign to real usage, this role gives you plenty of room to build.

You will:

  • Own the end-user journey from “license granted” to “actively using AMBOSS,” including onboarding, activation, and ongoing engagement for students and physicians on institutional licenses.

  • Build and maintain automated CRM flows for onboarding, feature announcements, and re-engagement, tailored by audience (students vs. physicians) and institution type.

  • Support institutional renewals by identifying low-usage accounts and running targeted engagement campaigns, in close coordination with Sales and Account/Regional Managers.

  • Create and maintain institution-facing collateral (onboarding kits, flyers, one-pagers, usage summaries) that Sales and Regional teams use to support rollouts and renewals.

  • Own and optimize CMS content and landing pages for institutional end users, including license activation and sign-up flows.

  • Partner with institutions on local activation, such as campus ambassador programs, webinars, and events.

You bring:

  • 3-4+ years of experience in B2B, B2B2C, SAAS, or edtech marketing,

  • Hands-on experience with CRM/marketing automation tools.

  • Strong ownership and accountability in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

  • Detail-oriented ownership of content quality across CMS, CRM, and collateral.

  • Data-driven decision-making, even with imperfect or limited data sets.

  • Proactive in spotting activation/usage gaps and proposing fixes, not just reporting metrics.

  • Excellent stakeholder management across global/local and marketing/sales teams.

Benefits:

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health, and work-life harmony.

  • 🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

  • 🥙 Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

  • 🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club – M plan, Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

Even if you don’t meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

AMBOSS operates across multiple international markets and diverse verticals. If this specific role doesn’t feel like the perfect match, we encourage you to browse our other open positions in Marketing and beyond to find where you can make the biggest impact.

title: AI Lead
description:
We’re seeking a driven AI Lead to take ownership of AI across one of the fastest-growing legal tech companies in Europe, leading the development and evolution of our core AI products.

This role combines applied generative AI development with AI leadership, balancing hands-on work on production systems with leading the AI team, defining the roadmap, and establishing best practices for AI across the company.

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, you’ll be responsible for the entire AI function: setting direction, building systems, and enabling the organization to effectively leverage AI. You will work closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver reliable AI features while continuously improving infrastructure, observability, and evaluation workflows across all AI products.

For a leader with strong experience building and deploying AI systems in production, this is an opportunity to own multiple AI products, scale a high-performing AI team, and shape how AI is applied across the company.

Your Challenge and Opportunity in This Role

You will define how AI is built, shipped, and scaled at JUPUS. As AI Lead, you are responsible for both strategic direction and execution, ensuring that AI systems across voice, chat, and document processing deliver real value to users.

You will lead the development and evolution of the AI across JUPUS’s three modules. The Website Chatbot turns website visitors into qualified inquiries. ‘Marie’, our AI Phone Assistant, handles inbound and outbound calls for law firms. Case File & Document AI builds the case file, then analyses incoming documents, drafts briefs and tests arguments, grounded in over a million German court rulings. You will also establish the technical and organizational foundations needed to scale AI across the company.

Expect strong ownership, fast iteration, and pragmatic decision-making, with a clear focus on building reliable, production-ready systems that improve productivity for law firms.

Tasks

AI Strategy, Leadership & Implementation:

  • Define and execute the AI roadmap across all AI products

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the AI team, fostering a high-performance, execution-focused culture

  • Architect and implement production-ready generative AI systems across voice, chat, and document workflows

  • Contribute hands-on (≈40%) to core AI systems, including architecture, implementation, and optimization

  • Design and oversee agentic workflows, RAG systems, and LLM-based architectures across products

  • Establish and scale evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks for AI systems

  • Define and enforce best practices for AI development, deployment, and iteration

  • Ensure reliable delivery and fast iteration within a small, high-impact team

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Partner closely with product, design, and engineering teams to integrate AI into real product workflows

  • Translate complex AI capabilities into clear, practical product features

  • Act as the AI authority within the company, supporting teams in adopting and applying AI effectively

  • Communicate AI strategy and progress clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Requirements:

  • 5–6 years of experience building and shipping applied AI systems in production

  • Proven hands-on experience with agentic AI systems and/or RAG in production (beyond simple API usage)

  • Strong proficiency in Python and backend development for AI-driven products

  • Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring AI engineers, including setting technical direction and raising team standards

  • Track record of owning and delivering AI features end-to-end in a product environment

  • Experience with LLM evaluation, monitoring, and observability (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar)

  • Ability to balance hands-on work with technical leadership in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong product mindset and ability to translate AI capabilities into real user value

  • You must be located in the CET -2/+2 zone for this role!

Benefits

🚀 Foundational Impact – Help build and scale the core AI capabilities of JUPUS from the ground up

🔒 Technical Ownership – Work directly on the systems powering AI features across multiple products

🌱 Growth Environment – Build production AI systems at the cutting edge of generative AI and agentic workflows

💼 Leadership Visibility – Flat hierarchy with direct access to the Head of Engineering and CTO, reporting to the AI Lead

🏡 Fully Remote – Enjoy the flexibility of working from anywhere

💻 Top Equipment – State-of-the-art MacBook plus all the accessories you need

🏋️ Wellbeing Perks – Urban Sports Club membership to support your healthy lifestyle

If you're passionate about building practical AI systems, shipping agentic workflows, and creating real impact for users through generative AI, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Prakitkant M&A Due Diligence (m/f/d)
description:
Über Buena

Buena wird von GV unterstützt und macht Immobilien einfacher: von der Wohnungssuche über den Kauf und die Finanzierung bis zur Verwaltung. Dafür kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Technologie und besseren Prozessen weiter. Unser Ziel: Immobilieneigentum und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen zugänglich machen.

Über die Rolle

Bevor wir eine Hausverwaltung übernehmen, müssen wir ihr Geschäft verstehen. Wie belastbar sind die Zahlen? Welche Risiken stecken in den Verträgen? Was braucht das Unternehmen, um nach der Übernahme erfolgreich weiterzulaufen?

Als Praktikant:in M&A Due Diligence gehst du diesen Fragen nach. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Deal Lead und unserem Operations- und Deal-Team an laufenden Übernahmen. Dabei begleitest du Transaktionen vom ersten Datenraum über die Bewertung bis zur Entscheidung des Managements und zum Closing.

In unserem dreiköpfigen Team übernimmst du ab Tag eins eigene Workstreams und nimmst an Gesprächen mit den Geschäftsführern der Zielunternehmen teil. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in unsere Kaufentscheidung ein.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Financial DD. Du analysierst BWAs, Jahresabschlüsse und Cashflows, prüfst Umsatz und verwaltete Einheiten und dokumentierst Red Flags. Du arbeitest an Kaufpreismodellen und rechnest Szenarien und Earn-out-Strukturen durch.

  • Commercial & Operations DD. Du prüfst Objektlisten, Verwaltungsverträge und ERP-/Prozessdaten. Du bewertest Personal- und Kapazitätsbedarf und bereitest Fragen für die Gespräche mit der Geschäftsleitung vor.

  • Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Du verdichtest deine Ergebnisse zu klaren Findings und Executive Summaries. Du bereitest Liegenschaftscontrolling und Liquiditätsplanung auf und lieferst Input für die Entscheidungsvorlage und die Anlagen zum Unternehmenskaufvertrag (SPA).

  • Den DD-Prozess steuern. Du erstellst und pflegst Information Request Lists, organisierst den Datenraum in DataSite oder Google Drive und hältst fehlende Unterlagen nach. Du dokumentierst offene Fragen, Fortschritt und Ergebnisse in Linear.

  • Eigene Workstreams verantworten. Je nach Erfahrung und Transaktion führst du einzelne DD-Workstreams von der ersten Datenanforderung bis zum Findings-Report.

Du passt, wenn du

  • Bereits ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder transaktionsnaher Beratung absolviert hast.

  • BWL, VWL, Finance, Accounting, (Wirtschafts-)Recht, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder etwas Vergleichbares studierst – ab dem fünften Semester oder im Master.

  • GuV, BWA und Bilanz sicher lesen kannst und verstehst, was Umsatz, EBITDA, Working Capital und Verbindlichkeiten über ein Unternehmen aussagen.

  • Bewertungsmethoden wie Multiples und DCF kennst und bereits angewendet hast.

  • Excel sicher beherrschst: Pivot-Tabellen, XVERWEIS/SVERWEIS und das Aufbereiten und Konsolidieren unstrukturierter Daten.

  • Sorgfältig arbeitest, Unstimmigkeiten hinterfragst und offene Punkte eigenständig klärst.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sprichst und schreibst. Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, Verträge und Finanzunterlagen sind überwiegend deutsch.

  • Für mindestens drei, idealerweise sechs Monate Vollzeit verfügbar bist und aus unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten möchtest.

Was du bei uns lernst

  • Wie wir als Käufer Unternehmen prüfen, bewerten und übernehmen – bei einer zweistelligen Anzahl an Transaktionen pro Jahr.

  • Wie aus Finanzdaten, Verträgen und Management-Gesprächen eine belastbare Kaufentscheidung entsteht.

  • Wie Bewertung, Kaufvertrag und spätere Integration zusammenhängen.

Bei guter Zusammenarbeit gibt es eine Perspektive für den Einstieg nach dem Praktikum.

Deine Benefits

  • Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10–20 Gehminuten zum Büro wohnst oder dorthin ziehst.

  • 110 € Lunch-Budget pro Monat und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

  • 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

  • Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Wir wachsen durch Übernahmen. Du arbeitest an laufenden Deals und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Arbeit unser Wachstum beeinflusst.

  • Verantwortung folgt Ergebnissen. Wer zuverlässig liefert, bekommt bei uns schnell mehr Verantwortung.

  • Wir arbeiten eng zusammen. Aus unserem Büro, mit kurzen Wegen zum Deal Lead und zum Management.

  • Wir bauen Buena langfristig auf. Jede Übernahme bringt uns unserem Ziel näher: Immobilien einfacher machen und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen ermöglichen.

title: Business Development Director (m/f/d)
description:

Nice to Have

title: Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Wir suchen eine:n Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d) für den Aufbau und Betrieb unserer Data Platform – der Infrastruktur für Datenaufnahme, Speicherung und Laufzeitumgebungen, auf der alle Datenpipelines bei Shopware laufen. Du verantwortest ihre Architektur und Zuverlässigkeit: von der CDC-Datenaufnahme über einen dreistufigen Data Lake bis hin zur Orchestrierungsplattform.

Deine Arbeit ermöglicht es den Service-Teams und dem Management, unsere Kund:innen und Produkte besser zu verstehen. Zugleich schaffst du die technische Grundlage, um Anforderungen an Data Governance und Compliance tatsächlich durchzusetzen.

Du arbeitest eng mit Data & AI zusammen, die auf der von dir betriebenen Plattform Datenpipelines entwickelt. Im Service Enablement Team sorgst du dafür, dass für die Data Platform dieselben Golden Paths und Qualitätsstandards gelten wie für die übrige Service Platform. Die Position ist eine erfahrene Fachlaufbahn ohne Personalverantwortung. Wichtig ist, dass du gern mit vielen Stakeholdern, Kolleg:innen und Partnern zusammenarbeitest.


  • Datenaufnahme: CDC-Ingestion über DMS/Lambda in den Raw-Bereich von S3 sowie Verantwortung für Raw-Schema und Datenverträge. Derzeit umfasst die Plattform 13 Domänen und rund 180 Schemata über drei Ebenen hinweg. 11 CDC-Quellen laufen bereits produktiv, weitere kommen hinzu.

  • Speicherung und Orchestrierung: Verantwortung für die mit Terraform bereitgestellte Orchestrierungsplattform auf Basis von Step Functions, EventBridge und Glue über alle drei Lake-Ebenen (Raw, Curated und Aggregated) sowie für die zugehörigen CDC-Terraform-Module.

  • Datenkatalog-Infrastruktur: Betrieb und Bereitstellung von OpenMetadata. Dazu gehören die Katalog-Infrastruktur und die Trennung zwischen Betrieb und Nutzung wie bei den Lake-Ebenen. Data & AI ergänzt darauf aufbauend Datensatzbeschreibungen, Glossar und Stewardship-Inhalte.

  • Tooling-Infrastruktur: Bereitstellung und Betrieb von Superset, dem Werkzeug der Teams für Datenabfragen und Visualisierungen.

  • Abgrenzung der Pipelines: klare Codegrenzen, ein Merge-blockierender Vertragscheck und eine eindeutige Regel für die Weiterleitung von Vorfällen: Bei Infrastrukturproblemen wirst du benachrichtigt oder alarmiert, nicht bei Fehlern in der Pipeline-Logik.

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Aufbau von Observability und operativer Exzellenz für die Data Platform, unter anderem mit Datadog, Incident Response sowie SLOs und SLIs. Du übernimmst den On-Call-Dienst; die Vergütung dafür entspricht vom ersten Tag an der Regelung anderer Teams.

  • Governance- und Compliance-Mechanismen: Die Richtlinien selbst – etwa Klassifizierungsstandards, Aufbewahrungsregeln und der Umgang mit DSGVO- und Datenschutzanfragen – werden außerhalb von SET und Data & AI durch Legal/Compliance oder eine datenschutznahe Funktion verantwortet. Du legst diese Richtlinien nicht fest, sondern implementierst die dafür erforderliche Architektur: Aufbewahrungsfristen, Zugriffskontrollen, Klassifizierungsmetadaten und die Weiterleitung von Löschanfragen.

  • Plattformübergreifende Konsistenz: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur, damit die Data Platform dieselbe Self-Service-Philosophie und denselben Reifegrad wie die übrige Plattform erreicht.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische AWS-Erfahrung mit Glue, Athena, Step Functions, EventBridge, Lake Formation und S3 sowie umfassende Terraform-Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Weiterentwickeln gemeinsam genutzter Module.

  • Praxiserfahrung mit CDC-Pipelines und einer Iceberg-basierten Lakehouse-Architektur mit den Ebenen Raw, Curated und Aggregated. Dieses Format ist heute produktiv im Einsatz.

  • Vertrautheit mit Kafka-basiertem Event-Streaming (MSK, Glue Schema Registry) für Ereignisse auf Anwendungsebene, die neben CDC-Daten in der Plattform landen.

  • Sicherheit im Betrieb einer Plattform, auf die andere Teams angewiesen sind: Erfahrung mit Incident Response und SLOs sowie das Urteilsvermögen, individuelle Anforderungen in den Backlog aufzunehmen, statt sie ad hoc umzusetzen.

  • Starke teamübergreifende Kommunikation: Du arbeitest direkt mit Data & AI daran, die Grenzen zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik klar zu halten, und stimmst dich mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur zu übergreifenden Standards ab. Keine der beiden Beziehungen ist eine Berichtslinie.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis dafür, was eine datengetriebene Kultur nachhaltig verankert: Führungskräfte, die anhand von Kennzahlen handeln, organisationsweite Datenkompetenz, eine für alle Zielgruppen zugängliche Infrastruktur und Daten als gemeinschaftliche Ressource.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher gegenüber der Führungsebene und sprichst Zielkonflikte und Risiken proaktiv an, statt darauf zu warten, danach gefragt zu werden.

  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und direkt und kannst technische Positionen gegenüber Engineering-Kolleg:innen ebenso wie gegenüber nichttechnischen Stakeholdern vertreten und begründen.

Nice to have:

  • Vertrautheit mit dbt (dbt-athena) oder Spark/pySpark – genug, um konstruktiv darüber zu sprechen, wo die Grenze zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik künftig verlaufen sollte.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau eines On-Call-Dienstes für ein Team, das bisher noch keinen hatte.

  • Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Legal- und Compliance-Stakeholdern: Anforderungen an Aufbewahrungsfristen oder Datenklassifizierung in konkrete Infrastrukturentscheidungen übersetzen – und nicht nur wissen, dass es solche Anforderungen gibt.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

title: Senior Go Engineer, Full Stack
description:

In this role, you will be architecting features from the database to the browser. Your center of gravity is the Go backend, APIs, data models, system design, but you'll move into the React/TypeScript frontend whenever the feature requires it. You'll join an experienced and supportive team where you'll have a significant voice in shaping both our technical direction and the product itself.

This is a role for an engineer who lives in the backend but enjoys reaching across the stack. You'll thrive here if you can:

  • Own the Full Lifecycle: Build, scale, and maintain modern web applications where the heavy lifting sits in our Go backend, with the willingness to ship in React/TypeScript on the frontend whenever a feature calls for it.

  • Architect for Scale: Maintain high standards for code quality and performance across the entire stack, from backend microservices to frontend component libraries.
  • Collaborate Broadly: Work closely with Product and Design to turn ambiguous requirements into polished features.

You own every line that ships under your name, whether you typed it or an agent did. You're motivated to deep-dive into agent workflows and bring the judgment that turns agent output into production-grade code.

To Be Successful in This Role, You'll Need:
  • Experience: at least 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in a production environment.
  • The Backend: Proven experience architecting and maintaining high-scale web APIs. You've shipped Go in production for 2+ years and are comfortable owning backend system design end-to-end.
  • The Frontend: Motivated and willing to work in our React/TypeScript frontend, with enough baseline ability to ship features there when a story calls for it. Prior hands-on React/TypeScript experience is a plus, not a must.
  • System Ownership: A "DevOps" mindset, comfortable with CI/CD, automated testing, and version control.
  • Communication: Fluent English and the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
What we care about
  • Teamwork: collaborating and supporting each other within engineering and across functions
  • Inclusion: creating an environment where everybody can bring their whole self and do their best work
  • Ownership: empowering you to do the work that is most impactful
  • Sustainability: balancing work with family and personal hobbies so we can be at our best
  • Growth: supporting each other's learning and development


Why topi?

  • Impact from Day One - Your ideas are valued, and you actively shape our direction. No long feedback loops or complex hierarchies - you'll have a direct impact on what you do.

  • meetings, demo sessions, quizzes, and offsites - perfect opportunities to spend time as a team.

description:
About us:

Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) | Elternzeitvertretung / Parental Leave Cover
Fixed-term, around12 months  |  ideally part-time (60–80%), with the option to extend to full-time  |  Berlin (hybrid)  |  Recruiting for SRLabs and Allurity group companies
based candidates.

Please apply only if you are based in Berlin and has right to work. No visa sponsor available, No remote options available.

About us
SRLabs is home to some of the sharpest minds in cybersecurity. We secure critical infrastructures in finance, energy, and telecommunications — not through compliance checklists, but through hands-on hacking resilience. Our work lives at the intersection of deep technical research and impactful consulting for organisations that care about staying ahead of real threats.
We're a team of 60 people based in Berlin, with colleagues from all over the world. We're part of Allurity, a European cybersecurity group of 12+ sister companies, which gives us scale without sacrificing our startup energy.

We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to cover a parental leave for around 12 months. In this role, you won't just recruit for SRLabs — you'll also support hiring across several of our Allurity sister companies, working closely with our cross-company People Hub. It's a great opportunity to get hands-on, end-to-end recruiting experience across a range of technical and business roles, in an organisation that takes hiring seriously without drowning it in process.


Your responsibilities

Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for open roles at SRLabs and selected Allurity sister companies — from intake call to signed offer.
  • Write and post compelling, accurate job ads that speak to the kind of people we want to attract.
  • Screen applications and conduct first-round interviews, giving candidates a fair, fast, and human process.
  • Coordinate interview loops with hiring managers and technical interviewers, and keep candidates informed at every step.
Sourcing
  • Proactively source candidates for harder-to-fill and technical roles via LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and other channels.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring role types across the group.
  • Help identify and test new sourcing channels, particularly for niche cybersecurity talent.
Cross-Company Collaboration
  • Partner with hiring managers and People colleagues across Allurity sister companies to understand their hiring needs and local market context.
  • Contribute to shared recruiting standards, templates, and best practices via the People Hub.
  • Support group-wide initiatives such as the graduate/internship pilot and employer-branding activities where relevant.
Candidate & Hiring Manager Experience
  • Be the main point of contact for candidates throughout the process — approachable, responsive, and clear.
  • Coach hiring managers on structured interviewing and help them make confident, fair decisions.
  • Gather feedback to continuously improve the candidate and hiring manager experience.
Systems & Process
  • Keep our ATS/Personio data accurate and up to date — job postings, pipelines, candidate statuses, and reporting.
  • Maintain recruiting-related documentation and help keep our hiring process easy to follow for everyone involved.
  • Track basic recruiting metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness) and flag bottlenecks early.


What do you bring?

  • Proven technical recruiting experience (agency or in-house) — this is a must. You've hired engineers, security specialists, or comparable technical profiles, and you can hold a credible conversation with them. This isn't a role for a first-time recruiter, but you don't need to be senior either.
  • A bit of hands-on sourcing know-how — comfortable using LinkedIn Recruiter or similar tools, and not afraid of a Boolean search string.
  • Good communication skills in both German and English — you can run a candidate conversation and write a clear job ad in either.
  • A structured, organised way of working — you keep pipelines tidy and don't let candidates fall through the cracks.
  • Genuine affinity for tech and cybersecurity talent — you don't need to code yourself, but you understand technical roles well enough to assess and engage the people in them.
  • Comfortable working across multiple companies and stakeholders at once, with a good sense for adapting your approach to different teams and cultures.
  • Ownership mentality — you follow through, flag issues early, and don't wait to be told what's next.
  • Based in Berlin, with an existing right to work in Germany.


What awaits you with us?

  • A front-row seat in the world of cybersecurity — one of the most interesting and relevant fields there is right now.
  • Real end-to-end ownership of recruiting across multiple companies, not just req-filling.
  • A close-knit, international team that takes the work seriously but doesn't take itself too seriously.
  • 30 days of paid vacation (pro-rated for the contract term).
  • Learning budget for courses or conferences relevant to your role.
  • BVG public transport pass and gym membership discounts.
  • German language lessons (if you need them).
  • Flexible home office.
  • Exposure to group-wide People initiatives and colleagues across 12+ Allurity sister companies.
 
This is a fixed-term position (Elternzeitvertretung) for approximately 12 months, covering a parental leave. It starts as a part-time role at 60–80%, with the option to move to full-time during the contract term depending on hiring volume. There's a real possibility of a handover period with the current role holder to ensure continuity.

description:

Idealworks builds industrial automation as a coordinated system — mobile robots, orchestration software, simulation, and increasingly humanoids and physical AI, working together in real production environments rather than as isolated pilots. Since our founding within BMW Group and our integration into Agile Robots SE, we've grown from a Munich-based robotics team into a global player.

As physical AI and humanoid robotics move from research into industrial deployment, our project landscape is expanding: today's programs span classic mobile robot fleets, next-generation humanoid platforms, and the simulation environments used to develop and validate both. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Project Manager to lead this kind of work end to end - technically credible enough to sit with R&D and hardware/software engineering, and organized enough to keep shareholders, partners, and customers aligned as programs move from concept to production.


Role Responsibilities: What you will do

Project & Program Delivery

  • Manage complex engineering projects across the full lifecycle — from scoping and planning through execution, integration, testing, and handover — spanning both software and hardware workstreams.
  • Define and manage project plans, milestones, budgets, and resourcing; monitor schedule, cost, quality, and contractual compliance throughout.
  • Identify technical, schedule, and commercial risks early, and drive mitigation and contingency planning across multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Plan and coordinate integration and validation phases (e.g., factory and site acceptance testing) across hardware, software, and systems components.

Cross-Functional & Technical Coordination
  • Act as the connective layer between product management, partner management, solution engineering, software development, hardware development, R&D, innovation management, and operations — ensuring each function's inputs and dependencies are captured and sequenced correctly.
  • Work closely with engineering leads on cutting-edge developments in mobile robots, humanoid platforms, simulation tooling, and physical AI to translate technical realities into realistic, defensible project plans.
  • Support innovation and R&D initiatives as they mature into deployable projects, helping bridge the gap between exploratory work and production-grade delivery.

Stakeholder & Partner Management
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for a diverse stakeholder landscape, including shareholders, technology and integration partners, and customers, tailoring communication to each audience.
  • Prepare and lead steering committee meetings, status reviews, and escalation discussions; ensure decisions are documented and followed through.
  • Manage claims, change requests, and contract or scope amendments in coordination with commercial and legal stakeholders.
  • Build long-term, trust-based relationships with partners and customers that extend beyond a single project milestone.

Operational Excellence
  • Track and report on project and portfolio KPIs (schedule adherence, cost/margin, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction) to leadership and shareholders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project management methodology, tooling, and best practices across the organization.
  • Support resource planning and prioritization across a portfolio of concurrent engineering projects.


Role Requirements: What you need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of experience in a similar role, or in a technical role such as engineering, software development, product management, program management, project management, or partner management, within the robotics industry or a domain of comparable technical complexity (e.g., autonomous systems, industrial automation, advanced hardware/software integration).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional engineering projects that combine hardware and software development.
  • Strong technical fluency to engage credibly with R&D, software, and hardware engineers on cutting-edge topics in mobile robotics, humanoids, simulation, or physical AI, without needing to be the domain expert yourself.
  • A track record of managing external stakeholders e.g. customers, partners, or investors including steering committees, escalations, and commercial discussions.
  • Solid grounding in project management fundamentals: planning, budgeting, risk management, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical and business/executive audiences.
  • A degree in engineering, computer science, software development, mechatronics, robotics, or a related technical field is a plus.
  • Fluency in English required; German is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as project needs require.


Why idealworks

  • At idealworks, you will find an international working environment and become part of an experienced, open team where mutual trust counts. You will feel at home from the very first second!
  • Experience a first-hand start-up feeling and flat hierarchies with varied and responsible tasks that you work on independently.
  • Look forward to hybrid working model with 30 vacation days per year and various opportunities to balance your free time, family and job.
  • For your commitment to helping us achieve our mission, you will not only be rewarded with appreciation, but also with above-average pay including a bonus scheme and an annual personal development budget.
  • We offer exciting corporate benefits, an attractive company pension scheme and regular team events.
  • Our modern office is easily accessible by public transport, bike and car and offers numerous catering options for relaxed lunch breaks with your team.
  • Driven by our unique corporate culture, the five values "passion for results", "wellbeing", "personal growth", "trust" and "being and acting as one team" determine our daily actions and cooperation.

title: Remote Maintenance Engineer
description:
About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.
    • Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry.
    • Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools.


Competences and preferred skills

  • Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments
  • Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. 
  • Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset
  • Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems 
  • Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics.
  • Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis.
  • Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

title: Senior Agent Platform Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Technical owner of Proxima’s AI agent platform, turning autonomous agents into reliable everyday colleagues for physicists and engineers.

  • Own the platform architecture, technical delivery, and day-to-day operation.

  • Scale the platform from an early product into reliable, governed infrastructure used across the company.

  • Enable agents to work across knowledge bases, write code, run simulations, and support engineering workflows.

  • Work within the Enterprise AI Team Lead’s overall vision while owning how that vision is technically implemented.

  • Use strong technical judgment to influence and shape the platform roadmap.

  • Identify and propose new platform features based on hands-on experience and feedback from internal users.

  • Build a platform that engineers and scientists can trust for real, production-level work.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the design, delivery, and operation of our agent platform: the runtime and its primitives: durable sessions, sandboxed execution environments, long-running task execution, memory, and tool integration

  • Turn a rapidly evolving agent ecosystem into stable platform building blocks: evaluate harnesses, models, and protocols as they emerge, and decide what becomes a supported primitive versus a passing experiment

  • Co-Design the integration layer that connects agents to internal and external systems, from enterprise tools to our scientific computing stack, and the standards for how tools, skills, and context are exposed to agents

  • Make autonomy safe and governable: permission and approval flows with human-in-the-loop escalation, capability boundaries, audit logging, cost and token controls, and hardening against prompt injection and tool abuse

  • Build the evaluation and observability layer for non-deterministic systems: session tracing, quality evals, and cost/latency visibility, so we know agents work before our users have to find out

  • Operate what you build on Google Cloud with production discipline: reliability, failure handling, and observability

  • Work directly with demanding technical users and feed their feedback and your technical judgment into the platform roadmap you shape together with the team lead

WHO YOU ARE

Must have

  • You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with real depth in Python and distributed backend systems

  • You have architected, built, and operated production-grade agentic or LLM systems well beyond the prototype phase

  • You know the current agent ecosystem hands-on: MCP, agent SDKs and CLIs, multi-agent orchestration patterns, sandboxed code execution and have formed opinions on where the abstractions should sit

  • You have run production workloads on Kubernetes and a major cloud (ideally GCP), and know what it takes to keep stateful, long-running services alive

  • You treat evaluation and observability as platform features, not afterthoughts

  • You take security seriously as a design constraint

  • You think in platforms and internal products

  • You are a low-ego, high-clarity communicator who can work directly with expert users and build consensus across teams

  • You have experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD

Nice to have

  • Experience with model gateways and routing

  • Exposure to scientific or high-performance computing: batch schedulers, HPC clusters, or simulation-heavy environments

  • Open-source contributions to AI/agent tooling

  • A track record of technical mentorship

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30min)

To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team.   • Coordinate closely with the Head of Licensing & Regulation to ensure building permit processes and nuclear licensing requirements are sequenced coherently - flagging where planning approvals and licensing timelines interact, and ensuring neither track creates blockers for the other

  • Strategic as well as operational: you can define a multi-site permitting strategy and manage its execution simultaneously, not just process individual applications

  • Comfortable working in a design-inform role - you understand how regulatory constraints shape structural and systems design decisions, and you engage with engineers upstream rather than reviewing outputs downstream

  • Experienced managing authority relationships directly - you are the owner-side face to planning bodies, not a coordinator of external consultants who hold those relationships

  • Aware of the radiation protection licensing landscape in Germany - you do not need to be a specialist, but you understand how nuclear or radiation-related facility licensing timelines interact with building permit sequencing and can plan accordingly

  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken - authority relationships are German-language; internal working language is English

  • Familiar with AI tools and digital working methods; comfortable in a lean, high-autonomy environment

  • Background in planning, building regulations, or regulatory affairs for energy, industrial, or research facilities is strongly preferred; experience across multiple simultaneous permitting processes is a strong plus

  • Aware of the radiation protection and nuclear licensing landscape in Germany is a plus - you do not need to be a specialist, but you understand how licensing timelines interact with building permit sequencing and can coordinate effectively with the Head of Licensing & Regulation who owns that domain

title: VP, Growth
description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery retailers with diamond, gemstone and jewellery suppliers in 70+ countries, and we process $300M+ in annual transactions in a $350B industry that has barely been touched by technology.

We remove the traditional barriers of capital, geography and information asymmetry. An independent jeweller in Ohio can source from a cutter in Mumbai with the same ease, pricing and confidence as one of the world's largest chains. That's the whole point.

Our Mission 🚀

Diamond and gemstone trading has run on inefficiency, opacity and exclusivity for generations. Relationships were gatekept, pricing was hidden, and the size of your business decided the terms you got. We're building the infrastructure that changes that — so any jewellery business, anywhere, regardless of size, can compete on the quality of what they do rather than who they know.

The Marketing Team ⭐️

We're a remote-first, low-hierarchy company where the best idea wins. Marketing at Nivoda is at an inflection point: we have real product-market fit, thousands of businesses transacting, a category we have the opportunity to redefine, and a marketing function that has not yet been built to match the scale of the opportunity.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Growth to build Nivoda's marketing function from the ground up and turn it into a predictable growth engine for a two-sided global marketplace.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's or maintainer’s. You'll own the strategy, the growth model, the budget, the team and the number. You'll be the person who decides what Nivoda's category story is in partnership with the CEO, how we reach tens of thousands of independent jewellers and suppliers, and how we prove — with data, not decks — which of those bets are working.

You'll report directly to the President and sit on the senior leadership team, with a mandate that spans demand generation, product marketing, brand, content, lifecycle and marketing operations across every market we trade in.

What would you be doing?

  • Owning Nivoda's marketing strategy end to end - translating company goals into a growth model, then into the channels, programmes and headcount that deliver it

  • Building the marketing team from its current base: hiring, structuring and levelling up a global team, and building the systems, briefs and feedback loops that make good marketers great

  • Owning demand generation and pipeline contribution for both sides of the marketplace - retailers who need supply, and suppliers who need demand

  • Building the measurement layer: attribution, funnel instrumentation, CAC and payback by segment and geography, and a reporting rhythm the leadership team actually trusts

  • Running marketing as a portfolio of experiments rather than a calendar of campaigns - defining leading indicators, killing what doesn't work quickly, and going all-in on what does

  • Owning positioning and product marketing across a multi-product platform (diamonds, gemstones, melee, bridal, finished jewellery, payments and logistics) so each launch lands with the right segment

  • Building the category narrative for "the operating system for the jewellery industry" - and making Nivoda the default name in an industry that still runs on WhatsApp and trade shows

  • Driving lifecycle and retention marketing in partnership with Product: onboarding, activation, reactivation and share-of-wallet growth inside existing accounts

  • Partnering closely with Sales and Revenue leadership on segmentation, ICP definition, territory support and sales enablement - marketing that helps close, not just fill the top

  • Localising go-to-market across our biggest markets, from the US and UK to India, Europe and Asia, without fragmenting the brand

  • Owning the marketing budget and making a clear, defensible case for where every dollar goes and what it returned

  • Representing marketing at leadership and board level - bringing a point of view on where growth comes from next, and the evidence behind it

What do we need from you?

  • Significant experience leading marketing in B2B SMB - selling to owner-operators and small businesses, not enterprise procurement committees. You understand that a high-volume, lower-ACV motion is a fundamentally different sport

  • A track record of building marketing teams and functions from the ground up. You've been the first or second marketing leader, hired the team, chosen the stack and created the operating model. Maintaining someone else's machine is not what you're looking for

  • Deep, hands-on data and growth orientation. You build growth models, instrument funnels, run experiments with real statistical discipline, and can talk fluently about CAC, payback, conversion by stage and cohort behaviour. You're as comfortable in the numbers as you are in the narrative

  • Demonstrated ownership of a pipeline or revenue number, with the receipts — you can walk us through what you inherited, what you changed, and what it did to the funnel

  • Full-stack breadth: you've owned some combination of performance, content, product marketing, lifecycle and brand, and you know which of them matters most right now versus in eighteen months

  • Genuine senior leadership: you've hired, managed managers, made hard calls on people and priorities, and held your own with a founder, CEO or board

  • The judgement to say no. You can name the channels you deliberately didn't pursue and explain why, anchored to the company's go-to-market model

  • Comfort with ambiguity and low hierarchy. You're happy to write the ad copy yourself one week and present the three-year growth model the next

  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to operate across time zones in a globally distributed team

Nice to have

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, where supply and demand have to be grown in step

  • Background in a traditional, offline-heavy industry going through digital transformation — jewellery, construction, logistics, food service, wholesale, agriculture

  • Experience in a company that scaled from roughly $10M to $100M+ in GMV or revenue

  • International go-to-market experience across multiple regions and languages

  • Familiarity with a modern growth stack — HubSpot, Mixpanel or similar product analytics, and a warehouse-backed reporting setup

Our culture and what we offer 🌍

We're collaborative, fast-moving and allergic to bureaucracy. We're growing exponentially, which means real ownership and real scope — the work you do here is visible, and it compounds. We hire people who want to get better, give them the context to make good decisions, and then get out of the way.

Our current benefits

  • ⏰ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 🏥 Private health insurance

  • 📚 Opportunities for growth and continuous learning

  • 💳 Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 📈 The chance to join a company in its exponential expansion phase

Benefits vary by country of employment - your recruiter will walk you through the specifics for your location.

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the global industry we serve. We welcome applications regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let it stop you - if you think you'd thrive here, we'd rather hear from you than not.

Join our Talent Pool

Not quite the right role, or the timing isn't right? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we'll be in touch when something fits: https://nivoda.net/talent-pool

title: Softwarearchitekt (x) Energiemarkt
description:
Über Greenflash

Wir arbeiten für etwas, das größer ist als wir selbst.
Wir gestalten die Energieversorgung der Industrie von morgen. Das erfordert Menschen mit Ambitionen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und einen spürbaren Beitrag leisten wollen.

Wir vertrauen Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.
Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Initiative und Ergebnisse. Deshalb geben wir Menschen früh Verantwortung und den Freiraum, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben.

Wir wachsen gemeinsam.
Große Ziele entstehen nicht durch Routine. Sie entstehen durch Lernen, Feedback und den Mut, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Genau dafür schaffen wir das passende Umfeld.


Deine Mission

  • Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen.
  • Technische Beratung: Du berätst Entwicklungsteams und Fachbereiche bei technischen Fragestellungen, bewertest unterschiedliche Ansätze und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
  • Energie & Software verbinden: Du bringst dein Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung und Energiewirtschaft zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte.
  • Architektur in die Umsetzung bringen: Du begleitest die Entwicklung von der technischen Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen auch im Produkt ankommen.
  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter.
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit.


Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du kennst unsere Systemlandschaft und Architektur.
  • Du übernimmst erste eigene Architekturthemen.
  • Du bringst dich als Sparringspartner in die Entwicklung ein.
  • Du triffst erste Architekturentscheidungen und setzt Impulse.
  • Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelandschaft aktiv mit.


Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
  • Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger.
  • Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln.
  • Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
  • Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading.


Warum Greenflash

  • Arbeite an etwas, das zählt.
    Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
  • Mehr Verantwortung. Früher.
    Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
  • Wachstum durch Herausforderungen.
    Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Leistung, die sichtbar wird
    Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen. 
  • Ein Team mit Ambition
    Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.
  • Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Reise
    Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat.
  • Erfolge gemeinsam erleben
    Wir arbeiten mit hohen Ansprüchen. An unsere Arbeit. An unsere Ergebnisse. An uns selbst. Genauso wichtig ist, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern. Ob bei Team-Events, auf dem Padel-Court oder im Alltag – wir glauben daran, dass starke Leistung und starke Teams zusammengehören.

  • Du bist strukturiert, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert

Noch wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf: Du hast Lust, Recruiting neu zu denken und Dinge auszuprobieren.


Das bieten wir Dir

  • Top-moderne Ausstattung für effektives Arbeiten
  • Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten – ob von zuhause oder unterwegs
