title: Product Manager Footwear - Amsterdam
description:
For an international premium fashion brand, we are looking for a Product Manager Footwear who understands that quality is never an accident. It’s built into every material choice, every production step, and every detail leaving the atelier floor.

This is not a role where you sit in spreadsheets all day tracking KPIs from a distance. You’ll work directly with international ateliers, suppliers, and technical teams to improve production processes, solve real operational challenges, and help bring premium footwear collections to life.

From lead times and craftsmanship to new product development and supplier relationships — you’ll have direct influence on how products are made, delivered, and continuously improved.

What makes this role interesting?

You’ll work at the intersection of craftsmanship, production, and innovation within a premium fashion environment where quality genuinely matters.

The collections are produced across multiple international ateliers, meaning you’ll collaborate closely with production partners, technicians, and internal teams to ensure products meet high standards — both technically and aesthetically.

This role offers a combination of operational responsibility and strategic impact. One day you might be improving production flow with an atelier partner, the next you’re involved in onboarding a new supplier or optimizing the launch of a new footwear category.

If you enjoy being close to the product, solving complex production challenges, and working in an environment where details matter, this role offers a lot of ownership and visibility.

What you’ll be doing

You’ll oversee production performance across multiple ateliers and act as the main link between production, technical teams, and internal stakeholders.

Your focus is on:

  • Improving lead times and production flow;

  • Maintaining high product quality standards;

  • Solving operational bottlenecks before they become real problems;

  • Supporting ateliers in achieving consistent production performance.

Improving production without compromising craftsmanship

The challenge is not simply producing faster — it’s improving efficiency while maintaining premium quality.

You’ll work on:

  • Production planning and capacity management;

  • Stock flow and logistics processes;

  • Quality control and technical implementation;

  • Monitoring production costs and identifying improvement opportunities.

Product development & new initiatives

You’ll also play a role in launching new developments within production, including footwear-related projects and onboarding new atelier partners.

This means working closely with teams across Product Development, Buying, Logistics, and Customer Operations to ensure products move smoothly from concept to final delivery.


About you

You probably already have experience within premium fashion, footwear, or high-end production environments and understand how demanding these processes can be.

You are someone who:

  • Enjoys being close to production and solving operational challenges;

  • Understands the balance between craftsmanship, quality, and commercial realities;

  • Can manage multiple stakeholders without losing oversight;

  • Feels comfortable working internationally with suppliers and ateliers;

  • Notices details others miss;

  • Likes improving processes, but without turning everything into bureaucracy.

What’s offered?

  • A key role within an international premium fashion environment;

  • Direct impact on product quality, production performance, and operational improvements;

  • Collaboration with international ateliers and suppliers;

  • A combination of strategic thinking and hands-on production involvement;

  • International travel opportunities;

  • A highly collaborative environment with short communication lines and strong ownership.

Interested?

Would you like to work at the intersection of craftsmanship, international production, and premium footwear?

Feel free to reach out for more information about the company, team, and next steps in the process.

title: Senior Online Marketing Consultant - Rotterdam
description:
Bouw mee aan de digitale strategie van ambitieuze organisaties

Sommige klanten hebben behoefte aan een sterke campagne. Anderen zoeken een partner die meedenkt over hun volledige online mediastrategie. In deze rol ben jij die strategische sparringpartner. Je werkt voor uiteenlopende organisaties en helpt hen om marketingdoelstellingen te vertalen naar slimme digitale keuzes. Daarbij kijk je verder dan losse campagnes: je verbindt data, media, creativiteit en technologie tot een aanpak die echt resultaat oplevert. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om klanten te adviseren, bouwt aan langdurige relaties en bent verantwoordelijk voor je eigen klantportfolio. Tegelijkertijd werk je nauw samen met specialisten op het gebied van advertising, campagnebeheer en data.

Dit is waar jij het verschil maakt

Strategisch advies

Je verdiept je in de business van de klant, analyseert kansen in de markt en ontwikkelt digitale mediastrategieën die bijdragen aan groei. Daarbij adviseer je over onder andere SEA, social advertising, programmatic, online video, native advertising en influencer marketing.

Van strategie naar resultaat

Samen met het campagneteam zorg je ervoor dat plannen ook daadwerkelijk succesvol worden uitgevoerd. Je bewaakt de voortgang, bespreekt resultaten met klanten en stuurt bij waar nodig. Campagnes zijn voor jou geen eindpunt, maar het begin van de volgende optimalisatie.

Relaties bouwen

Je bent het vaste aanspreekpunt voor jouw klanten. Je begrijpt hun uitdagingen, denkt vooruit en ziet kansen voordat zij die zelf zien. Daardoor ontwikkel je duurzame samenwerkingen en draag je bij aan verdere groei van bestaande accounts.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Het uitdenken van digitale mediastrategieën en de vertaling naar creatieve en concrete mediavoorstellen voor diverse online mediakanalen als social media, display RTB, SEA, online video, mobile, native en influencers.

title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Germany.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
  • Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
  • Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.
  • Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms.
  • Benefits clarification: This is a contract position. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off (PTO), are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own computer and high-speed internet connection.

LEADERSHIP PERSPECTIVE: You will have the opportunity to develop towards the Sales Lead role for Remazing Core. In this position, you will additionally take on functional and people leadership for the Sales team, which currently consists of two team members, set clear goals, further develop the team strategy, and share responsibility for the sustainable development of our sales performance.

STRATEGIC & COMMERCIAL MINDSET: You combine a strong understanding of markets with sound commercial judgement. You recognise potential, prioritise opportunities based on evidence, and turn client needs into sustainable business opportunities.

GLOBAL SALES MINDSET: You operate confidently in an international environment, adapt to different markets and cultures, and manage complex processes across countries and teams.

MARKETPLACE & TECHNICAL EXPERTISE: You ideally bring experience in Amazon marketing, e-commerce, or data-driven services, or can quickly develop a strong understanding of complex topics. You communicate sophisticated services in a credible, clear, and client-centred way.

NEGOTIATION & CLOSING STRENGTH: You lead demanding negotiations with clarity, reliability, and a solution-oriented approach. You can align different interests, handle objections confidently, and move complex opportunities consistently towards closing.

LEADERSHIP POTENTIAL: You enjoy supporting others, sharing knowledge, and providing clear direction. Initial experience in leadership, mentoring, or coaching is highly welcome; most importantly, you are motivated to take ownership and develop towards a formal people leadership role.

STRUCTURED & DATA-DRIVEN APPROACH: You work independently, in a structured way, and with a strong focus on results. CRM discipline, reliable forecasting, and data-led prioritisation are integral to your approach to professional sales management.

description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.

  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.

  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.

  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.


Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.

  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.

  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.

  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.

  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.

  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.


Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)

  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)

  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen

  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)


Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.

  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.

  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.

  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.

  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.


Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.

  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.

  • Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor.

  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Recherche, Dramaturgie und Zuschauerbindung.

Deine Aufgaben

Ideation: Uns gehen nie die Themen aus

•⁠ ⁠Du findest regelmäßig Themen, die gerade relevant sind und die Menschen sehen wollen, und baust dabei auch ungewöhnliche Brücken zu Bitcoin und den Finanzmärkten, zum Beispiel von Popkultur, Politik oder Tech.

•⁠ ⁠Du bereitest jede Idee mit passenden Titelvorschlägen und Referenz-Thumbnails auf, damit wir die stärksten Themen auswählen können.

Audience Retention: Skripte, die bis zum Ende tragen

•⁠ ⁠Du entwickelst Hook und Value Proposition, die klar machen, was das Video liefert und warum es sich lohnt, bis zum Payoff dranzubleiben.

•⁠ ⁠Du baust jedes Video in drei bis vier Kapiteln mit steigender Spannung auf, so dass das Stärkste am Ende kommt und das Thema Substanz hat.

•⁠ ⁠Du schreibst gelegentlich Trading-Videos zu Strategien und Grundlagen, zum Beispiel „Wenn ich als Trader heute neu starten müsste".

User Retention: Zuschauer, die wiederkommen

•⁠ ⁠Du schreibst Short-Form-Inhalte und Posts für X (Twitter), die die Community zwischen den Videos aktiv halten.

•⁠ ⁠Du sorgst dafür, dass die Personal Brand über alle Formate wiedererkennbar klingt und Vertrauen aufbaut

Retention-optimiertes Copywriting im Alltag

•⁠ ⁠Du übersetzt komplexe Krypto- und Trading-Themen in klare, verständliche Sprache, ohne Gewinnversprechen und unseriöse Übertreibungen.

•⁠ ⁠Du unterstützt bei Bedarf die morgendliche Recherche für Markt-Updates: News, X und On-Chain-Daten kurz zusammengefasst.

•⁠ ⁠Du hilfst dabei, dem Editing- und Motion-Team zu erklären, welche Charts, Screenshots und Animationen ein Video braucht.

•⁠ ⁠Du nutzt KI-Tools für Recherche und Tempo, überarbeitest den Output aber immer selbst. Ein Skript übernimmst du nie eins zu eins.

Was du mitbringst

•⁠ ⁠Schreiben: Du schreibst fehlerfreies Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau. Deine Texte klingen gesprochen natürlich und machen auch schwierige Zusammenhänge verständlich.

•⁠ ⁠Social Media: Du verstehst, wie Inhalte für YouTube, Shorts und X aufbereitet werden, und kannst ihre Planung und Veröffentlichung zuverlässig koordinieren.

Nicht das Richtige für dich, wenn:

Benefits

title: Co-Founder & CTO @ AI Model Efficiency Engine Venture, Berlin
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. Think ten specialists working on ten pieces, rather than one generalist carrying the whole task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder was selected for Slush 20 Under 20, awarded by Anthropic, Slush, Index Ventures and Sifted, and brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. We closed our pre-seed round in two weeks. With people already waiting to use the product, we are looking for a technical co-founder to help shape what comes next and bring it into production.

About the Role

As co-founder and CTO, you will help shape the company as well as its technology. Working alongside the founder as an eye-level partner, you will turn the ambition into an architecture, a product and an engineering team capable of delivering it.a

Your remit spans the efficiency engine, the platform beneath it and the people building both. You will lead our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, grow the team and establish the standards that guide its work. You have led engineering before, but stayed close to the code, and want to keep building as your responsibilities grow.

Two things define the technical challenge here. Efficiency is the product itself, so routing, fine-tuning, caching, quantization and open-weight serving sit at the heart of the roadmap. Agentic engineering is also central to how we work. You will set the standard for using individual agents and entire agent fleets effectively, building the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to move quickly while retaining sound engineering judgement.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with relentless intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and look for people who take initiative and see things through. You will have the scope to make consequential decisions early, and the responsibility to turn them into something that works.

What you’ll do

You will move between architecture, code and company building, setting the technical direction while building the team that delivers it.

  • Lead the engineering team: guide our founding AI engineer and backend platform engineer, review their work and establish the engineering and operational standards, including on-call and incident response.

  • Build the team: lead technical hiring and decide how engineering grows as the company develops.

  • Set the technical direction: make the architectural calls, shape the roadmap and decide what we build ourselves and where we use existing tools and services.

  • Develop the efficiency engine: bring together routing, semantic and prefix caching, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, distillation, quantization and batching, with inference economics informing each decision.

  • Own open-weight serving: choose and operate vLLM, SGLang or equivalent, including GPU capacity and European hosting, alongside closed providers through a single interface.

  • Make quality measurable: build rigorous eval harnesses and the evidence needed to establish whether a cheaper route still meets the agreed standard.

  • Build the platform underneath it: own the gateway API, provider layer, identity and tenancy, precise usage and cost accounting, secure storage of customer keys and European infrastructure as code, with GDPR and data residency requirements built in.

  • Stay hands-on: write code and play an active part in designing and building the platform and cost-efficiency systems. Develop our agentic engineering setup, from harness design and benchmarking to the agent workflows that help the team ship.

  • Represent the company technically: bring depth and clarity to customer pilots, enterprise security reviews and investor conversations.

About You

You have grown into engineering leadership without losing the instinct to build. When faced with a difficult problem, you explore what would make it possible and look for a workable path through it, weighing failure modes alongside unit economics. AI has changed how you work, and you have taken the time to understand where it helps, where it fails and how to use it well.

We are looking for depth in five areas:

  • Engineering leadership: you have been a CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering or engineering lead, ideally in a startup. You have hired and led engineers, established standards and taken responsibility for both the architecture and what the team shipped.

  • Backend and platform engineering: you bring deep experience in distributed systems, API design, streaming, Postgres, Kubernetes, Terraform and cloud operations, with a broad understanding of what makes a platform reliable and scalable. You have taken systems into production, operated them under significant load and worked through incidents yourself.

  • LLM cost efficiency: you have reduced costs in a production system and can explain the numbers, the decisions behind them and the trade-offs involved. Your experience covers techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA, routing, caching, quantization, distillation and batching, grounded in an understanding of serving economics.

  • Open-weight models in production: you have served, tuned, evaluated and operated open models under load, including the GPU and capacity decisions that come with them.

  • Agentic engineering: you build on strong coding fundamentals, with practical experience running agent fleets and designing and benchmarking their harnesses. You can reason independently about the code they produce and take responsibility for its quality.

You also bring a disciplined approach to LLM benchmarking: thoughtful eval design, statistical honesty and a willingness to reproduce results before relying on them.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

Nice to have

  • A strong open-source record, particularly in AI infrastructure or inference, with real users.

  • Experience with LiteLLM, NVIDIA NIM, TGI, llama.cpp or similar, and with self-hosted or air-gapped enterprise deployments.

  • Experience with European cloud providers such as Scaleway, Hetzner or OVH.

  • Experience working in startups tackling similar technical challenges.

Why Join

With the pre-seed round closed and the first steps already taken, you will join at a point where there is momentum to build on and considerable room to shape what comes next. You will build alongside the founder, choose and grow the engineering team, and receive co-founder equity in the business you help create.

The architecture, efficiency engine, security model and engineering culture are all still yours to shape. The decisions you make now will become the foundations for everything that follows.

We are entering a market where competitors have larger teams, more funding and an earlier start. Our conviction is that technical depth, focused decisions and a small team that works well together give us a meaningful opportunity to compete. For the right person, that is an interesting challenge to take on, with substantial ownership over how we approach it.

This is a full-time commitment, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible.

title: Senior Consultant Real World Evidence - Focus on Healthcare Data Analysis (m/f/d)
description:
About us

IGES GmbH specialises in health economic and strategic research and consulting services for international pharmaceutical and medical device manufacturers. It offers biotech, pharmaceutical and medical device companies solutions for market access, pricing and reimbursement of their medical innovations. The company has offices in France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom and also provides support for multinational product launches. IGES is part of the Athagoras Group, which brings together various consulting firms for the life sciences industry.

To strengthen our team in the area of Value Strategy & RWE, we are looking for a Senior Consultant Real World Evidence - Focus on Healthcare Data Analysis (m/f/d)


Your mission

  • Design, execution, evaluation and interpretation of analyses based on claims data – in particular health insurance fund data (GKV) and/or registry data – from data preparation through cohort definition to the presentation of results 
  • Interpretation and contextualisation of analysis results to generate robust real-world evidence, and its translation into strategic recommendations for our clients
  • Strategic consulting for market access, HE&OR and RWE departments at leading pharmaceutical companies and emerging biotechs
  • Providing technical oversight and quality assurance for analyses in interdisciplinary projects, as well as mentoring less experienced colleagues
  • Providing support on HTA-related issues (e.g. evidence requirements, PICO scoping, analysis strategies) and translating the results into publications, presentations and project reports
  • Conducting systematic literature reviews and structured evaluations to supplement findings from claims data
  • Active involvement in the further development of internal data and methodological expertise for analyses of health data from the FDZ-Gesundheit
  • Collaboration on the preparation and publication of results, e.g. in scientific journals, project reports and presentations of findings


Your profile

  • Successfully completed degree (master's/diploma) in health services research, public health, health economics, statistics, epidemiology or a comparable field 
  • Several years’ relevant professional experience in the analysis of claims data – in particular health insurance fund data (GKV) and/or register data – in an industrial or academic environment
  • Demonstrable ability to interpret analysis results independently, synthesise them into real-world evidence and present them in a manner tailored to the target audience
  • Proficiency in epidemiological and statistical methods, to the extent required for the practical evaluation of claims data
  • Experience in drafting scientific documents, e.g. study protocols, study reports or publications
  • Programming skills in R or Python would be an advantage
  • Knowledge of HTA/market access requirements is welcome but not essential
  • Analytical thinking, structured and careful working style, and a high degree of initiative
  • Open-minded and communicative personality with a team- and client-oriented approach
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English (academic level)


Our offer

  • Collaboration on varied projects involving highly innovative drugs at the interface of healthcare research, real-world evidence and strategic consulting
  • An interdisciplinary, collegial working environment with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths and good development prospects
  • Professional and personal development through challenging project work, plenty of scope for your own ideas and individually tailored further training (e.g. conferences)
  • Gain practical experience in using large claims data sets, as well as early development of expertise relating to the FDZ Gesundheit
  • Flexible working arrangements after structured training at the Berlin site, including the option to work from home
  • A Permanent position with competitive remuneration, flexible working hours, 30 days of holiday and additional time off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve

  • Experience with root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, statistical process control, capability studies, or measurement-system analysis.

  • Experience with supplier quality, incoming inspection, calibration, material certification, or production release.

  • Experience building quality processes in an early-stage, rapidly scaling, or vertically integrated organisation.

title: Principal Brand Designer (Spain or Portugal - based role)
description:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.


What you'll own

Define the future of OLX’s  Group's brand ecosystem

Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across  product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.


    What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust 

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design 

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills


    • Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.


    Hiring Process
    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
     
    First Stage 
    Portfolio & Design Leadership 
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage 
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership 
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Automatically cataloging more than 2 billion offers from over 50,000 online shops is a complex challenge that requires intelligent and scalable machine learning solutions. At idealo, our team working on offer recognition and catalog association is responsible for this process, which forms a central part of our price comparison platform.

We develop and apply modern machine learning methods, explore the potential of Large Language Models and agentic AI systems, and ensure our ML systems operate reliably and at scale in the cloud. From researching and evaluating new approaches to MLOps and production-ready ML systems, we combine scientific research with real-world engineering challenges.

As part of your Bachelor's or Master's thesis, you'll have the opportunity to contribute your own ideas, experiment with emerging technologies, and explore machine learning solutions using real-world e-commerce data.   • AI Agents: You research and develop agentic AI systems for automatically recognizing, processing, and cataloging product offers.

  • Foundation Models: You explore how Foundation Models and Large Language Models can be applied to product classification in e-commerce.

  • Machine Learning Development: You develop ML solutions in Python using frameworks and technologies such as PyTorch, AWS Strands, and AWS Bedrock in a cloud-based environment.

  • Scientific Research: You investigate current scientific approaches, develop your own ideas, and evaluate them using real-world datasets and use cases.

  • Practical Application: You explore how your approaches can improve automated offer cataloging while considering the requirements of scalable, production-ready ML systems.



Skills & Requirements

  • You are studying Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Information Technology, or a related STEM field, ideally with a focus on Machine Learning or Artificial Intelligence.

  • You enjoy tackling challenges actively and solving them pragmatically.

Die Energiewende hat ihren ersten Schritt geschafft. Am zweiten, entscheidenden, arbeiten wir.

Günstiger, erneuerbarer Strom ist da, nur zur falschen Zeit. Unsere Speicher und unsere Optimierung verschieben ihn dorthin, wo er gebraucht wird. Das entlastet Netze, dämpft Preise und macht Erneuerbare planbar.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) - AI Programs, Vinted Engineering
Staff Product Manager - Billing (VAT)
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the role

At Perk, we believe in empowering cross-functional teams that drive exceptional results for our customers and the company. We’re transforming how work gets done by eliminating tedious manual processes in travel, spend, and events.

As a Product Manager at Perk, you will play a pivotal role in driving innovation by identifying opportunities, shaping product strategy, and leading execution. You’ll work closely with customers, stakeholders, and lean product development teams to build best in class solutions for our users. We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the team and own the Billing product area.


Billing isn't just a back-office function for us; it's a strategic product area that directly impacts our ability to win in new markets and scale globally. Our billing platform enables finance teams to accurately analyse and forecast travel spend, the automation to streamline their accounting, and the accuracy to trust their financials. Thanks to our AI-powered invoice collection service and partner integrations, we help customers save thousands in VAT reclaims. We are on a mission to make complex financial operations feel effortless.

As the Staff Product Manager for Billing, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for a product that is the financial engine of our business. You will transform complex challenges—from international tax compliance to AI-powered invoice data extraction—into a seamless, scalable, and intelligent billing platform. This is a mission-critical role where you will directly shape our commercial strategy, enhance customer trust, and build a key pillar of our competitive advantage.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Spend ecosystem

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a world class team of making bold, fast bets informed customer feedback, data, market research, and deep intuition for how AI can reshape how teams operate

  • Use customer insights with technical possibilities, crafting intuitive user experiences that simplify the user experience

  • Help millions of employees and thousands of finance teams seamlessly manage expenses, cards, and invoice processing.

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Claude and Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products.

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI research, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it creatively to Perk products

  • Empower Your Team: Lead with a servant-leadership approach help stay focused, remove distractions, and foster creativity and collaboration

What You’ll Need

  • Experience That Counts: Significant experience in a tech company, with proven capability as a Product Manager. Experience working on a Tax product is a strong plus. Bonus if you have experience in development, design, or business roles (though not a must).

  • Finance and accounting: You have a working knowledge of accounting reconciliation and finance operations.

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking, with a passion to understand the entire expense lifecycle — from the moment of spend inception through automated reconciliation to final posting in the ERP system — and the specific friction points unique to complex accounting workflows

  • Fluency in data and how to make data-driven product decisions

  • Experience evaluating product decisions and prioritization trade-offs

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence small teams of engineers & designers toward a common goal

  • Ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders and large cross-functional teams

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Bolt, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including equity in the company

  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge

  • Health perks such as private healthcare or gym allowance depending on your location

  • "Flexible compensation plan" to help you diversify and increase the net salary

  • Unforgettable Perk events including travel to one of our hubs

  • Mental health support tool for your wellbeing

  • Exponential growth opportunities

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
We help companies get compensation right.

What we get paid at work has a massive impact on our lives, and it’s one of the biggest factors in hiring and retaining talent - and yet so many companies struggle to get it right. They simply have no choice but to rely on poor data and unsophisticated tools for their pay decisions. That’s why we created Ravio.

We help many of the world’s most innovative and ambitious companies build stronger teams and reach their goals through better compensation. Our real-time data platform brings compensation into the modern age, tracking the market across all compensation types from salary to equity and benefits.

Ravio is growing fast, which means you can too. We’ve established ourselves as the European leader in our space serving more than 1,200 clients, and now have our sights set on becoming the global go to place for compensation data and tools for managing compensation.

Joining a startup and scaling it into a global product is one of the most challenging and rewarding experiences a career can offer. If that sounds exciting to you, you’re in the right place.


The role

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our engineering team and play a major role in our technical leadership during a significant platform shift.

Ravio is moving from a traditional SaaS posture to a platform built around agents - parent agents fronting our compensation data, specialist agents underneath, durable workflows, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. You’ll own architecture and technical design across the stack: the customer-facing web app, the agentic platform, and the shared infrastructure connecting them.

You’ll bring system design depth - the kind that holds up under load, failure, and coordination across services and teams. You’ll continue to raise the bar on code quality, reliability, and the technical decisions that shape what we ship.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role - leading technical decision-making and tackling the hardest problems we encounter. There are also upcoming opportunities to move into management as our company continues to grow, if you wish.


Requirements

  • 8+ years commercial engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership during platform shifts - owning architecture, driving decisions, raising the bar through code review and design review, especially where LLM assisted engineering has become the standard

  • System design depth as your headline strength. Concrete: durability and consistency under failure, multi-service orchestration, data platforms, performance and cost at scale, observability and ops fluency

  • Senior-level fluency in TypeScript and Node, comfortable across the backend (PostgreSQL, GraphQL or HTTP APIs, GCP-shaped infra)

  • Comfortable owning code in a distributed monorepo with multiple deployable services

  • Ships fast under product pressure - we’re moving from PMF to scale and the role needs that pace

 

Nice to have

  • Production experience with agentic systems - tool calling, multi-step orchestration, LLM evals.

  • Workflow engines (Temporal, Cadence, Step Functions) - even if not Temporal specifically

  • MCP, Anthropic SDK, or other LLM platform work

  • Building developer platforms, internal SDKs, or framework-shaped surfaces

  • Eval-driven development, prompt engineering at scale, LLM-judge harnesses

  • React or another modern frontend framework

 

Our tech stack

  • Frontend

    • React

    • Typescript

    • GraphQL (Apollo Client)

    • Playwright

    • Jest

    • Storybook + Chromatic

    • Mantine

    • GCP (Cloud Run)

  • Backend

    • Typescript

    • PostgreSQL

    • GraphQL Yoga

    • Jest

    • Auth0

    • GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage + more)

  • AI / agentic platform

    • Opus/GPT/Gemini/and many more model families

    • Vertex/Bedrock/Foundry - Cloud deployed models

    • Temporal - durable workflow engine

    • MCP servers as the tool layer

    • AI gateway (Bifrost) for logging, routing, governance

    • Eval harness (Phoenix) - golden queries, LLM-as-judge

    • Memory layer (Neo4j)

  • All the other good stuff

    • GitHub Actions

    • Datadog

    • Figma

    • Slack

    • Linear

 

The opportunity at Ravio right now

From your perspective, there are three critical things to look for when evaluating this role: a company going places, a strong engineering culture, and a role that gives you a true opportunity to have impact as a technical leader.

Ultimately it’s for you to decide whether that’s true in our two-way street interview process. Here’s a summary of where we are right now and what you can expect as a starting point.

There’s a lot happening at Ravio right now. We’ve just raised our Series A led by tier 1 US investors Spark Capital, and have acquired the benchmarking business of our competitor - Compete. We’ve got new joiners starting almost every week, and we’re rapidly expanding outside of our core markets in Europe. We need you to help us maintain our velocity and continue to build a scalable org and product.

Our core benchmarking product is at product-market fit, and we have a couple of new modules in the 0-1 phase. This means we’re at an exciting stage that involves 0-to-1 building in some areas, and building for scale in others. That’s true across the business, we’re continuing to expand and experiment, while systemising and doubling down on what is already working well from our seed phase.

Beyond the core product, we’re building Ravio’s agentic platform - parent agents fronting our compensation data with specialist agents underneath, durable workflows on Temporal, an MCP-based tool layer, and an eval harness to maintain consistency. It’s a platform engineering effort with the same care and rigour we apply to the rest of the product. A Staff engineer joining now would help shape the foundations of how Ravio’s product is built for the next phase.

We’d like to think Ravio is a great place to be a Staff engineer - we have technical leaders who know first hand the importance of creating space and focus for engineering teams to do their best work. And you’ll be working alongside many accomplished and world class teammates, who are energised by the work they do and have a high bar for themselves and their colleagues.

 

Why join Ravio?

  • Shape an agentic platform from its early stages, with senior engineering peers and a high autonomy bar.

  • Opportunity for fast-tracked professional growth at a scaleup backed by world-class investors alongside a smart, energetic team.

  • Blend of IC work and leadership, giving you both hands-on impact and career growth.

  • Remote-friendly, flexible work culture with a high degree of ownership.

  • While we’re very focused, we also know how to have fun in the process.

  • Build a meaningful product that helps people get paid fairly and competitively in their careers.

 

Compensation & benefits

  • £110,000 - £170,000

  • Company ownership (everyone gets a meaningful equity stake in Ravio)

  • 37 days paid time off (25 days holiday + 4 wellness days + 8 public holidays)

  • Up to 6% pension matching scheme

  • £60 a month wellness allowance (Invest in your physical wellbeing, on us)

  • Income protection insurance (for full peace of mind in case you cannot work because of sickness or disability)

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
Studio is where creators build and finish video on ElevenLabs, powered by our generative graph engine, Flows. You’ll own our “produce once, distribute everywhere” workflow. It takes a finished Studio project and runs it through our dubbing pipeline to produce it in many languages and aspect ratios, with auto-translated captions. Today that means duplicating and rebuilding projects by hand.
This work is entirely greenfield: the specs aren’t written yet. You’ll shape them through written proposals (RFCs), pressure-test data structures with the team lead, and carry the project from first draft to launch.
You’re a strong backend generalist who is good with complex data structures and has the product instincts to decide what’s worth building.

Requirements

  • Strong backend generalist who has designed and shipped complex, data-heavy systems end to end.

  • Comfortable with enterprise-grade concerns such as usage reporting and accounts.

  • Evidence of product ownership: side projects, open source, or work in a product-facing context.

  • Has taken projects from inception to launch with little hand-holding.

Bonus: experience with media or video-processing pipelines (helpful, not required)

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About the Role

We're hiring a System Architect to build the engine behind our full-funnel lifecycle programs across Creator, Enterprise, and Developer segments. This is not a marketing technologist role — we're not looking for someone to maintain the stack. We're looking for someone to design the machine that runs on it.

The core challenge: today, every new industry, segment, or language means another fork — another campaign tree, another set of manual sequences to maintain. Your job is to make those parameters instead. You'll architect a lifecycle system where launching a new vertical in a new market is a configuration change, not a rebuild, and where onboarding, nurture, upsell, and ABM programs compose from shared logic rather than duplicated effort.

You'll be both architect and operator — defining the data model and segmentation logic underneath the journeys, then shipping them. You'll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth, and Data, and you'll scope engineering support rather than queue behind it. This is a build year: you're inventing the system, not inheriting one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect a parameterised lifecycle system where new industries, segments, and languages are configuration, not new campaign trees

  • Design and launch onboarding, nurture, and upsell campaigns across Creator, Enterprise, and Developer segments

  • Prototype and ship your own integrations and logic; you scope engineering help, you don't queue behind it

  • Own lifecycle touchpoints across channels with clear, measurable goals

  • Build multilingual nurture flows that scale globally, maintaining message quality and performance

  • Set up and manage robust A/B testing plans and track performance across the full funnel

  • Own the reporting framework for lifecycle marketing; define success metrics and communicate learnings

  • Build ABM infrastructure for targeted, account-level nurture and retention programs

  • Partner with the design and engineering teams to deploy campaigns that require light integration or tech support

  • Bring structure and governance to lifecycle strategy—ensuring data hygiene, segmentation accuracy, and QA rigor

Who You Are

You think in funnels and systems, not one-off campaigns. You're equally comfortable in the weeds of a HubSpot workflow and in a room with Sales talking about pipeline quality. You default to testing and measuring rather than guessing, and you're excited about using AI to do more with less — automating the repetitive work so you can focus on strategy and experimentation. You move fast, take ownership of outcomes, and collaborate easily across marketing, sales, and product.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years in B2B lifecycle, demand gen, or marketing automation roles, ideally at a high-growth SaaS company

  • Deep proficiency in HubSpot — building workflows, scoring models, and automated nurture programs

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and how marketing and sales data connect end-to-end

  • Experience building and managing lead scoring and MQL/SQL/PQL funnels

  • Experience running or supporting ABM programs for target accounts

  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable owning funnel metrics and translating data into action

  • Excellent cross-functional communication, especially with Sales and RevOps

Nice to Have

  • Experience building AI-powered marketing workflows — for personalization, content generation, or campaign automation

  • Experience marketing to developer or technical buyer personas

  • Familiarity with product-led growth motions and PQL-to-enterprise conversion

  • SQL or basic data querying skills

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead social strategy across all ElevenLabs brands and sub-brands as the social function scales

  • Move into a broader content role spanning video, editorial, and social

  • Expand into brand marketing or creative direction as the growth team evolves

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The Role

ElevenLabs is scaling globally at extraordinary speed, growing from 400 to 1,000+ by the end of 2026. We operate across 46+ countries, with a highly distributed workforce spanning researchers, engineers, GTM teams, operators, creatives, and frontier AI specialists. Compensation and total rewards are core to how we attract and retain the best builders in the world.

This environment is inherently complex. Different regulatory frameworks. Different talent markets. Different role archetypes. High volatility in frontier AI compensation benchmarks. That complexity is not a constraint, it’s the challenge.

We are looking for someone to own and evolve our global compensation and total rewards strategy, designing systems that are competitive in frontier AI markets, internally consistent, globally scalable, and built for long-term sustainability.

You will operate as the single point of accountability for compensation architecture across the company, partnering closely with Operations, Legal and Finance.

If you’re energized by solving hard global compensation problems, building clarity across diverse markets, and designing systems that scale globally without slowing the company down, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Compensation Strategy & Philosophy

  • Own and continuously refine ElevenLabs’ global compensation philosophy.

  • Ensure pay, equity, and incentives reinforce attraction, retention, and performance.

  • Balance market competitiveness with internal equity and financial discipline.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on complex, high-impact compensation decisions.

Job Architecture & Leveling

  • Design systems that introduce rigor without slowing the company down.

  • Evolve our structure intentionally to match our scale: mature enough to support 46+ countries and a diverse set of roles, but not over-engineered or bureaucratic.

  • Drive clarity and consistency in job architecture, leveling frameworks, and compensation bands globally.

Equity & Long-Term Incentives

  • Design equity programs that reflect a core ElevenLabs belief: employees should be genuine owners in the company and invested in our long-term ambition.

  • Own our equity philosophy, structure, and grant strategy.

  • Partner with Finance and Legal on equity design, refresh cycles, and promotion grants.

Compensation Cycles & Governance

  • Assist annual compensation reviews end-to-end.

  • Design clear off-cycle governance and decision frameworks.

  • Build calibration rigor and tooling that scales globally.

  • Introduce AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve speed and consistency.

  • Act as the final escalation point for leveling and pay consistency decisions.

Benefits & Total Rewards

  • Own global benefits strategy across a distributed workforce.

  • Balance standardisation with regional relevance.

  • Ensure benefits are competitive in frontier talent markets while remaining operationally scalable.

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • 5+ years in Compensation or Total Rewards, ideally in high-growth technology companies that operate across multiple countries

  • Ownership of equity programs

  • Strong track record of building compensation systems that scale

  • Experience designing and evolving job architectures and leveling systems

  • Experience operating in fast-scaling, ambiguous environments

Skills & Attributes

  • First-principles thinker: approach problems without bias

  • Hands-on builder: comfortable designing systems from scratch

  • Strong analytical skills: the ability to translate data into clear, strategic recommendations

  • Comfortable partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions in complex, fast-moving environments

  • Excellent communication skills

  • High standards and high ownership

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

About the role:

We are seeking an experienced Sales Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team who are responsible for optimizing the success of Docker's Sales & GTM teams to accelerate our revenue growth.

Your primary focus will be supporting our global Sales organisation, with a focus on EMEA and APAC. You will build and streamline sales processes and systems, design territories and segmentation models, support forecasting and pipeline inspection, manage quota models, and manage projects from conception to release. You will work alongside GTM leadership to define, build and document processes and overall sales strategy and planning, and partner with the dedicated Operations owners for BDR, SE, TAM, Renewals and Channel where your work overlaps with theirs.

An ideal candidate is a start-up builder who has experience working with Sales teams and has worked closely with Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, RingLead and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. This role reports to the Director of Sales Operations and is based in EMEA.

In this role, you will:

  • Support the global Sales leadership team, with a focus on EMEA and APAC, in running their business

  • Design and maintain territory and segmentation models, and document account engagement models, with a focus on EMEA and APAC

  • Support forecasting processes and pipeline inspection, working with Sales leadership to ensure good forecast hygiene and accuracy in Gong

  • Help manage GTM quota and compensation models

  • Assist in the fiscal year planning cycle

  • Partner with the dedicated Operations owners for BDR, SE, TAM, Renewals and Channel to ensure aligned processes, quotas and territories across teams

  • Manage and prioritise implementation of key projects including scoping of requirements, writing business requirement documents, collaborating with cross functional teams, and working alongside the business systems team to build, test and roll out new processes

  • Manage and maintain the sales technology stack, ensuring data integrity and system efficiency, and owning vendor relationships

  • Optimize the sales process and ensure a smooth deal flow from lead generation through to deal closure and repeat renewal

  • Identify and implement continuous process improvements to enhance productivity and performance

  • Analyse data to identify trends and areas of opportunity, and provide insights and recommendations to leadership

  • Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders across various GTM departments

  • Contribute to efforts around data quality, integrity, standardisation, and controls that ensure accurate reporting and forecasting


Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in Sales Operations

  • Experience working for a high growth software/SaaS company
