  • Prior experience in forecasting and pipeline management

  • Knowledgeable in managing projects including writing project plans, business requirement documents, business summaries and user acceptance testing

  • Track record of defining operational processes and collaborating with technology teams for successful implementation of projects

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

  • Technically savvy with Google Suite, Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, RingLead and LinkedIn Sales Nav

  • Ability to think strategically and translate business needs into actionable plans within a fast paced environment

  • Comfortable and familiar with cross-functional collaboration

  • Able to work autonomously, with a constant focus on building for the future

Additional attributes:

  • Experience in one or more of BDR, Renewals, TAM, SE, SA, Customer Experience, Channel or Provisioning operations

  • Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and reporting tools

  • Experience in building AI agents

  • Comfortable with new technologies and ability to communicate with those who are tech-savvy

  • You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program

  • You will learn how to navigate through award-winning sales tools such as Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, RingLead, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Docker

  • Review existing processes and metrics to identify areas of improvement

  • Begin building strong cross functional relationships

  • Take ownership of tools within the tech stack and start scoping refinements and improvements

  • Build documentation to support new and existing processes

  • Start implementing improvements to assist with data integrity and accuracy

Europe: €77,000 – €110,000 + equity

title: Partnerships Development Lead
description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

As a Partnerships Development Lead, you’ll play a critical role in building and nurturing a robust ecosystem of partners and stakeholders around Sierra, amplifying our reach and market impact.

  • Industry Partnerships: Develop and grow partnerships with key industry players and technology platforms

  • Strategic Customer Channels: Explore and cultivate alternative customer acquisition channels beyond traditional sales, leveraging Sierra’s ecosystem of investors, partners, and industry influencers to drive inbound interest and adoption

  • GTM Strategy & Collaboration: Align partnership efforts with Sierra’s broader GTM approach, collaborating closely with Sales and Marketing

  • Investor & VC/PE Engagement: Build and deepen relationships with VCs and PE firms to position Sierra as a strategic AI partner across their portfolios. Proactively identify opportunities to introduce Sierra to portfolio companies that would benefit from our agents

  • Industry & Market Expansion: Gather market intelligence, share insights to inform product development, and explore opportunities for potential growth across new market segments and geographies

What you’ll bring

  • 8+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, or related roles in tech

  • Strong understanding of the VC/PE landscape and experience working with investors

  • Proven track record of structuring and closing high-value partnerships with senior stakeholders

  • Ability to engage and maintain relationships with C-level executives, investors, and key decision-makers

  • Analytical mindset to evaluate partnership opportunities and align them with Sierra’s long-term vision

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving startup environment

Even better…

  • Prior experience at a high-growth AI or enterprise SaaS startup

  • Deep expertise in a few of our key industries: financial services, healthcare, telecommunications, media, travel, transportation and hospitality, retain and consumer goods, and/or technology

  • Experience structuring and managing ecosystem partnerships

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team.   • Expertise IaC & DevOps : Tu maîtrises l'automatisation via Terraform/Ansible, l'écosystème Kubernetes et les déploiements continus (ArgoCD/GitLab CI).

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, AWS ou GCP avec du Terraform) avec deux Sfeirians. 
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux.

title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
  • Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
  • Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
  • Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
  • Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
  • Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
  • Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

  • You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
  • You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
  • You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
  • You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
  • You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

  • Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
  • Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
  • Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
  • A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
  • Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
  • Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
  • Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
  • Clear, structured documentation habits
  • Fluent English and French skills
  • Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

  • Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
  • Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
  • Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
  • Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
  • SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

  • Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
  • Customer satisfaction with your contribution
  • Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
  • Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
  • Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
  • Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
  • Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Quality & Training Manager
description:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

To support our continued growth, we are creating a new, strategic role at the heart of operational performance and customer experience. There is no Quality & Training activity in the Group today : you will build it from the ground up.

description:
About H:

H exists to push the boundaries of superintelligence with agentic AI. By automating complex, multi-step tasks typically performed by humans, AI agents will help unlock full human potential.

  • Take ownership of the new brand platform: positioning, identity, tone of voice and messaging house, and drive its rollout internally and externally.

  • Build a brand system that flexes by market (France, UK, US) without losing coherence, and that separates our two registers: a bold "vision voice" and a precise "capability voice".

  • Set and enforce brand guidelines across every touchpoint: website, decks, events, product, recruiting.

Build awareness where our buyers are (Awareness)

  • Prepare and lead the brand side of our US launch.

  • Partner with Growth so awareness turns into qualified relationships and pipeline.

Earn authority (Authority)

  • Grow H's thought leadership around the execution gap in enterprise AI and "AI that actually works".

The index combines aided awareness, unaided awareness and consideration of H in enterprise AI, tracked quarterly by market. Your first milestone is to set its baseline, since none exists today.

Horizon Target First 90 days BAI baseline set in France and the US; brand platform rolled out France Top 3 in aided awareness among SBF 120 decision-makers, then Top 3 in unaided awareness US Top 5 in aided awareness among Fortune 500 decision-makers, then Top 3 in unaided awareness within 2 years for AI for enterprise

Supporting indicators: share of voice versus competitors, and the share of H mentions about product and value rather than founders and funding.

  • You have led a brand repositioning or relaunch end to end, from strategy to rollout, and can show what it changed.

  • You have built awareness among enterprise decision-makers, and you have measured it (brand tracking, share of voice, consideration).

  • You are as comfortable with a CEO and a leadership team as with a brand studio or a PR agency, and you know how to brief, challenge and arbitrate.

  • You think in systems and act in details: a clear strategy, a sharp eye for craft, and a bias for shipping.

  • Fluent English is required; French is a strong plus.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

  • You have built a brand in an emerging category, where the words themselves were still being defined.

  • You have worked across Europe and the US and know how a story needs to flex from one market to the other.

  • You care about proof: case studies, customer voices and numbers matter more to you than slogans.

  • You are low ego and high ownership, and you like building a team and a function from the ground up.

Location

Paris/London, hybrid: 3 days a week on average in our office (8 rue Sainte-Cécile, 75009) or with customers. Regular travel to London and the US.

description:
ENGLISH VERSION

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN (Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne, avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis, reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur (https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur), en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set. Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT.

Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée.

Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées.

· Capacité à travailler en équipe

title: Maintenance Lead
description:
Een fabriek waar volop wordt geïnvesteerd in techniek en waar continu verbeteren onderdeel is van de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Maintenance Lead krijg je de ruimte om niet alleen technische problemen op te lossen, maar vooral te zorgen dat we ze steeds beter vóór zijn.

In Doetinchem maken we verschillende soorten noten en pindakaas voor bekende merken als Whole Earth én voor grote retailers. Onze productielijnen draaien volop en ondertussen bouwen we verder aan onze Factory of the Future. Dat vraagt om technische kennis, een analytische blik en de drive om te blijven verbeteren.

Jouw rol als Maintenance Lead

Als Maintenance Lead werk je aan één belangrijk doel: onze installaties en productielijnen steeds betrouwbaarder laten presteren.

Je onderzoekt complexe en terugkerende storingen, analyseert oorzaken en bepaalt wat nodig is om herhaling te voorkomen. Daarbij ben je veel op de productievloer te vinden en werk je nauw samen met operators, Equipment Owners, Line Leads en collega's binnen de technische organisatie.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • het analyseren en structureel oplossen van complexe en terugkerende storingen;

  • het slimmer inrichten en continu verbeteren van preventief onderhoud;

  • het realiseren van technische verbeteringen en deze borgen in onderhoudsplannen en standaarden;

  • het begeleiden en technisch verder ontwikkelen van operators en Equipment Owners;

  • het bijdragen aan technische projecten, bijvoorbeeld als Startup Lead of projectlid.

We werken hierbij volgens ons Integrated Work System (IWS), waarmee we continu verbeteren onderdeel maken van onze dagelijkse manier van werken.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Een technische functie met verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte voor eigen initiatief en volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Daarnaast krijg je:

  • een salaris tussen € 3.580 en € 4.700 bruto per maand;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 12 ATV-dagen;

  • 8% vakantietoeslag;

  • een goede pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding;

  • volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • vier keer per jaar een pakket met Intersnack-producten.

Jouw ingrediënten

Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en een technische achtergrond, bijvoorbeeld in werktuigbouwkunde, mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt ervaring met maintenance, reliability, engineering of technische verbeteringen binnen een productieomgeving. Werk je nu bijvoorbeeld als Maintenance Engineer, Reliability Engineer of technisch specialist? Dan kan deze rol een mooie volgende stap zijn.

Je combineert technisch inzicht met een analytische blik. Je wilt begrijpen waarom een probleem ontstaat, legt verbanden en vertaalt dit naar oplossingen die op de lange termijn werken. Je communiceert makkelijk met collega's op de productievloer en deelt graag jouw technische kennis.

Wij zijn Intersnack

Wij zijn een van de grootste snackproducenten van Europa. Met bekende merken als Chio, POM-BÄR, Tyrrells en Whole Earth én producten voor grote retailers vind je onze snacks overal terug.

In onze fabriek in Doetinchem draait alles om noten en pindakaas. We investeren volop in onze mensen, techniek en processen en bouwen samen aan onze Factory of the Future: een fabriek waarin we steeds slimmer, veiliger en beter produceren.

description:

In Doetinchem produceren we daarnaast meer dan 75 soorten pindakaas. Grote kans dus dat je iets van ons in huis hebt. Onze dagelijkse uitdaging is om supermarkten steeds van de juiste voorraden te voorzien. Dat vraagt om een productieorganisatie die elke dag scherp is, vooruitkijkt en samen blijft verbeteren. De operatie bestaat uit twee fabrieken en vier lijnstructuren. Als Senior Line Lead ben je verantwoordelijk voor Noten Verpakken en Noten Processing. Je werkt nauw samen met de Line Leads van beide teams en zorgt samen met hen voor een optimale output van de notenfabriek. Onze operatie draait in 3 ploegen, zelf werk je in dagdienst.

Onze ambitie is helder: een factory of the future met 100% betrokkenheid van alle collega’s en nul verliezen. Een omgeving waarin iedereen verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor zijn of haar deel van het proces. Met IWS (Integrated Work System) als onze verbetermethodiek werken we stap voor stap aan die ambitie.

Wat ga je doen?

Je geeft leiding in een productieomgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Juist daar zorg jij voor overzicht, duidelijke prioriteiten en een werksfeer waarin collega’s zich gezien en gehoord voelen. Je neemt de leiding wanneer dat nodig is, maar geeft je teams vooral de ruimte om zelf verantwoordelijkheid te pakken, beslissingen te nemen en initiatief te tonen.

Samen met de lijnteams werk je continu aan betere prestaties. Je begeleidt de organisatie door de verschillende IWS-fasen en geeft richting tijdens de dagelijkse DDS-overleggen (Daily Direction Setting). Je analyseert onder andere verbruik, doorlooptijden, afwijkingen en andere procesvariabelen en gebruikt systemen als ERP, FMES en Ultimo om prestaties inzichtelijk te maken. Daarnaast neem je deel aan projecten en werk je intensief samen met onder andere Technische Dienst, Quality Control en Technologie aan procesanalyses en verbeteringen.

Je rapporteert aan de Plant Manager.

Wat bieden we jou?

Je krijgt een stevige leidinggevende rol binnen een productieomgeving waarin volop wordt geïnvesteerd in mensen, processen en technologie. Daarbij werk je samen met gedreven collega’s die er iedere dag iets beter van willen maken. Je krijgt:

  • Een jaarcontract voor 36-40 uur per week, met de intentie om dit daarna om te zetten naar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd;

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 3 ADV-dagen per jaar (op fulltime basis);

  • Een pensioenregeling waarbij wij twee derde van de premie betalen;

  • Een personeelswinkel met aantrekkelijke kortingen;

  • Vier keer per jaar een goedgevuld snackpakket;

  • Ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale productieorganisatie.

Jouw ingrediënten

Je hebt ervaring in een leidinggevende functie binnen een productieomgeving, bij voorkeur in food, en beschikt over een afgeronde hbo-opleiding. Je begrijpt hoe productie- en logistieke processen werken en hebt kennis van hygiëne-, kwaliteits- en health & safety-systemen en voorschriften. Ervaring met continu verbeteren is belangrijk; kennis van IWS of vergelijkbare verbetermethodieken is mooi meegenomen. Je bent analytisch, houdt overzicht wanneer de druk toeneemt en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Daarbij combineer je duidelijk leiderschap met aandacht voor de ontwikkeling van je team. Je beheerst Nederlands en Engels goed.

Wie zijn wij?

Intersnack is een van de toonaangevende snackproducenten van Europa. We produceren bekende merken en private label-producten die je terugvindt in vrijwel iedere supermarkt. Bij ons staat ondernemend handelen centraal. Je krijgt ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verbeteringen door te voeren en verantwoordelijkheid te pakken. Tegelijkertijd doen we het samen. De sfeer is nuchter en professioneel, de lijnen zijn kort en collega’s helpen elkaar wanneer dat nodig is. Samen groeien en verantwoord denken zijn belangrijke onderdelen van onze cultuur. We combineren de kennis en ervaring van onze teams met individueel eigenaarschap en blijven investeren in innovatie, veiligheid, duurzaamheid en efficiëntere productie.

Hoe ziet jouw week eruit?

Je geniet van een gezonde balans tussen focus op kantoor en vrijheid op de weg:

  • Maandag: Je start de week op je (thuis)kantoor. Je verzorgt de administratie, plant je afspraken voor de komende week en werkt offertes uit.

  • Dinsdag t/m vrijdag: Je bent hét gezicht van De Wild. Je bent onderweg en stapt binnen bij klanten en prospects. Je voelt je thuis op de werkvloer van de vakhandel en spreekt de taal van de sector.

  • 1 x per kwartaal kom je bij elkaar met de directie, sales, marketing en engineering om samen de aanpak in de markt en alle innovaties en productontwikkelingen te bespreken. Uiteraard ben je tussendoor ook van harte welkom op kantoor in Roosendaal.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Accountmanager bij De Wild krijg je de volle verantwoordelijkheid over jouw eigen rayon. Je vindt de ideale balans (50/50) tussen het koesteren van bestaande relaties en het enthousiasmeren van nieuwe business.

  • Relatiebeheer & Acquisitie: Je onderhoudt intensief contact met onze dealers in Noord-Oost Nederland & Limburg

Wij zoeken een collega die spreekt vanuit passie en ervaring binnen de groene sector. Je herkent jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Talent voor Sales: Je krijgt energie van het binnenhalen van nieuwe accounts en het uitbouwen van bestaande relaties.

Dit bieden wij

Bij De Wild word je onderdeel van een warm familiebedrijf met een informele werksfeer. Je krijgt veel vrijheid om je werk naar eigen inzicht in te richten.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Confidential Computing & Runtime Security (Eindhoven)
description:
About Fortanix:  

In today's world, where data spreads across various clouds and devices, traditional security measures aren't enough. Businesses need a dynamic approach to defend against constant cyber threats and ensure agile data security. Fortanix leads the way in data-centric cybersecurity for hybrid multicloud environments, using advanced cryptography, encryption, and confidential AI solutions.   

As data breaches become more frequent and traditional defenses fall short, we focus on data exposure management to keep your information safe. Our unified data security platform addresses vulnerabilities in hybrid multicloud environments, defends against threats, and makes it easier to discover, assess, and fix data exposure risks. Whether implementing a Zero Trust model or preparing for the post-quantum computing era, we help businesses worldwide protect their most sensitive data, wherever it is.  

Our commitment to solving the world’s toughest data security challenges has earned Fortanix multiple Cybersecurity Excellence and Innovation Awards, as well as recognition from industry giants such as Nvidia, Microsoft, Intel, ServiceNow, and Snowflake.  

Our team includes industry leaders and cryptography experts, creating a culture of trust, innovation and collaboration where every voice is valued. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, we're looking for passionate individuals to help us shape the future of data security and work towards a safer digital future. 

Requirements

At the intersection of systems engineering, security, and cryptography, we're building technology that helps organizations protect their most sensitive data—even while it's actively being processed. If you're passionate about low-level software, secure systems, and solving complex technical challenges, this is an opportunity to work on some of the most advanced security problems in the industry. 

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Runtime Encryption team, you'll help shape the future of confidential computing by developing the tools, SDKs, and platform capabilities that enable secure execution environments. You'll work across the software stack—from applications and runtimes down to the operating system and hardware layers—while collaborating with a team of engineers pushing the boundaries of data protection. 

This role offers the chance to work on cutting-edge technologies that protect data in use, at rest, and in transit, while contributing to products used by organizations around the world to secure their most critical workloads. 

Location 

We strongly prefer candidates who are within commuting distance of our Eindhoven, Netherlands office and are excited to work in a hybrid environment. For exceptional candidates with deep domain expertise in confidential computing, systems security, or low-level software engineering, remote work may be considered. 

 

What you’ll do (Duties and Responsibilities):  

  • Develop tools and SDKs for confidential computing platforms.  
  • Support other teams within Fortanix to use tools related to confidential computing platforms developed internally  
  • Design, develop, and implement high-quality software solutions that meet security and performance standards.  
  • Investigate and resolve complex issues spanning application, runtime, kernel, and platform layers. 
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends in security and confidential computing.  
  • Conduct code reviews, ensure best practices in software development, and maintain high standards of code quality.  
  • Drive the adoption of new tools, methodologies, and processes to improve development efficiency and product quality. 

 

What you’ll need (Basic Qualifications) 

  • A passion for systems programming and low-level software development, particularly in x86-based environments. 
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and an appreciation for modern programming languages and abstractions, particularly Rust. 
  • Solid understanding of Linux kernel and operating system fundamentals.  
  • A desire to work within a small, highly collaborative team and help grow its technical expertise and impact. 
  • At least 3-5 years of hands-on experience with C/C++ or Rust  
  • Bachelor or Master in Computer Science, Information Security or related field 
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.  
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts.  

 

Preferred Technical And Professional Expertise  

  • Experience with trusted execution environments or confidential computing technologies. 
  • Knowledge of rust compiler, virtualization, or cloud infrastructure. 
  • Familiarity with low-level security concepts, attack mitigations, and secure systems design, along with a desire to deepen expertise in these areas. 
  • Knowledge of software development tools and methodologies, including CI/CD, Agile, and DevOps.   
  • Contributions to open-source projects. 

Benefits

  • We offer a competitive salary and equity package
  • 40 hours of Volunteer Time Off/year
  • The opportunity to redefine cloud computing in a friendly, collaborative work environment.  

Fortanix is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!

description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Over the last 12 months we've grown from 3k to 150k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

title: Senior FP&A Analyst (all genders)
description:
About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

Your Role

Do you want to move beyond traditional Excel modeling and define the future of data-driven finance operations?

Are you ready to be a key architect of the financial narrative for a high-growth SaaS business backed by world-class PE investors?

...then you are our perfect match!

Prepare for a steep learning curve and the opportunity to leave a lasting legacy by evolving our FP&A infrastructure for the next stage of scale. This is not a 'run the model and report back' role; we want someone who interrogates the numbers, surfaces the story behind them, and is willing to challenge assumptions at every level of the organisation.

Please note: This is a 12 month maternity cover.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Strategic Visibility: Build, maintain, and present meaningful dashboards and reports (e.g., Monthly Flash, Management Pack, Board Pack) that enable the Board, CFO, and Head of FP&A to monitor performance and take action.

  • Modernize the Stack: Support the migration of our FP&A tool/platform by defining requirements, mapping data flows, validating systems, and training stakeholders.

  • Architect Planning Frameworks: Implement end-to-end forecasting and budgeting templates and processes to enable efficient, accurate quarterly and annual planning cycles.

  • Define the Truth: Partner with the Data team to validate SaaS KPIs, ensuring a single version of truth across all business reporting.

  • Sales & Marketing Partnering: Support pipeline-to-forecast conversion modeling and commission tracking for Sales, while collaborating with Marketing to optimize segment profitability and ROI.

  • Operational Ownership: Manage and forecast global OPEX directly with department heads and support the Accounting team with month-end reviews and ad-hoc strategic business cases.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • The Foundation: Minimum 4+ years’ experience in FP&A, business finance, or a similar analytical role, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or subscription business.

  • The "Scar Tissue": Proven track record of building complex financial models and managing investor-grade reporting (Private Equity/PE experience is a significant plus).

  • The Builder: Experience with platform/tool migrations (FP&A or ERP systems) and a history of driving process improvements.

Skills

  • Technical Mastery: Highly proficient in Excel/G-Sheets; SQL experience is a plus.

  • AI & Automation: Proven track record of leveraging AI-driven tools and methodologies to streamline analytical workflows and optimize repetitive tasks.

  • SaaS Fluency: Deep understanding of SaaS economics and metrics (ARR, Churn, LTV/CAC).

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written English; German is a bonus but not required.

Mindset

  • The Interrogator: You don't just report numbers; you surface the story behind them and challenge assumptions at every level.

  • The Owner Mindset: You take full ownership of your workstreams and drive change in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Bias to Action: You prefer a "shipped" automated solution over a "perfect" manual one.

  • Keep it Simple: You champion the value of simplicity, identifying process improvements and eliminating non-value-added tasks.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

  • Recharge & Unwind: We value your downtime. You start with 26 days of leave, plus we love to top that up with additional discretionary "X-days" to make sure you’re truly rested.

  • Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

  • Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.

  • Exclusive Employee Discounts: Get more for your money with access to the "Benefits at Work" platform, offering significant discounts on top global brands.

  • Your Benefits, Your Choice: Through Probonio, you get a monthly budget to spend on what matters to you—whether that’s your public transport pass or other flexible perks that fit your lifestyle.

 

What Matters to Us

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

We build and operate large-scale web crawling and extraction systems that turn unstructured, dynamic websites into clean, structured and correct data. title: Power Markets Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
About Nexun

Backed by Marguerite, a leading pan-European infrastructure fund, Nexun is a fast-growing renewable project development platform active in Spain, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, and Austria. At Nexun, we are passionate advocates for renewable energy as well as grid infrastructure and are committed to accelerating the transition to a low-carbon economy. Join our diverse team to contribute to projects that positively impact communities across Europe.

The Power/Flexibility Markets Analyst leads the commercial development, negotiation, and optimization of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects, including both standalone storage assets and co-located solar-plus-storage projects. The role focuses on identifying best value and route-to-market for our projects, forecasting revenue schemes and offtake contracts possibilities (Tolling Agreements, PPAs), optimizing the commercial design of our plants to derisk projects and maximize their value at the point of sale (RTB) based on a solid market and technical understanding of electricity markets and asset configurations, negotiating PPAs and Tolling agreements.

Target countries: Italy, Poland, France as priority and Spain, Austria and Germany as secondary markets

Tasks

  • Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of the electricity markets in at least one of the target countries, including Day-Ahead, Intraday, Ancillary Services, Balancing Markets, Capacity Markets.
  • Monitor regulatory and market developments and evaluate their impact on the revenues and commercial viability of BESS and solar projects.
  • Collect, analyze, and develop electricity price forecasts and revenue projections for standalone BESS and hybrid solar-plus-storage projects.
  • Analyze and compare current route-to-market and optimization models and select and negotiate the optimal role (merchant, tolling, PPA, floor/hybrid structures) for standalone BESS, co-located BESS with photovoltaic (PV) plants, and hybrid renewable energy projects to maximize the RTB value and derisk the projects.
  • Originate, negotiate, and close Tolling Agreements and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with offtakers, utilities, traders, on all type of assets (BESS; collocated etc.)
  • Support the preparation of business cases, investment decisions, financial models, and technical/commercial due diligence processes.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across the BESS ecosystem and the different target countries, including utilities, energy traders, optimizers, aggregators, transmission and distribution system operators, regulatory authorities, investors, and asset operators.
  • Evaluate and optimize different technical system configurations from both a commercial and market perspective to maximize the RTB value (duration, sizing, PV/BESS ratio etc.)
  • Collaborate closely with Development, Engineering, Finance, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

Technical Qualifications

  • Good understanding of electricity markets in at least one European target market.
  • Familiarity with Day-Ahead, Intraday, Balancing, Ancillary Services, Capacity Markets, and other flexibility markets.
  • Understanding of current revenue optimization and commercialization models for standalone BESS and co-located renewable energy projects.
  • Ability to interpret and use market models, revenue forecasts, and financial models.
  • Strong Excel skills and financial modeling capabilities
  • Familiarity with Python, Power BI, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Exposure to commercial negotiations, tolling agreements, PPAs, or energy trading is beneficial but not mandatory.

Analytical Capabilities

The successful candidate should be able to quantitatively assess how different technical configurations impact project economics. Typical analyses include:

  • Comparing 2-hour and 4-hour battery storage systems with respect to CAPEX, OPEX, revenue potential, and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).
  • Determining the optimal battery size for co-located solar PV projects.
  • Evaluating revenue allocation across energy arbitrage, balancing services, ancillary services, and other flexibility products.
  • Performing scenario and sensitivity analyses covering electricity price forecasts, technology cost reductions, grid connection costs, financing assumptions, and regulatory changes.

Personal Competencies

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills; proven ability to lead and close deals
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
  • Self-driven, proactive, and entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken); additional European languages are considered an advantage.

Education & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Energy Economics, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Finance, or related discipline.

5-8 years of experience in commercial or offtake origination, PPA/tolling negotiation, route-to-market, or energy trading, combined with a solid understanding of electricity markets and BESS & all renewable assets. A demonstrable deal track record is highly desirable

Benefits

At Nexun, you’ll be part of a mission-driven, international organization shaping the future of renewable energy across Europe. Depending on the country you work in, you benefit from market-leading compensation and locally relevant benefits. We provide:

  • Flexible working arrangements and a strong work–life balance

  • A vibrant co-working office in a central location
  • The opportunity to contribute to high-impact renewable energy projects across six countries
  • A dynamic, innovative environment that supports learning, growth, and career development

At Nexun, your work matters-here, you’ll be part of shaping the future of renewable energy while thriving in a flexible, modern, and inspiring workplace.

title: Growth Product Manager
description:
The essentials

Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As Growth Product Manager at 7NXT Health Group, you drive subscriber growth across all our brands. You find the problems behind our key metrics, test your way to solutions, and make sure what we learn in one brand helps the others. Your focus spans the subscriber lifecycle — with the emphasis on its two ends: acquisition and retention.

You work in close collaboration with Marketing to bring the right people in and find the right offers to keep them: a lot of testing on pricing, offers, landing pages and cancellation flows. This is a mid-level role with real ownership in a fast-moving environment.

What you’ll drive

  • You own the experimentation roadmap, from metric to hypothesis to shipped test and clear result

  • You partner closely with Marketing and CRM on funnels, landing pages and campaigns, and own the testing of pricing and offers

  • You share what works across the group, so a win in one brand becomes a test in another

What defines you

Must-have

  • Experimentation and growth mindset. You turn a metric into customer problems and sharp hypotheses, run sound A/B tests, and build a roadmap around what will move the number.

  • Data and customer insight. You do your own analysis, from funnels to test read-outs, and combine it with research and interviews to find the real problem.

  • Hands-on attitude, comfortable using AI. You build and launch things yourself — landing pages, tests and prototypes — and use AI to automate your workflows.

  • Ownership. You own outcomes end to end and step in beyond your scope when the team needs it.

  • Communication and structure. You align Marketing, design, engineering and leadership around evidence, and document learnings so the whole group can use them.

  • 3–5 years in product, growth or a related role in a digital B2C product, with a track record of running A/B tests

Nice-to-have

  • A marketing background, or experience working closely inside a marketing team

  • Experience in a subscription business: trials, paywalls, pricing, churn and LTV dynamics

  • Familiarity with tools such as Braze, Contentful, Google Analytics or Webflow

  • Experience in a scale-up or PE-backed environment

  • German language skills

Benefits

Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:

  • 🏖️ 30 days of vacation per year + Christmas Eve & New Year's Eve as additional paid days off

  • 🏠 Hybrid working model — 60% in the office, 40% from home, applicable to all working hours

  • 🌍 Up to 4 weeks of work from abroad per year (Berlin-based roles)

  • 🏋️ Free Urban Sports Club M membership & access to Nilo Health for mental health and personal development

  • 📱 Free access to 7Mind, Gymondo & Buddyfit — our own digital wellbeing products

  • 🚲 €30 monthly mobility budget via Navit

  • 📚 €1,000 annual training budget + a wide range of opportunities for personal growth and development

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family-friendly benefits — childcare costs & paid sick days for children

  • 🍎 The office classics — fruit & vegetable basket, muesli & yogurt (also vegan), drinks & snacks

  • 🐶 Pet-friendly office — four-legged colleagues are very welcome!

These benefits apply to full-time and part-time permanent employees. Working students and interns receive a pro-rated selection.

People who make things happen

7NXT Health Group is Europe’s leading platform group for digital fitness and mental wellbeing. Through our brands Gymondo, 7Mind, Buddyfit and Preneo, we reach 20–30 million people per month across 9 European markets, helping them live healthier lives — physically and mentally. Our team of ~170 people grows organically, works at eye level, and genuinely practises what we preach.

We believe in trust over rigid structures, smart working over endless meetings — and that sustainability, inclusion and diversity aren’t buzzwords, they’re how we actually operate.

Everyone counts

We welcome what makes you unique.

At 7NXT Health Group we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love — you are welcome here.

Don’t meet all the criteria? No problem — if you’d like to help shape the future of health & wellbeing with us, we look forward to your application.

Need a more accessible process or have questions? Write to us — we’ll find a way.

title: Strategist, Agent Development (Norwegian speaking)
description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you'll do

As an Agent Strategist, you own how Sierra's AI agents come to life for our customers — from first pilot to a production agent handling thousands of conversations a day. You sit at the intersection of product, building agents and customer-facing work, and stay just as close to the technology as you are to the people you build for. You transform a customer's thorniest, highest-stakes problems into agents that measurably move their business.

  • Own the Agent Development Life Cycle. Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, and evaluation, to launch and continuous iteration in production — translating business goals into an agent that outperforms, and tuning relentlessly until it's the best version of itself in the real world. You'll have real ownership and autonomy over the outcome.

  • Be the trusted strategic advisor to enterprise leaders. Sit shoulder-to-shoulder with our customers' executives, understand what success actually means to their business, and shape the AI strategy that gets them there.

  • Partner with the customer's working teams day to day. Run working sessions, troubleshoot the agent as issues come up, and make the calls that keep the build on track for launch.

  • Directly impact product. Surface unmet needs from your customer work, and feed them back to research and platform to shape where Sierra goes next.

Example projects

These are the kinds of projects that strategists on our team have worked on recently:

  • Scope and launch a subscription-retention agent for a large telecommunications or media company that consistently outperforms human agents at saving at-risk customers.

  • Stand up an agent for a commerce customer that troubleshoots a broken device end-to-end and personalizes product recommendations in the same conversation.

  • Redesign the conversation flows for a financial services agent so it can handle complex, regulated interactions — and convert a pilot into a multi-team production deployment. See our financial services blog for examples.

  • Partner with product on a net-new capability — a new agent architecture or self-service tooling — using a live customer as the design partner.

  • Define the evaluation and quality bar for a new agent, then use those metrics to drive a measurable lift in outcome week over week.

What you'll bring

  • Customer obsession. Genuine energy being in front of customers — understanding their business and needs, thriving in complex organizations, and building trusted relationships.

  • Communication. Clear, direct, and persuasive across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strategic problem-solving in ambiguity. Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills to break down complex problems, spot risks early, and adapt as things change fast.

  • Technical aptitude. Comfortable engaging directly with technical concepts - reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and following engineering tradeoffs in a design discussion.

  • Ownership and delivery. A track record of running multiple complex, high-visibility projects at once and driving them to outcomes.

Even better...

  • Experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — hands-on with the tools behind them (eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG, prompt engineering) — working closely with technical counterparts.

  • You've been a founder, founding team member, or operator — you know how to balance craft, ownership, and speed.

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience — and/or an MBA or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Compensation: £150K – £245K • Offers Equity

title: Head of Risk
description:
About Keyrock

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a Head of Risk to own and develop the Firm’s risk function end-to-end. This is a senior leadership role with direct accountability for the design, implementation and enforcement of a Firm-wide risk framework across all activities.

The role requires strong quantitative risk expertise and the ability to apply rigorous methodologies to complex, real-time markets across both traditional finance and digital assets. The successful candidate will co-design the firm’s risk architecture with the COO and CIO, covering data, analytics and real-time risk aggregation.

You will have full oversight of risk across trading (spot and derivatives), treasury and investments, including exposures across CeFi and DeFi environments. This includes defining risk appetite, implementing advanced risk metrics and ensuring disciplined risk-taking across the organization.

We are looking for a leader who sets the standard, challenges the business and enforces a strong risk culture, while enabling the firm to scale.

 
 

Role description

Quantitative Risk Framework: Develop and maintain a quantitative risk framework grounded in modern risk theory (e.g. market, credit, liquidity and systemic risk modelling), leveraging concepts such as tail risk, extreme value theory, dependence structures and stress testing

Firm-wide Risk System Architecture: Co-design and implement the Firm-wide risk management system in close collaboration with the COO and CIO, including data architecture, risk aggregation layers, real-time monitoring capabilities and reporting infrastructure across all business lines.

Cross-Asset & Cross-Infrastructure Risk Integration: Build an integrated risk view across centralized and decentralized venues, covering exchange risk, counterparty risk, smart contract risk, collateral efficiency and liquidity fragmentation.

Advanced Risk Modelling & Metrics: Define and implement advanced risk metrics (VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress scenarios, liquidity-adjusted risk, concentration risk) and ensure their consistent application across trading, treasury and investment activities.

Is plus: TradFi ↔ Crypto Risk Translation: Translate traditional financial risk methodologies into crypto-native environments, adapting models to account for 24/7 markets, fragmented liquidity, funding dynamics, on-chain transparency and new failure modes (e.g. oracle risk, protocol risk).

 
 

Background and Experience

Quantitative Risk Expertise: Strong foundation in quantitative risk management, including hands-on experience with market risk, credit risk and liquidity risk modelling, ideally aligned with frameworks such as those presented in Quantitative Risk Management (McNeil, Frey, Embrechts).

Modelling & Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to design and implement risk models, including tail risk estimation, scenario analysis, stress testing frameworks and dependence modelling across asset classes.

System Design & Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven experience in designing or co-designing firm-wide risk systems, working closely with technology (CIO) and operations (COO) to translate risk requirements into scalable infrastructure.

TradFi + Crypto Hybrid Experience: Experience operating at the intersection of traditional financial markets and digital assets (CeFi and/or DeFi), with a strong understanding of differences in market structure, risk transmission and infrastructure.

Crypto-Specific Risk Understanding: Practical knowledge of crypto-specific risks, including exchange/custodian risk, smart contract risk, protocol risk, funding/basis dynamics and collateral management in both centralized and decentralized environments.

Competences and personality

  • Strong drive and proactivity to continuously strengthen the risk management in a fast-growing financial institution

  • The candidate reports to the COO but this is not a reporting role, but a quantitative risk management system-building role.

Our recruitment philosophy


We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

Keyrock offers you both a career and a large range of benefits that we will gladly discuss in the course of the application process.

As an employer we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse and non-discriminating work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, creed and sexual orientation. We hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
