Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As a Staff Research Scientist, you will join a team of 40+ researchers and engineers in our R&D department, working on the frontier of generative AI with a focus on avatar-centric, interactive video diffusion models.

This is a unique opportunity for experts in machine learning and diffusion models to shape the future of AI video agents that listen, respond, and react like humans. As part of our Interactive Avatars team, you'll build models that hold natural, real-time conversations: understanding what a user says and how they say it, then responding with appropriate turn-taking, backchannels, gaze, and facial and body reactions. You'll join a team that moves fast, iterates often, and turns breakthrough research into product capabilities that ship.


What you'll do

  • Set the research direction and roadmap for dyadic interaction modeling, balancing long-term bets with near-term product impact.

  • Advance the state of the art in the perceptual layer of interactive agents, including understanding user audio and video and generating contextually appropriate reactions.

  • Post-train multimodal models to generate rich, natural dyadic interactions from user audio and video inputs.

  • Adapt diffusion models to new conditioning signals, such as conversational state, turn-taking, and listener cues.

  • Build robust evaluation frameworks and test suites for continuous tracking of interaction quality.

  • Partner with our data team to define data needs and shape high-quality datasets.

  • Lead and mentor a small group of researchers, and drive technical decisions across research, data, and engineering.

What we're looking for:

  • Deep ML expertise and extensive hands-on experience with diffusion models, ideally for video or avatar generation.

  • A strong publication record at top-tier venues (e.g., CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, SIGGRAPH) in areas such as world models, dyadic interaction, or video diffusion, or equivalent demonstrated impact.

  • Experience leading a small team of researchers and mentoring junior members.

  • A track record of taking research from idea to production.

  • Proficiency in PyTorch and modern ML tooling for large-scale training.

  • Clear communication of hypotheses, experiments, and results, and the ability to influence direction across teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience with real-time or streaming generation, including autoregressive video diffusion.

  • Distillation or other techniques for low-latency inference.

  • Audio-driven facial, gesture, or full-body motion modeling.

  • Conversational modeling, such as turn-taking, backchanneling, or listener-response generation.

Why join us?

We’re living the golden age of AI. The next decade will yield the next iconic companies, and we dare to say we have what it takes to become one. Here’s why,

Our culture

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

  • Own conversion across the site: forms, journeys, page structure, and what happens after someone clicks an ad

  • Build and update pages using our existing component library and CMS

  • Run an ongoing testing programme on the pages that matter, and work with the in-house design team on what comes next

  • Ship landing pages for campaigns and product launches, including forms and tracking

  • Keep tracking and attribution clean, so the reporting can be trusted

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. title: Forward Deployed Scientist
description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the Role

You work with customers to help them design better proteins and get more out of every experiment, sitting between their design models and our lab.

In London, a large share of that work is with ARIA. Adaptyv has been selected for ARIA's second cohort of Activation Partners, and ARIA, the UK's Advanced Research + Invention Agency, is funding our new automated lab in London: the UK's first AI-native automated wet lab.

ARIA backs ambitious research programmes across areas such as engineering human immunity, protein-based materials and synthetic plants. The teams it funds, called Creators, often need experimental capabilities that do not yet exist. You'll work directly with those teams to define what needs to be built, develop the assays, and bring them onto our automation platform.

Our goal is to help the next 100 UK biotechs and neopharmas get started by the end of 2028.

What You'll Do

  • Lead scientific projects with customers. Translate biological questions into clear protein design and experimental strategies, including targets, success criteria, constructs, controls and assays.

  • Guide protein design strategy. Help teams choose the right approaches for the problem, from de novo and diffusion-based design to protein language models, structure prediction and physics-based methods.

  • Turn data into decisions. Analyse binding, expression, stability and other assay data with customers and determine what the next round of designs should test.

  • Develop new experimental capabilities. When an ARIA programme needs an assay that does not yet exist, work with the Creator team and our scientists to develop it, validate it and bring it onto the automation platform.

  • Shape future ARIA programmes. Work with ARIA Programme Directors to understand the experimental capabilities upcoming Creator cohorts are likely to need and help us prepare for them.

  • Build long-term scientific partnerships. Become a trusted scientific counterpart to the teams you work with, and bring what you learn back into our product, science and platform roadmap.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong protein science foundation. A degree and/or hands-on experience in protein design, computational biology, biochemistry, structural biology or a related field.

  • Biophysical characterisation experience. Deep hands-on experience with SPR, BLI, nanoDSF or related methods is required.

  • Fluency in modern protein design. You understand the major approaches used in the field, their strengths and limitations, and how to apply them to real design problems.

  • Strong quantitative instincts. Comfortable working with Python, notebooks and basic statistics to analyse noisy experimental data and reach clear conclusions.

  • Excellent scientific communication. Able to work closely with researchers, understand what they are trying to achieve and explain trade-offs clearly.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can take an underspecified scientific problem, form hypotheses, design the right experiments and iterate when things do not work.

  • High ownership. You take responsibility for scientific outcomes rather than simply handing work from one team to another.

  • Experience in assay development, lab automation or working with external scientific partners is a plus.

Details

  • Location: London, UK (on-site), with travel to customers and ARIA Creator sites, and regular time at our Lausanne lab.

  • Type: Full time

  • Start date: ASAP. Our London lab comes online in 2027.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

description:

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Responsable Réglementation et Conformité (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Juridique.  Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Le Responsable Réglementation et Conformité veille à ce que l'entreprise respecte l'ensemble des réglementations applicables à ses activités, produits et processus, tant au niveau national qu'international. Il garantit la conformité des collections (prêt-à-porter et accessoires, lifestyle et décoration/maison) avec les normes en vigueur, tout en intégrant les enjeux éthiques, environnementaux et sociaux sur l'ensemble des marques du groupe. Il pilote par ailleurs le dispositif de conformité corporate du groupe, en particulier la lutte anticorruption.

Missions

1. Veille réglementaire et normative

  • Assurer une veille constante sur les réglementations applicables : droit de la consommation, droit du travail, droit commercial, douanes, réglementation textile, REACH, sécurité produit, étiquetage, allégations environnementales (directive Empowering Consumers), protection des données
  • Identifier les évolutions réglementaires susceptibles d'impacter l'activité de l'entreprise (France, UE, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, pays de fabrication et de distribution)
  • Informer les équipes internes des évolutions et les accompagner dans leur mise en œuvre

2. Conformité produit

  • S'assurer que les produits respectent les exigences légales en matière de composition, traçabilité, étiquetage, sécurité, tests laboratoires, sur l'ensemble des catégories (textile, maroquinerie, bijoux, lifestyle, décoration/maison)
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes qualité, achats, design, développement produit et supply chain afin de garantir la bonne conduite des audits de conformité et des tests produits (substances réglementées, inflammabilité, solidité, sécurité des articles enfant…)

3. Conformité corporate et lutte anticorruption

  • Piloter le dispositif de conformité à la loi Sapin II : cartographie des risques de corruption, code de conduite, dispositif d'alerte interne, procédures d'évaluation des tiers, formation des collaborateurs exposés 
  • Gérer le dispositif de recueil des signalements (lanceurs d'alerte) : réception, qualification, instruction et suivi, dans le respect de la confidentialité et des délais légaux
  • Déployer et suivre les procédures de due diligence tiers (fournisseurs, intermédiaires, agents à l'international)
  • Assurer le suivi des obligations liées au devoir de vigilance et au reporting de durabilité (CSRD), en lien avec les équipes RSE et Finance

4. Accompagnement des équipes et mise en conformité

  • Rédiger ou actualiser les procédures internes et les différents cahiers des charges (produits, matières, fournitures)
  • Former les collaborateurs aux enjeux réglementaires et de conformité (équipes design, production, marketing, supply chain, achats, finance, commerce)
  • Aider à l'accompagnement par les équipes des fournisseurs dans la mise en conformité des produits et dans le respect des standards sociaux et environnementaux de l'entreprise
  • Être le point de contact des équipes opérationnelles pour toute question de conformité, et savoir arbitrer entre exigence réglementaire et réalité business

5. Gestion des risques et reporting

  • Mettre en place des plans de prévention ; animer et mettre à jour la cartographie des risques de conformité du groupe 
  • Suivre les indicateurs de conformité et établir un reporting régulier
  • Gérer les situations liées à une non-conformité : rappels produits, litiges clients, contrôles DGCCRF, AFA, CNIL ou autorités étrangères
  • Piloter les relations avec les conseils externes sur les sujets de conformité

Requirements

  • Formation supérieure en droit (Master 2 en droit des affaires, compliance, droit de la consommation ou équivalent) ; une certification compliance est un atout
  • 6 à 10 ans d'expérience en conformité, en entreprise ou en cabinet, avec une expérience opérationnelle avérée du déploiement d'un dispositif Sapin II
  • Une expérience dans le retail, le e-commerce ou les biens de consommation est fortement souhaitée, idéalement avec une exposition à la conformité produit textile et aux filières REP
  • Maîtrise des réglementations clés : Sapin II, RGPD, droit de la consommation, devoir de vigilance, réglementation textile et sécurité produit
  • Capacité à traduire la réglementation en process opérationnels simples, applicables par des équipes non juristes
  • Rigueur, autonomie, sens de la confidentialité et solidité face à des situations sensibles
  • Anglais courant indispensable, environnement de travail international

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

The opportunity

 

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end.

Here are the challenges to be tackled as a Senior Platform Engineer:

  • Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage.
  • Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform.
  • Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team.
  • Participate in incident response.
  • Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas.
  • Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...)
  • Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team.

In addition to Platform responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. This is not limited to scripting and automations - we expect to you to be fully capable of reading and writing code. We believe Senior Platform Engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team.

 

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product.

Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend.

 

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology.

Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit.

 

Technical stack:

  • Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL
  • Terraform: all our infrastructure is managed via this infrastructure as code (creation of GKE clusters, Google Cloud SQL databases, GCS buckets, IAM permissions...)
  • Databases: PostgreSQL (CloudSQL and CloudNativePG), SingleStore, ElasticSearch
  • RabbitMQ: queuing system
  • Temporal.io: workflow automation platform
  • Others: ArgoCD, Istio, Vault, Github, Docker (for local development)
  • Backend: Microservices written in C# ASP.NET Core 8 (running exclusively on Linux) & Golang
  • Frontend: React + Typescript, Jest, Cypress, Vite...

 

Who you are

 

More than knowledge of a specific cloud provider, language, or automation framework, we are looking for great engineering skills: the ability to translate product requirements into an elegant and simple architecture, and then make sure our product runs well on it.

In any case, you have:

  • Experience as a software engineer & Platform Engineer. Hands on coding is a must for this role.
  • Experience with a container orchestration platform (Kubernetes is a plus)
  • Experience with a public cloud provider, GCP is a plus
  • Proven experience in software developments with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive).
  • Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Jaeger...)
  • Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude.
  • A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!).
  • Fluency in English

title: Single Photon Source Lithography Engineer
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.
Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

About this position:

Role Overview 

We are looking for a Single Photon Source Lithography Engineer to support the development, stabilization and industrialization of our semiconductor fabrication processes. 

At our current stage of maturity, this position combines advanced process development, hands-on R&D and manufacturing engineering. The Lithography Engineer will play a key role in bridging the gap between Advanced R&D and Production, transforming newly developed process building blocks into robust, repeatable and scalable manufacturing processes. 

The role will have a strong focus on in-situ localization of quantum dots (QDs) at cryogenic temperatures and laser lithography over the localized Qds with laser writing techniques. The successful candidate will work closely with R&D teams, fabrication engineers, equipment owners and cleanroom operators to improve process capability, reproducibility, yield and production throughput. 

This is a highly hands-on position requiring a strong understanding of semiconductor fabrication, rigorous experimental methodology and the ability to investigate complex interactions between process parameters and device performance. 

Key Responsibilities 

Process Development & Industrialization 

  • Develop, optimize and stabilize QD positioning and laser lithography process. 
  • Contribute to the development of GUIs and automation codes in the Python programming language. 
  • Contrinute to the development of fully-automated QD-positioning and litography tools. 
  • Validate and qualify new fabrication equipment and associated processes. 
  • Define process windows, recipes, operating conditions and acceptance criteria. 
  • Use structured experimentation, including Design of Experiments (DoE) where appropriate, to understand process sensitivities and optimize performance. 
  • Improve process repeatability, reproducibility, robustness and within-wafer / wafer-to-wafer homogeneity. 
  • Prepare processes and equipment for increasing wafer sizes, batch sizes and production volumes. 

R&D to Production Transfer 

  • Act as a key technical interface between Advanced R&D and Production. 
  • Convert R&D process building blocks into stable, documented and manufacturable processes. 
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability and process risks before transfer to production. 
  • Define qualification plans and acceptance criteria before releasing new or modified processes to production. 
  • Lead or contribute to Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for critical fabrication steps, identifying potential failure modes, their effects on device performance and appropriate prevention and control measures. 
  • Translate PFMEA outcomes into process controls, monitoring plans, acceptance criteria, Control Plans and documentation. 
  • Support technology transfer through clear documentation, operator training and technical communication. 

Process Control & Yield Improvement 

  • Monitor and improve production process performance, yield and throughput. 
  • Establish regular process checks, controls and monitoring methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC) where relevant. 
  • Detect process drifts, investigate deviations and define corrective and preventive actions. 
  • Lead root-cause analysis and troubleshooting activities for yield losses, process excursions and equipment-related issues. 
  • Define and maintain relevant process KPIs and contribute to continuous-improvement initiatives. 
  • Promote best practices that increase process stability, repeatability and equipment utilization. 

Equipment & Production Support 

  • Provide hands-on technical support to cleanroom operators and production teams. 
  • Work closely with equipment suppliers and internal teams to resolve technical issues. 
  • Contribute to a safe, disciplined and efficient cleanroom environment. 

Process Characterization & Data Analysis 

  • Correlate process data with structural, optical and electrical characterization results. 
  • Use experimental data to identify process sensitivities, failure mechanisms and optimization opportunities. 
  • Develop appropriate data-analysis tools to support process monitoring and engineering decisions. 
  • Search and analyze scientific and technical literature to support process development and troubleshooting. 

Documentation & Communication 

  • Create and maintain high-quality process documentation, including process specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), equipment recipes, qualification reports, Control Plans, process-development reports and troubleshooting guides. 
  • Ensure frequent and clear reporting of process status, experimental results, risks and improvement actions. 
  • Communicate effectively with colleagues from different technical backgrounds and levels of experience. 
  • Train and support operators and other team members on new or updated processes. 

Requirements

Required Qualifications & Experience 

  • Master's degree or PhD in Optics, Materials Science, Physics, Micro/Nanotechnology, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
  • Hands-on experience with semiconductor or photonic-device fabrication in a cleanroom environment. 
  • Hands-on experience in conception, assembling, and alignment of optical systems. 
  • Hands-on experience in conception, assembling, and operation of electronic devices 
  • Python programming language fluency. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a rigorous approach to experimental work. 
  • Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills. 
  • Ability to independently investigate technical problems using experimental data and scientific literature. 
  • Strong communication and documentation skills. 
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in developments of GUIs with the python programming language. 
  • Experience in a semiconductor manufacturing, pilot-line or production environment. 
  • Experience with process industrialization and transfer from R&D to production. 
  • Experience with PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, DoE or other structured process-risk and continuous-improvement methodologies. 
  • Experience with III-V semiconductor devices, particularly AlGaAs-based photonic structures, resonators or VCSEL-type technologies. 

Profile 

We are looking for someone who combines the mindset of an R&D engineer with the rigor of a manufacturing/process engineer. 

The ideal candidate is comfortable developing new systems where all parameters are not yet fully understood, while also being able to transform experimental processes into stable, controlled and documented production workflows. 

You should enjoy working directly in the cleanroom, analyzing data, developing Python projects, solving complex fabrication problems and collaborating across R&D and production teams. 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer:

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

title: Senior Project Manager - Quantum Research
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

 

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – Advanced Technology Programs to lead large-scale, strategic technology and R&D programs involving multiple technical disciplines, internal teams and external partners.

You will operate at the intersection of technology, engineering and program execution, turning ambitious technical objectives into structured and executable programs.

You will coordinate programs involving disciplines such as quantum physics, integrated photonics, semiconductor technologies, electronics, optics, hardware engineering, software and algorithms, while ensuring alignment between technical performance, schedule, resources, budget and contractual commitments.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed large and technically complex programs in demanding engineering environments such as space, aerospace, defense or semiconductors, where successful delivery requires coordinating multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, industrial partners, research organizations and institutional stakeholders across several countries.

This is a senior individual contributor / program leadership position requiring both technical credibility and strong execution capabilities. You will not be expected to be the scientific expert on every topic, but you must be able to understand complex technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, structure decisions and create the conditions for engineering teams to deliver.

Key responsabilities

** Lead Complex Technology Projects

Take end-to-end ownership of strategic R&D and technology projects, from initial framing through development, integration, validation and final delivery.

Translate high-level scientific, product or business ambitions into clear program objectives, work packages, milestones, interfaces and measurable deliverables.

Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, dependencies and critical paths.

Establish program governance and ensure effective decision-making across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify deviations, bottlenecks and dependencies requiring management attention.

Drive recovery plans when projects deviate from their original objectives, including prioritization, resource reallocation, scope adjustment or technical replanning.

** Manage Technical complexity & interfaces

Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning quantum physics, photonics, semiconductor technologies, optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, software and algorithms.

Work closely with technical leads to identify critical interfaces and dependencies between subsystems and workstreams.

Challenge project assumptions and ensure that technical decisions are translated into clear consequences for performance, schedule, cost and risk.

Support the transition from research and scientific proof-of-concept to engineering development, prototyping, integration, qualification and demonstrators.

Ensure that technical maturity, integration readiness and project risks are visible and understood at program level.

** Coordinate Internal & External Stakeholders

Act as a central coordination point between Quandela teams, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions and institutional stakeholders.

Lead technical and programmatic exchanges involving stakeholders with different scientific, engineering and business perspectives.

Coordinate activities across multiple teams, organizations, sites and countries, ensuring clear ownership and effective information flow.

Manage expectations and commitments with external partners while protecting Quandela's technical, contractual and strategic interests.

Prepare and lead program reviews, steering committees and executive-level project updates.

** Risk, Budget & Delivery Management

Establish and maintain structured risk and opportunity management, including technical, schedule, supply-chain, financial and organizational risks.

Own or contribute to program budgets, resource forecasts and capacity planning.

Define and monitor relevant KPIs covering delivery, technical maturity, cost, schedule and risk.

Anticipate critical-path issues and implement mitigation plans before they impact major milestones.

Create a strong culture of accountability, transparency and fact-based decision-making across programs.

** Governance, contracts & compliance

Ensure high-quality program documentation, traceability and reporting. Coordinate contractual deliverables and reporting for strategic partnerships and publicly funded programs where applicable.

Work with relevant internal stakeholders on IP, confidentiality, export-control, security and contractual matters.

Contribute to improving Quandela's project and program management methodologies as the organization scales.

Requirements

Education

You have graduated from a top-tier engineering school or university in engineering, physics or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.

A PhD in physics, photonics, quantum technologies, semiconductor technologies or a related engineering field is a strong asset, particularly when combined with substantial industrial program-management experience.

Experience

You bring approximately 10+ years of professional experience, including significant responsibility for complex technology or engineering programs.

You have demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multidisciplinary projects with significant technical complexity, multiple interfaces and demanding delivery objectives.

Experience in one or several of the following industries is particularly relevant:

  • Space / aerospace
  • Defense
  • Semiconductors / microelectronics
  • Advanced photonics or optics
  • Complex scientific instrumentation
  • Other high-tech environments combining hardware, software and advanced engineering

You have worked with multidisciplinary and international stakeholders, including engineering teams, scientists, suppliers, industrial partners, research institutions and/or public organizations.

You can demonstrate concrete examples of programs for which you managed significant scope, budget, resources, milestones, risks and external dependencies.

Technical & Program Management Capabilities

You have sufficient technical depth to understand complex engineering discussions, challenge project assumptions and identify critical technical dependencies without replacing subject-matter experts.

You are comfortable managing projects from early-stage R&D through engineering development, prototyping, integration and validation.

You have strong command of project/program management practices including WBS, planning, critical-path management, risk management, resource planning, budget management, change management and project governance.

Experience with PMI/PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or hybrid methodologies is valued, but demonstrated delivery experience matters more than certification alone.

Experience with publicly funded, governmental or collaborative R&D programs is an advantage.

Previous quantum-computing experience is not mandatory. Experience in quantum technologies, photonics or semiconductor technologies would nevertheless be a strong asset.

Leadership & Mindset

You combine a strong engineering mindset with the ability to operate at program and strategic level. You are comfortable challenging senior technical stakeholders while maintaining constructive and fact-based discussions.

You know how to bring structure to environments where technical uncertainty is high and not all answers are available at the beginning of a project.

You can distinguish between issues requiring deep technical investigation and those requiring pragmatic decisions to maintain momentum.

You communicate effectively with both highly specialized technical teams and executive stakeholders.

You are comfortable operating in an international, multidisciplinary and rapidly growing deeptech environment.

Professional fluency in English is required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working environment, with the position primarily based at our Massy (Paris-Saclay) office to support close collaboration with the teams. 
  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan.
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car).

At Quandela, we value intellectual diversity, curiosity and initiative. If you're passionate about quantum algorithms, fault-tolerant quantum computing and the future of large-scale quantum applications, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement.

At Plumerai, we make it easy and affordable for developers to add highly accurate AI to their camera devices, enabling them to create amazing new products. Role description

We are looking for an Senior Deep Learning Research Engineer that can help us develop state of the art AI products.   • +5 years of professional software engineering experience with proficiency in Python.

  • Comfortable with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, or JAX.

  • Strong experience with computer vision and multimodal LLMs.

  • Trained neural networks that moved into production.

description:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

title: Endear - Product Designer
description:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

title: Knit - Research Manager
description:
Knit is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.


Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

  • Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

  • Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

  • Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

  • Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

  • Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

  • Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

  • Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

  • Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

  • Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision in getting to stakeholder ready reports

Required Skills & Experiences:

  • Must have 5+ years of market research experience, with the majority of the time spent on the supplier side in a market research agency environment.

  • Must have experience leading discovery and scoping calls, writing and editing quant and qual questionnaires from scratch, drafting analysis plans, and creating and presenting stakeholder-ready insights topline & reports.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes in ambiguous environments, both for navigating complex customer needs and Knit internal business changes. Proven track record successfully operating in an early stage startup (<50 employees) is a plus.

  • Proven track record of owning and supporting client relationships with customers at Enterprise, Fortune 500 US-based companies, specifically working with insights professionals to scope and achieve desired research outcomes, resulting in customer retention and growth.

  • Ability to drive initiatives and outcomes successfully in environments with competing priorities, multiple research projects on at a given time, and simultaneous internal business demands.

Benefits

Upon joining the Knit team, you will receive a competitive salary + commission plan if applicable to role, Equity Options, Healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), and Additional Coverage, a company laptop and one-time, onboarding Technology Stipend, a 401(k) with company match, flexible time-off, hybrid working, and more!

Salary

In accordance with New York pay transparency requirements, the salary range for this role is $115,000 - $130,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s level, experience, and qualifications upon joining Knit.

Our Company Values

We are the Championship Team. This means we:

  • Are 1% better every day: We approach situations with a growth mindset and ask, “How can we make the business better?” and “What would it take?”

  • Play to win: We set audacious goals and push ourselves to achieve them with a bias towards action (When we see a need, we take initiative, and hold ourselves accountable to seeing it through).

  • Keep the main thing the main thing: Identify what has the biggest impact and prioritize to focus on it.

title: Senior AI Product Engineer
description:
About the company

Turning marketing into a market-domination weapon, we created a new category — the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy — full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We're the #1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we're accelerating.

Role overview

We're looking for a Senior AI Product Engineer to build the AI operating layer behind our marketplace. You take a valuable but unclear business problem — improve lead quality, cut refunds, automate a manual workflow, extract intelligence from calls — and turn it into a dependable production system end-to-end: investigate, define success, design, build, deploy, and improve on real usage data. You are a one-person AI product team for high-leverage problems, not a spec-taker.

We are expanding beyond real estate into new service-business niches, and growth is powered by reusable software and automation — not proportional growth in manual work. Every system you ship either compounds into that leverage or exposes where it leaks — no in-between.

Why this role exists

Our growth is not limited by ideas or data — we already run 40K+ members, 750+ verified daily leads, and 50B data points powering AI. It's limited by how fast we can turn ambiguous, high-value problems into shipped AI systems that actually move business metrics. We need a builder who owns the complete production outcome — not a prompt tinkerer, not a researcher, not a PM who delegates the build.

Requirements:

  • Strong record of building and shipping production software end-to-end, ideally in a SaaS, marketplace, or workflow product — with real users and real revenue on the line.

  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript, plus solid backend fundamentals: APIs, databases, auth, data models, testing, and deployment.

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered functionality using model APIs, structured outputs, tool/function calling, retrieval, context engineering, and agentic workflows.

  • Production automation experience: webhooks, events, queues, schedules, retries, idempotency, monitoring, and failure recovery — not just happy-path demos.

  • Practical evaluation skills: test sets, traces, quality metrics, regression checks, feedback loops, and root-causing real production failures.

  • Daily fluency with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or equivalent) — you review, test, refactor, and secure generated work, not ship it raw.

  • English C1+; our stakeholders, users, and business owners are US-based, and communication must be sharp and clear.

  • AI-first by default — if you are not already using AI to 3x your own output, you will be behind the rest of engineering.

  • Product ownership and strong judgment in ambiguous, fast-moving environments — you clarify goals, make tradeoffs, and connect every technical decision to a business KPI.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Discover high-value product and operational problems by working directly with users, business owners, and internal teams, then frame clear success criteria before writing code.

  • Design and ship customer-facing AI features and internal automations across lead quality, matching, prediction, call intelligence, CRM, support, and operations.

  • Build agents and workflows that safely use tools, APIs, databases, calls, SMS, email, and other company systems — with human approval where risk requires it.

  • Create the context layer around models: instructions, retrieval, memory, structured outputs, tool definitions, permissions, and feedback loops.

  • Build reliable event-driven and scheduled automation using webhooks, queues, schedulers, retries, idempotency, audit logs, and graceful fallbacks.

title: Senior Financial Operations Specialist
description:
Ecochain is a fast-growing, purpose-driven B2B SaaS scale-up on a mission to make sustainability data accessible for 100M products by 2035. We build LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) automation platforms—Mobius and Helix—that help Industrial Manufacturers quantify, share, and reduce their environmental footprint with speed and scale.

Founded in 2011 in the Netherlands, we're now a team of 50+ professionals serving Construction Products and Industrial Equipment manufacturers across Benelux, DACH, and beyond. Our customers trust us to turn complex impact data into actionable insights, enabling them to meet compliance requirements (CPR, EPBD, ESPR) and build more sustainable products.

Our Values:

  • We Care – We support our teammates, customers, and the planet

  • We Share – We grow stronger by sharing knowledge, feedback, and success

  • We Empower – We create space for people to lead, learn, and make a difference

The Role

As our Senior Financial Operations Specialist, you'll own the operational backbone of our financial administration—accounts receivable, the vendor invoice pipeline, and a clean, on-time month-end close. Reporting directly to our Financial Controller, you won't be assisting someone else's process. You'll own a domain outright, and your Controller will review your work rather than rebuild it.

This is a deliberately designed 24-hour role. Not a full-time job squeezed into part-time pay, and not a stopgap—a permanent, well-organised position for someone who wants to do one thing properly rather than five things partially.

What You'll Do

  • Own accounts receivable end-to-end—customer billing, contract invoicing, credit management, and the AR aging overview.

  • Run collections independently, following up past-due balances with a friendly, professional approach and resolving billing queries yourself.

  • Manage the accounts payable pipeline—intake, approval routing, and submission of vendor invoices to our external accountant.

  • Prepare weekly payment batches for approval, maintaining continuous oversight of what's unpaid.

  • Code invoices accurately to the correct general ledger accounts and cost centres.

  • Prepare routine monthly journal entries (accruals and revenue allocations) and perform balance-sheet reconciliations.

  • Review P&L cost and revenue lines to verify correct period allocation.

  • Keep the administration audit-ready as a matter of course, and support the Financial Controller on ad-hoc projects and process improvements.

  • Reports to: Financial Controller

  • Team: Finance (working closely with our external accountant, Customer Success, and Sales)

  • Hours: 24 per week—three full days, or spread across four or five. You choose the pattern.

What We Offer

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Gross full-time salary of €3,500 – €4,500 per month depending on experience (based on 40 hours, pro-rated to 24 hours), plus 8% holiday allowance (vakantiegeld)

  • Secondary benefits: Pension contribution, phone allowance, sports allowance

  • Free lunch options in our Amsterdam-area office

  • 100% public transport reimbursement or €0.25/km for own vehicle

Purpose & Impact

  • Mission-driven work: Enable 100M products to share sustainability data by 2035

  • Real-world impact: Clean, well-run administration is what frees up capacity for the mission-driven work everyone else here is doing. Cash collected on time is cash that funds the next release

  • B Corp employer: We're measured on our impact, not just our margins

Growth & Development

  • Scale-up phase: We're growing—be part of the journey

  • High ownership: Influence how our financial processes are designed, not just how they're executed

  • Career path: Grow through scope—ownership of the close calendar, the AP approval design, supplier terms. If the role outgrows 24 hours, we'll have that conversation honestly

  • Learning culture: Product training, cross-functional exposure, and sustainability context you won't get in a traditional finance department

Work-Life Integration

  • Genuinely flexible hours: 24 per week, structured around your life. We plan around your pattern, not the other way around

  • Hybrid working: Office presence during close week, otherwise your call

  • Protected time: When you're off, you're off. You are not expected to monitor emails, Slack, or check in on days you aren't working

  • Trust-based culture: High autonomy with clear accountability and support

  • Inclusive team: International team of 50+ colleagues who live our values (We Care, We Share, We Empower)

How to Apply

Submit your application including your Resume/CV and a Cover Letter. We read the cover letter first, and we'd love for you to answer three quick questions directly:

  1. The full cycle you've owned: Walk us from a customer signing to the accountant filing. Be specific about where your responsibility started and stopped.

  2. A balance you recovered: Tell us about a past-due balance you recovered from an unhappy customer. What did you say, and what happened to the relationship afterwards?

  3. Managing a 24-hour week: How do you organize your work across 24 hours so that routine deadlines (like month-end or payment runs) are met smoothly without urgent tasks getting stuck on days you're off?

Three short paragraphs are plenty. Specific beats polished—we'd rather read one real story than three pages of adjectives.

Interview Process

We move quickly for the right candidate:

  1. Screening Interview – Financial Controller (30 min): Culture fit, ownership experience, motivation, and how a 24-hour week fits your life.

  2. Working Interview – Financial Controller (90 min): A live case using real, anonymised material from our own administration, plus a short take-home assignment (capped at 3 hours, and paid).

  3. Final Interview – CEO (30 min): Vision alignment, long-term commitment.


What We're Looking For

Must-Haves:

  • Full-cycle ownership: Proven track record in bookkeeping, financial administration, or financial operations where you've owned a complete financial administration alongside an external accountant.

  • Accounting know-how: Solid understanding of general ledger mechanics, double-entry bookkeeping, accruals, and reconciliations.

  • Collections capability: You chase money by picking up the phone, and you keep the relationship intact while you do it.

  • Tech-savvy: Comfortable with cloud accounting platforms (e.g. Exact, AFAS, NetSuite) and Excel.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and Dutch, written and spoken—including phoning a customer about money in either.

  • Self-starter mentality: You manage your own schedule and follow up on details independently.

Strong Preferences:

  • Scale-up or SaaS experience—particularly recurring billing (proration, mid-term upgrades, monthly-to-annual conversions)

  • Experience working alongside an external accountant rather than inside a large finance department

  • Company size of roughly 30–150 people—big enough for real volume, small enough that you owned it

  • B2B invoicing to international customers across multiple countries and currencies

  • Dutch professional qualifications (PDB, MBA Moderne Bedrijfsadministratie, MBO/HBO bedrijfsadministratie)

  • Having been through an audit or due-diligence process from the administration side

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

YOU'RE A GREAT FIT IF:

  • You've owned a complete financial administration and can describe exactly where your responsibility started and stopped

  • You take genuine pride in clean accounts—being audit-ready is just how you work, not a project you run in January

  • You treat collections as a relationship job with a number attached, not as sending reminders

  • You're clear and outcome-focused: you appreciate having simple, transparent goals so you always know what success looks like

  • You want a permanent, well-organised 24-hour role that fits your life, and you're not looking to grow out of it next year

  • You'd rather fix the cause of a recurring problem than get faster at handling it

  • You're willing to tell a colleague—including a senior one—that a number or a contract term is wrong

YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF:

  • You've only ever been one specialist inside a large finance department—this role has nobody to hand work to

  • You need fully remote work (we need you in the Amsterdam office during close week)

  • You want to move into controlling or FP&A within a year—this is a permanent operations role and that ambition will frustrate you

  • You're looking for a bonus—there isn't one here, deliberately

  • You expect a full-time workload to be squeezed into 24 hours, or you expect 24 hours to mean 32

  • You view part-time as "less accountability" rather than "same ownership, fewer hours"

About Ecochain's Culture

We're a diverse, international team committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every team member is valued for their unique perspectives. We believe in:

  • Transparency: Open communication, shared wins and mistakes, honest feedback

  • Empowerment: Trust over micromanagement, ownership over task execution

  • Care: Support for teammates, customers, and the planet—always

  • Accountability: Clear expectations, regular check-ins, and data-driven decision-making

If you're ready to combine precise, well-run financial operations with meaningful, planet-positive work, we'd love to hear from you.

Ecochain is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
